01

天地初开When heaven and earth began

《古事记》的正文从天地开辟写起。它说：天地刚刚分开的时候，在高天原上出现了三位神：天之御中主神、高御产巢日神和神产巢日神。张伯伦把后两个名字分别译作“高贵而能生成万物的奇妙之神”和“神圣而能生成万物的奇妙之神”。这三位神都是独自出现的，出现以后就隐去了身形，书中没有讲他们的样子，也没有讲他们做了什么。那时候，下面的国土还很年轻，像漂在水上的油脂一样，像水母一样随波漂流，没有一处是固定的。就在这时，有一样东西像芦苇的嫩芽一样萌发出来，从中又出现了两位神：宇摩志阿斯诃备比古迟神和天之常立神。这五位神被称为“别天神”，也就是与后来诸神不同的、特别的天神，他们同样是独自出现、随即隐去身形的神。其中的高御产巢日神和神产巢日神，在后面的故事里还会一次次出现：一位主持高天原上的商议，一位把死去的大国主救活。故事就从这样一个漂浮不定、还没有固定下来的世界开始。

The Kojiki proper opens at the time when heaven and earth first began. In the Plain of High Heaven there came into being three deities: Ame-no-minaka-nushi, Takami-musubi and Kami-musubi, the last two of whom Chamberlain renders the High-August-Producing-Wondrous Deity and the Divine-Producing-Wondrous Deity. All three came into being alone and hid their persons; the text says nothing of how they looked or what they did. The land below was still young, like floating oil, drifting about like a jellyfish, with nothing yet fixed. Then, from something that sprouted up like a reed-shoot, two more deities came into being, Umashi-ashi-kabi-hiko-ji and Ame-no-toko-tachi, who likewise came alone and hid their persons. These five are set apart as the separate Heavenly Deities. Takami-musubi and Kami-musubi will return again and again: the one presiding over the councils of High Heaven, the other bringing the dead Ōkuninushi back to life. The story begins in a world still afloat and not yet made firm.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第一节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.01
02

神世七代The seven divine generations

接着出现的是国之常立神和丰云野神，他们也是独自出现、隐去身形的神。此后诸神开始成对出现：宇比地迩神与须比智迩神，角杙神与活杙神，意富斗能地神与大斗乃辨神，於母陀流神与阿夜诃志古泥神，最后是伊邪那岐神与伊邪那美神。张伯伦把这最后两个名字译作“邀请之男神”和“邀请之女神”：名字里的“伊邪那”有邀请、招呼的意思，“岐”和“美”分别表示男和女。从国之常立神到伊邪那岐、伊邪那美，被称为“神世七代”：前面两位独自出现的神各算一代，后面每一对男女神合算一代。这些名字的意思并不都清楚，有的像在说泥土和沙，有的像在说木桩，有的像在说宽大的门户，有的像在说完满的面貌和敬畏的言辞，像是一步步描写大地成形、万物有了模样的过程，但书中并没有讲他们做了什么。真正开始动手造国的，是最后出现的这一对兄妹神。

Next came into being Kuni-no-toko-tachi and Toyo-kumo-nu, who also came alone and hid their persons. After them the deities came in pairs: U-hiji-ni and Su-hiji-ni, Tsunu-guhi and Iku-guhi, Oho-to-no-ji and Oho-to-no-be, Omo-daru and Aya-kashiko-ne, and last of all Izanagi and Izanami, whom Chamberlain renders the Male-Who-Invites and the Female-Who-Invites: izana- carries the sense of inviting, and -ki and -mi mark male and female. From Kuni-no-toko-tachi to Izanami are called the Seven Divine Generations: the two single deities count a generation each, and each pair counts as one. The meanings of the names are not all clear; some seem to speak of mud and sand, of posts, of great doorways, of a perfect face and of awe, as if the land were slowly taking shape, but the text does not say what these deities did. The work of making the land falls to the last pair.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第二节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.02
03

淤能碁吕岛The island of Onogoro

天上的众神一齐命令伊邪那岐和伊邪那美：去把这片漂浮的国土整治好，使它坚固，把它生出来。众神的命令里有三件事——整治、巩固、生出——后面的故事，正是一步步完成这三件事。众神赐给他们一支装饰着美玉的长矛，叫作天之沼矛。两位神站在天之浮桥上，把长矛伸进下面的海水里，“咕噜咕噜”地搅动起来——这是书中模仿搅动海水的声音。他们把长矛提起来，从矛尖滴下的海水层层堆积，变成了一座岛，这就是淤能碁吕岛。张伯伦把这个名字译作“自凝岛”，意思是“自己凝结而成的岛”。这是天地间第一块坚固的土地。淤能碁吕岛究竟在哪里，书中没有说，后世有许多说法，都只是推测。两位神从天之浮桥上走下来，降落到这座岛上。造国的工作，就要从这里开始了。

All the heavenly deities commanded Izanagi and Izanami to make, consolidate and give birth to the drifting land — three tasks that the rest of the story works through one by one — and granted them a jewelled spear, the Ame-no-nuhoko. Standing on the Floating Bridge of Heaven, the two pushed the spear down and stirred the brine until it went curdle-curdle, the text imitating the sound. When they drew the spear up, the brine that dripped from its point piled up and became an island: Onogoro, which Chamberlain renders Self-Curdling Island. It was the first firm ground. Where Onogoro lies the text does not say; later identifications are only conjecture. The two deities descended from the Floating Bridge onto the island, and from there the making of the land began.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第三节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.03
04

天之御柱与水蛭子The heavenly pillar and the leech-child

两位神在岛上竖起了一根天之御柱，又建起一座八寻殿——“寻”是两臂张开的长度，八寻就是极言其宽大。伊邪那岐问伊邪那美：你的身体是怎样长成的？伊邪那美说：我的身体长成了，只有一处没有长合。伊邪那岐说：我的身体也长成了，只有一处长得多余。我想用多余的地方填补你没有长合的地方，生出国土，你看怎样？伊邪那美说：好。伊邪那岐说：那么我们绕着天之御柱走，相遇以后结为夫妻。你从右边绕，我从左边绕。两人绕柱相遇时，伊邪那美先开口说：啊，多么好的男子！伊邪那岐接着说：啊，多么好的少女！说完他又说：女子先开口是不吉利的。可他们还是结合了，生下的第一个孩子是水蛭子。书中没有描写他的样子，只说他们把这个孩子放进芦苇编的小船里，任它漂走了。接着又生了淡岛，也不算在他们的孩子之中。

On the island they set up a heavenly pillar and built a hall eight fathoms wide. Izanagi asked Izanami how her body was formed. She answered that it was fully formed except for one place that had not grown together; he said his was fully formed except for one place that had grown to excess, and proposed to fill her place with his and so give birth to lands. She agreed. 'Then let us walk round this heavenly pillar,' he said, 'and meet and be joined. You go round from the right, I from the left.' When they met, Izanami spoke first: 'Ah, what a fair and lovely youth!' Then Izanagi: 'Ah, what a fair and lovely maiden!' Afterwards he said it was unlucky for the woman to speak first. Yet they came together, and their first child was a leech-child, whom they put into a boat of reeds and let float away. Next they bore the island of Aha, which also was not reckoned among their children.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第四节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.04
05

重新绕柱，生下大八岛The Great Eight Islands

两位神商量说：我们生的孩子不好，应该去问问天上的众神。他们一起回到天上，请求众神的指示。天上的众神用太占——一种烧鹿肩骨看裂纹的占卜——占了一卦，说：因为女子先开口，所以不好。回去重新说一遍吧。两人回到岛上，像以前一样绕着天之御柱走，这一次伊邪那岐先说：啊，多么好的少女！伊邪那美再说：啊，多么好的男子！这样结合以后，他们生下的是一个个岛屿：先是淡路岛；接着是伊予之二名岛，它一个身体有四张脸，每张脸都有名字：伊予国叫爱比卖，赞岐国叫饭依比古，粟国叫大宜都比卖，土左国叫建依别；然后是隐岐岛；筑紫岛也是一个身体四张脸，分别是筑紫国、丰国、肥国和熊曾国；再往后是壹岐岛、对马岛、佐渡岛，最后是大倭丰秋津岛，也就是本州。因为这八个岛最先生出，所以这片土地被称为“大八岛国”。之后他们又生下了六个小岛。

The two took counsel: 'The children we have borne are not good. We should report this before the heavenly deities.' They went up together, and the heavenly deities divined by grand divination — reading the cracks in a burned deer's shoulder-blade — and said: 'It was not good because the woman spoke first. Go down again and say it anew.' So they walked round the pillar as before, and this time Izanagi spoke first. Then they gave birth to islands: Awaji first; then Iyo-no-futana, one body with four faces, each named — Iyo called Ehime, Sanuki called Iiyori-hiko, Aha called Ōgetsu-hime and Tosa called Takeyori-wake; then Oki; then Tsukushi, likewise one body with four faces, the lands of Tsukushi, Toyo, Hi and Kumaso; then Iki, Tsushima, Sado, and last Ō-yamato-toyo-aki-tsu-shima. Because these eight islands were born first, the country is called the Land of the Eight Great Islands. After them they bore six smaller islands.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第五节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.05
06

众神诞生The birth of the deities

生完了国土，伊邪那岐和伊邪那美又接着生神。书中把这些神的名字一个个记下来：大事忍男神，石土毘古神，石巢比卖神，大户日别神，天之吹男神，大屋毘古神，风木津别之忍男神；然后是海神大绵津见神，河口之神速秋津日子神和速秋津比卖神——这一对河口之神又生下了沫那艺、沫那美、颊那艺、颊那美等掌管水沫与水面的神；接着是风神志那都比古神，树木之神久久能智神，山神大山津见神，原野之神鹿屋野比卖神，又名野椎神，大山津见神和野椎神又生下了掌管土地、雾气、山谷的许多神。他们还生下了一位叫作“鸟之石楠船”的神，又叫天鸟船，是诸神乘坐的船；又生下了掌管食物的大宜都比卖。有的名字一长串，读起来就像是在点数天地间的万物：石头、门户、屋顶、海浪、水沫、雾气、山谷……世界就这样一样样有了自己的神灵。可是，在这一连串的诞生之后，等待着他们的却是一场灾祸。

Having borne the lands, Izanagi and Izanami went on to bear deities, and the text records each name: Oho-koto-oshi-wo, Iha-tsuchi-biko, Iha-su-hime, Oho-to-hi-wake, Ame-no-fuki-wo, Oho-ya-biko, Kaza-mo-tsu-wake-no-oshi-wo; the great sea deity Oho-wata-tsu-mi; the river-mouth deities Haya-aki-tsu-hiko and Haya-aki-tsu-hime, who in turn bore deities of foam and of the water's surface; the wind deity Shina-tsu-hiko, the tree deity Kuku-no-chi, the great mountain deity Oho-yama-tsu-mi and the moor goddess Kaya-nu-hime, also called Nu-dzu-chi, who together bore deities of earth, mist and valleys. They bore the Bird's Rock-Camphor-Boat, also called the Heavenly Bird-Boat, and the food goddess Oho-ge-tsu-hime. Some names are very long, so that the list reads like a counting of everything in heaven and earth: rocks, doorways, roofs, waves, foam, mist, valleys. So, thing by thing, the world received its deities. But at the end of this long run of births a calamity was waiting.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第六节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.06
07

火神之火The fire deity

最后，伊邪那美生下了火之迦具土神，也叫火之夜艺速男神、火之炫毘古神。因为生下了火神，她的阴部被烧伤，从此一病不起。她在病中呕吐，从呕吐物中生出了金山毘古神和金山毘卖神，也就是金属之神；从粪便中生出了波迩夜须毘古神和波迩夜须毘卖神，也就是黏土之神；从尿中生出了水神弥都波能卖神，以及和久产巢日神，和久产巢日神的女儿就是掌管食物的丰宇气毘卖神。即使在病痛之中，她的身体也还在不停地生出新的神来：金属、黏土、水和五谷，都是从这位垂死的母神身上来的。可是终于，伊邪那美因为生下火神而离开了人世——《古事记》用的说法是“神避”，也就是神的隐去。书中总结说，伊邪那岐与伊邪那美一起生下的岛屿共十四个，神共三十五位。创造了国土和万物之神的母亲，就这样因为生下火而死去，这是《古事记》里第一次出现死亡。

Last of all Izanami bore the fire deity Kagutsuchi, also called Hi-no-yagi-haya-wo and Hi-no-kaga-biko. In bearing this child her private parts were burned, and she lay down sick. From her vomit were born Kana-yama-biko and Kana-yama-bime, deities of metal; from her dung, Hani-yasu-biko and Hani-yasu-bime, deities of clay; from her urine, the water goddess Mitsu-ha-no-me and Waku-musubi, whose daughter is Toyo-uke-bime, goddess of food. Even in sickness her body went on bringing forth deities: metal, clay, water and grain all came from the dying mother. But at last, because she had borne the fire deity, Izanami divinely retired — the Kojiki's word for her passing away. The text sums up that together the pair had borne fourteen islands and thirty-five deities. So the mother of the lands and their deities dies from giving birth to fire; it is the first death in the Kojiki.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第六节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.07
08

哀哭与斩杀火神Mourning and the slaying of the fire deity

伊邪那岐悲痛地说：我亲爱的妹妹啊，我怎么能用你换来这一个孩子！他匍匐在伊邪那美的枕边和脚边痛哭，从他的眼泪里生出了一位女神，叫作泣泽女神，住在香山下的畝尾木本。伊邪那岐把伊邪那美安葬在出云国与伯伎国交界的比婆山上。接着，他拔出佩带的十拳剑，砍下了儿子迦具土神的头。剑尖上溅出的血落在岩石上，生出了石拆神、根拆神和石筒之男神；剑锷附近的血溅出来，生出了甕速日神、樋速日神和建御雷之男神，也就是后来降服出云的建御雷神；从剑柄上滴下、从指缝间漏出的血，又生出了暗淤加美神和暗御津羽神两位山谷之水的神。从迦具土神被砍杀的身体各处——头、胸、腹、阴部、左右手、左右脚——又生出了八位山神。伊邪那岐用来斩杀火神的这把剑，名叫天之尾羽张，又名伊都之尾羽张。

Izanagi cried: 'Oh my beloved younger sister! That I should have exchanged you for this single child!' He crept weeping round her pillow and her feet, and from his tears was born the goddess Naki-sawa-me, who dwells at the foot of the trees on the hill of Unewo by Mount Kagu. He buried Izanami on Mount Hiba on the border of Izumo and Hahaki. Then he drew the ten-grasp sword at his side and cut off the head of his son Kagutsuchi. The blood on the point of the sword splashed on the rocks and became Iha-saku, Ne-saku and Iha-tsutsu-no-wo; the blood near the guard became Mika-haya-bi, Hi-haya-bi and Take-mika-dzu-chi-no-wo, the Takemikazuchi who will later bring Izumo to submission; the blood dripping from the hilt through his fingers became Kura-okami and Kura-mitsu-ha, deities of the valley waters. From Kagutsuchi's head, chest, belly, loins, hands and feet eight mountain deities were born. The sword was named Ame-no-wo-ha-bari, also Itsu-no-wo-ha-bari.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第七至八节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.08
09

黄泉：不要看我Yomi: do not look at me

伊邪那岐思念妻子，追到了黄泉国。伊邪那美从宫殿紧闭的门里出来迎接他，伊邪那岐就隔着门对她说：我亲爱的妹妹啊，我和你一起造的国土还没有完成，请你回来吧！伊邪那美说：可惜你没有早一点来。我已经吃了黄泉灶火煮的食物——这句话的意思是，她已经属于黄泉了。不过，既然我亲爱的哥哥特意来了，我想回去。我要去和黄泉的神商量一下。在这期间，请你千万不要看我。她说完回到殿里，过了很久都没有出来。伊邪那岐等不下去了，他折下插在左边发髻上的多齿梳子的一根边齿，点起火来，走进殿里察看。只见伊邪那美的身上爬满了蛆虫，八位雷神盘踞在她身上：头上是大雷，胸口是火雷，腹部是黑雷，阴部是拆雷，左手是若雷，右手是土雷，左脚是鸣雷，右脚是伏雷。这就是后来故事里所说的“黄泉八雷神”。

Wishing to see his wife again, Izanagi followed her to the Land of Yomi. She came out to meet him from the closed door of the palace. 'My beloved younger sister,' he said, 'the lands that you and I were making are not yet finished. Come back!' She answered: 'Alas that you did not come sooner! I have eaten of the food of the furnace of Yomi. Yet since my beloved elder brother has come, I wish to return; I will discuss it with the deities of Yomi. Do not look at me.' She went back in and stayed so long that he could not wait. He broke off an end tooth of the comb in the left bunch of his hair, lit it, and went in. Maggots were swarming over her, and eight thunder deities had been born on her body: Great-Thunder on her head, Fire-Thunder on her breast, Black-Thunder on her belly, Crack-Thunder below, Young-Thunder on her left hand, Earth-Thunder on her right, Sounding-Thunder on her left foot and Reclining-Thunder on her right.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第九节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.09
10

黄泉丑女与三个桃子The Ugly Females of Yomi and the three peaches

伊邪那岐看见这副情景，吓得转身就逃。伊邪那美说：你让我蒙受了羞辱！她派黄泉丑女去追赶他。伊邪那岐取下头上的黑色发饰扔在身后，发饰立刻变成了葡萄，丑女们停下来捡葡萄吃；吃完了又追上来，他又折下右边发髻上的梳子扔出去，梳子变成了竹笋，丑女们又停下来拔竹笋吃。伊邪那美又派八位雷神，率领一千五百名黄泉的军队来追。伊邪那岐拔出十拳剑，一边在身后挥舞，一边逃跑。追到黄泉比良坂——黄泉与人间交界的山坡——的坡脚下时，他摘下长在那里的三个桃子，向追兵投去，追兵全都逃回去了。伊邪那岐对桃子说：你们帮助了我，以后苇原中国的人们遇到苦难的时候，你们也要像这样帮助他们。他给桃子取名意富加牟豆美命。

Terrified at the sight, Izanagi turned and fled. 'You have put me to shame!' cried Izanami, and sent the Ugly Females of Yomi after him. He threw down his black head-dress, which turned into grapes, and while they stopped to eat he fled on; when they came after him again he broke the comb from the right bunch of his hair and threw it, and it turned into bamboo shoots, which they pulled up and ate. Then she sent the eight thunder deities with fifteen hundred warriors of Yomi. He drew his ten-grasp sword and fled brandishing it behind him. At the foot of the Even Pass of Yomi, the slope between Yomi and the living world, he took three peaches growing there and smote the pursuers with them, and they all fled back. He said to the peaches: 'As you have helped me, so help the people of the Central Land of Reed-Plains when they are in trouble,' and named them Oho-kamu-dzu-mi.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第九节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.10
11

千引石前的诀别Farewell at the thousand-draught rock

最后，伊邪那美亲自追来了。伊邪那岐搬来一块要一千个人才拉得动的大石头——千引石，堵住了黄泉比良坂。两位神隔着石头面对面站着，说出了诀别的话，书中称之为“度事户”，一般理解为宣告断绝夫妻关系的话。伊邪那美说：我亲爱的哥哥，既然你这样做，我就每天把你国家的人勒死一千个。伊邪那岐回答：我亲爱的妹妹，如果你那样做，我就每天建起一千五百座产房。所以，世上每天必定有一千人死去，也必定有一千五百人出生。从此生与死被这块石头隔开，而活着的人总是比死去的多。伊邪那美从此被称为黄泉津大神，又因为她追上了伊邪那岐，也被叫作道敷大神。堵住黄泉坡的那块石头，被称为道反之大神，也叫塞坐黄泉户大神。书中说，所谓黄泉比良坂，就是现在出云国的伊赋夜坂。

Last of all Izanami herself came in pursuit. Izanagi pulled up a rock that would take a thousand men to lift and blocked the Even Pass of Yomi with it. Standing face to face on either side of the rock, they spoke the words of parting, which the text calls the exchange of the door of words, usually understood as a declaration ending the marriage. Izanami said: 'My beloved elder brother, if you do this, I will strangle a thousand of the people of your land every day.' Izanagi answered: 'My beloved younger sister, if you do that, I will set up fifteen hundred birth-houses every day.' That is why a thousand people surely die every day and fifteen hundred are surely born: the rock divides life from death, and the living always outnumber the dead. Izanami was thenceforth called the Great Deity of Yomi, and also the Road-Reaching Great Deity because she had overtaken him. The rock is called the Great Deity of the Road-Turning-Back. The Even Pass of Yomi, the text says, is the pass of Ifuya in Izumo.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第九节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.11
12

禊祓与三贵子Purification and the three noble children

伊邪那岐说：我去了一个丑恶污秽的国家，必须洗净我的身体。他来到筑紫日向的橘之小门的阿波岐原，在河口举行禊祓。他把手杖、腰带、袋子、衣服、裤子、帽子和左右手的手镯一件件扔掉，每扔下一件，就生出一位神，从手杖生出的是冲立船户神，一共生出了十二位神。接着他说：上游水太急，下游水太缓。就走进中游的水里洗身，先生出了由黄泉污秽而来的八十祸津日神和大祸津日神，又生出了纠正灾祸的神直毘神、大直毘神和伊豆能卖神，然后在水底、水中、水面洗涤，生出了三位绵津见神和三位筒之男神。书中说，三位绵津见神是阿昙连一族祭祀的祖神，三位筒之男神是墨江的三位大神。最后，他洗左眼时生出了天照大神，洗右眼时生出了月读命，洗鼻子时生出了建速须佐之男命。故事从这里接到下一部：三位尊贵的孩子即将各自领受父亲的命令。

'I have been to a hideous and polluted land,' said Izanagi, 'so I must purify my body.' He came to the plain of Ahagi by the river-mouth of Tachibana in Himuka in Tsukushi and performed purification. As he threw down his staff, girdle, bag, garment, trousers, hat and the bracelets of each arm, a deity was born of each — from the staff, Tsuki-tatsu-funa-do — twelve in all. Then, saying that the upper waters were too swift and the lower too sluggish, he went down into the middle reach to wash. First were born the two deities of calamity, Ya-so-maga-tsu-bi and Oho-maga-tsu-bi, from the pollution of Yomi; then Kamu-nahobi, Oho-nahobi and Idzu-no-me to set the calamity right; then, as he washed at the bottom, in the middle and on the surface of the water, three Wata-tsu-mi deities and three Tsutsu-no-wo deities. The text adds that the three Wata-tsu-mi are the ancestral deities worshipped by the Adzumi clan, and the three Tsutsu-no-wo the three great deities of Suminoe. Last, as he washed his left eye, Amaterasu was born; his right eye, Tsukuyomi; his nose, Take-haya-Susanoo. The story passes here to the next part, where the three noble children receive their father's charge.

Evidence / 证据《古事记》张伯伦译本第十节。claim.v0350.kojiki_izanagi.12

01

天浮桥上的长矛A spear from the Floating Bridge

天上的众神命令伊邪那岐和伊邪那美去巩固还在漂浮的大地，并交给他们一支镶玉的天沼矛。两神站在天浮桥上，把矛伸进海里搅动；提起矛时，矛尖滴下的盐水层层堆积，成了淤能碁吕岛。

The heavenly deities command Izanagi and Izanami to make firm the drifting land and give them a jewelled spear. Standing on the Floating Bridge of Heaven, they stir the brine; when they lift the spear, the drops from its tip pile up into Onogoro Island.

Evidence / 证据张伯伦译本第三节（kj010）。claim.v0310.japan.onogoro_result《日本书纪》说两神是自己决定动手，本版不合并。
02

火神出生The birth of the fire deity

两神结合，生出许多岛屿和神灵。可是伊邪那美生下火神时被烧伤，病倒在床，最终“神去”——也就是死去。

Joined together, the pair bring forth islands and deities. But when Izanami gives birth to the Deity-of-Fire she is burned, falls sick, and at length 'divinely retires' — she dies.

Evidence / 证据张伯伦译本第七节（kj014）。claim.v0310.japan.izanami_death
03

追到黄泉Following her to Yomi

伊邪那岐想再见到妻子，便追到黄泉，请她回去：“我们造的国土还没有完成。”伊邪那美回答：你来得太晚了，我已经吃了黄泉灶火煮的东西——不过她答应去和黄泉的神商量。

Longing to see her, Izanagi follows Izanami to Yomi and asks her to come back, for the lands they made are not yet finished. She answers that he has come too late: she has already eaten from the hearth of Yomi — yet she agrees to consult the deities there.

Evidence / 证据张伯伦译本第九节（kj016）。claim.v0310.japan.izanagi_yomi之后的逃离情节可参看本库“黄泉中的八雷神”故事。
04

洗出三位贵神Three deities born of washing

伊邪那岐回来后在水中洗净自己，身上不断化生出神。最后，他洗左眼时生出天照大神，洗右眼时生出月读，洗鼻子时生出须佐之男。

Back from Yomi, Izanagi bathes to purify himself, and deities are born as he washes. Last of all, washing his left eye brings forth Amaterasu, his right eye Tsukuyomi, and his nose Susanoo.

Evidence / 证据张伯伦译本第十节（kj017）及译注。claim.v0310.japan.tsukuyomi_born三神的通行名称来自译者注释。

北欧 / Norse

华纳神族：尼奥尔德、弗雷与芙蕾雅Njörðr, Freyr and Freyja — the Vanir family

尼奥尔德住在诺欧通，掌管风和海，原本在华纳海姆长大，作为人质来到阿萨神族。他的儿子弗雷掌管雨水、阳光和丰收；女儿芙蕾雅住在弗尔克范格，每次出征都分走一半战死者，乘坐两只猫拉的车。弗雷后来为了娶葛德，交出了自己的宝剑。

Njörðr lives at Nóatún and rules wind and sea; raised in Vanaheim, he came to the Æsir as a hostage. His son Freyr rules rain, sunshine and harvests; his daughter Freyja lives at Fólkvangr, takes half the slain and drives a chariot pulled by two cats. Later Freyr gives away his sword to win Gerðr.

01

海风之神尼奥尔德Njörðr of wind and sea

尼奥尔德住在天上一个叫诺欧通的地方。他掌管风的运行，能平息海浪和火焰；出海航行和捕鱼的人都向他祈祷。他在华纳海姆长大，后来作为人质被送到阿萨神族。

Njörðr lives in heaven at a place called Nóatún. He rules the motion of the wind and can calm sea and fire; those who sail or fish pray to him. He was raised in Vanaheim and later given to the Æsir as a hostage.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第23章。claim.v0310.norse.njord_wind_sea
02

弗雷与芙蕾雅Freyr and Freyja

尼奥尔德有一儿一女。儿子弗雷掌管雨水、阳光和大地的收成，人们向他祈求丰年与富足。女儿芙蕾雅住在弗尔克范格，每当她骑马出战，就分得一半战死者，另一半归奥丁；她乘坐的车由两只猫拉着。

Njörðr has a son and a daughter. Freyr rules rain, sunshine and the produce of the earth, and people pray to him for good seasons and wealth. Freyja lives at Fólkvangr; whenever she rides to battle she takes half the slain, Odin the other half, and her chariot is drawn by two cats.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第24章。claim.v0310.norse.freyja_slain
03

弗雷交出宝剑Freyr gives away his sword

后来，弗雷爱上了巨人之女葛德。为了娶到她，他把自己的宝剑交给了别人作为代价——这把剑从此不在他手中。

Later Freyr falls in love with Gerðr, a giant's daughter. To win her he gives away his sword as the price, and the sword is no longer his.

北欧 / Norse

提尔的手：束缚芬里尔Týr's hand and the binding of Fenrir

提尔是众神中最勇敢的一位。众神要捆住越长越大的狼芬里尔，狼要求有人把手放进它嘴里作担保。只有提尔伸出了右手；当狼发现自己挣脱不开，就咬断了他的手。所以提尔只有一只手。

Týr is the boldest of the gods. When they set out to bind the growing wolf Fenrir, the wolf demands a hand in its mouth as a pledge. Only Týr offers his right hand; when the wolf finds it cannot break free, it bites the hand off — and so Týr is one-handed.

北欧 / Norse

海姆达尔：众神的守望者Heimdallr, watchman of the gods

海姆达尔住在彩虹桥边的希敏约格，替众神守着桥，防备山巨人。他睡得比鸟还少，夜里能看见一百里远，连草和羊毛生长的声音都听得见。他有一支加拉尔号角，吹响时所有世界都能听到。人们还说他是九位姐妹母亲的儿子。

He needs less sleep than a bird, sees a hundred leagues by night, and hears grass and wool growing. His horn Gjallarhorn can be heard in all worlds, and he is called the son of nine mothers who were sisters.

北欧 / Norse

尤弥尔与世界的形成Ymir and the shaping of the world

太初有一道深渊，北方的寒霜遇到南方的热气，化出巨人尤弥尔。后来奥丁和他的兄弟维利、维杀死了尤弥尔，用他的身体造出世界：肉成了大地，血成了海洋和湖泊，骨头成了山石，头骨成了天空。

In the beginning there is a great void where rime from the north meets heat from the south, and from it the giant Ymir arises. Later Odin and his brothers Vili and Vé kill Ymir and build the world from his body: his flesh becomes the earth, his blood the sea and lakes, his bones the rocks, his skull the sky.

01

冰与火之间Between ice and fire

世界还不存在时，只有一道叫金伦加的深渊。北方的寒霜与南方的热气在这里相遇，融化的水滴里生出了巨人尤弥尔。

Before the world exists there is only the void of Ginnungagap. Where rime from the north meets heat from the south, the thawing drops bring forth the giant Ymir.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第5章。claim.v0310.norse.ymir_origin
02

奥丁兄弟杀死尤弥尔Odin and his brothers kill Ymir

布尔的儿子们——奥丁、维利和维——杀死了巨人尤弥尔。

The sons of Borr — Odin, Vili and Vé — kill the giant Ymir.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第7章。claim.v0310.norse.odin_kills_ymir
03

用身体造世界A world made from a body

他们用尤弥尔的身体造出世界：肉变成大地，血变成海洋和湖泊，骨头变成山岩，头骨被举起来成为天空。

From Ymir's body they make the world: his flesh becomes the earth, his blood the sea and lakes, his bones the rocks, and his skull is raised up as the sky.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第8章。claim.v0310.norse.ymir_world斯诺里的散文综述与诗歌见证可能有细节差异。

北欧 / Norse

弗丽嘉的誓言与巴德尔之死Frigg's oaths and the death of Baldr

弗丽嘉是奥丁的妻子，知道一切命运。她的儿子巴德尔梦见自己有危险，她便让火、水、金属、石头、草木和野兽都发誓不伤害他——唯独漏掉了一株幼小的槲寄生。巴德尔最后正是被槲寄生杀死的。

Frigg, Odin's wife, knows all fates. When her son Baldr dreams of danger, she makes fire, water, metals, stones, plants and beasts swear not to harm him — all except a young shoot of mistletoe. In the end it is mistletoe that kills Baldr.

01

不祥的梦Ominous dreams

奥丁的儿子巴德尔是众神中最好的一位，人人都称赞他。他容貌俊美、光彩照人，有一种最白的花就因为像他的睫毛那样白，被人们称作“巴德尔的睫毛”。他是阿萨神族中最聪明、最善于言辞、最仁慈的神，可是他的判决却从来不能实现。这一天，巴德尔做了几个可怕的梦，梦见自己的性命将要遭到危险。他把这些梦告诉了阿萨众神，众神聚在一起商议，最后决定：要为巴德尔求得一切东西的保护，使他免受任何伤害。

Baldr, Odin's son, is the best of the gods and all praise him; so fair and bright that the whitest flower is called Baldr's brow. He is the wisest, most eloquent and most merciful of the Æsir, though none of his judgements can be fulfilled. Then Baldr dreamed great and perilous dreams threatening his life, and when he told the Æsir they took counsel together and resolved to ask protection for him from every kind of danger.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.01
02

万物的誓言The oaths of all things

于是弗丽嘉出发，让世间万物都立下誓言，不伤害巴德尔：火与水、铁和各种金属、石头、泥土、树木、疾病、走兽、飞鸟、毒物和蛇，全都发了誓。这件事办成之后，众神都放下心来，并且以此为乐：巴德尔站在集会的场地中央，其他的神有的向他射箭，有的用刀剑砍他，有的向他扔石头，可是无论做什么都伤不了他。众神都认为这是一件了不起的荣耀。

Frigg took oaths that they would not harm Baldr from fire and water, iron and every metal, stones, the earth, trees, sicknesses, beasts, birds, poison and snakes. When this was done it became a sport of the Æsir: Baldr would stand in the assembly while some shot at him, some struck at him and some threw stones, and nothing harmed him. They all thought it a great honour.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.02
03

槲寄生The mistletoe

劳菲之子洛基看见这一切，心里很不高兴，因为巴德尔毫发无伤。他变成一个女人，来到弗丽嘉住的芬萨利尔宫。弗丽嘉问这位女子：你知道阿萨众神在集会上做什么吗？女人说：他们都在朝巴德尔射箭、扔东西，可是什么也伤不了他。弗丽嘉说：不论是兵器还是木头，都伤不了巴德尔，因为我已经让万物都立了誓。女人问：真的万物都向你发誓不伤害巴德尔了吗？弗丽嘉答道：在瓦尔哈拉的西边，长着一棵小小的树苗，叫作槲寄生。我觉得它太年幼了，就没有让它发誓。那女人听了便走了。洛基找到槲寄生，把它拔下来，带到集会的地方去。

Loki Laufeyjarson was displeased that Baldr took no harm. He went to Frigg at Fensalir in the likeness of a woman. Frigg told the stranger that neither weapons nor trees would harm Baldr, for she had taken oaths of all things. Had everything sworn? asked the woman. Frigg answered that a young shoot grew west of Valhöll called mistletoe, which seemed too young to ask for an oath. The woman went away; Loki took the mistletoe, pulled it up and went to the assembly.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.03
04

盲眼的霍德尔Blind Höðr

霍德尔站在人圈的外面，因为他是瞎子。洛基走过去问他：你为什么不朝巴德尔扔东西？霍德尔说：因为我看不见巴德尔在哪里，而且我也没有武器。洛基说：你也该像别人一样向巴德尔表示敬意。我来给你指方向，你把这根树枝向他扔去吧。霍德尔接过槲寄生，照着洛基的指引朝巴德尔扔去。树枝穿透了巴德尔的身体，他倒在地上死了。斯诺里说：这是神和人所遭遇的最大不幸。

Höðr stood at the edge of the ring, for he was blind. Loki asked why he did not shoot at Baldr. Because I cannot see where he is, said Höðr, and I have no weapon. Loki said he should honour Baldr like the others, and offered to show him where Baldr stood. Höðr took the mistletoe and threw it as Loki directed; it pierced Baldr and he fell dead to the earth. It was, says Snorri, the greatest misfortune ever to befall gods and men.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.04
05

说不出话的众神The speechless gods

巴德尔倒下的时候，阿萨众神都说不出话来，双手也失去了力气，不能把他扶起。他们彼此相望，心里都知道是谁干了这件事，却不能在那里报仇，因为那是一处圣地。他们想说话的时候，涌出的只有泪水，没有一个神能把自己的悲痛告诉别人。在所有的神中，奥丁最承受不住这个打击，因为他最明白，巴德尔的死对阿萨众神意味着多大的损失与毁灭。

When Baldr fell, the Æsir were struck dumb and their hands failed them to lift him. Each looked at the other, all of one mind about who had done the deed, but no vengeance could be taken there, for it was a place of great sanctuary. When they tried to speak, weeping came first, and none could tell the others his grief. Odin bore the loss worst of all, for he best understood how great a loss and ruin Baldr's death was for the Æsir.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.05
06

谁愿意去冥界Who will ride to Hel?

众神稍稍平静之后，弗丽嘉开口问道：阿萨神族中有谁愿意赢得我全部的爱与恩宠，骑马走上通往冥界的路，去找赫尔，问她要多少赎金才肯让巴德尔回到阿斯加德？奥丁的儿子、勇敢的赫尔莫德说他愿意去。于是众神牵来奥丁的八足骏马斯莱布尼尔，交给赫尔莫德。他跃上马背，向冥界疾驰而去。这是众神在巨大的悲痛中想到的唯一办法：如果冥界的女王肯收下赎金，巴德尔也许还能回来。赫尔莫德的马蹄声远去了，而留在阿斯加德的众神，还要先为巴德尔送行。

When the gods came to themselves, Frigg asked who among the Æsir would win all her love and favour by riding the road to Hel to find Baldr and offer Hel a ransom to let him come home to Ásgarðr. Hermóðr the Bold, Odin's son, undertook the journey. Odin's horse Sleipnir was led out, and Hermóðr mounted and galloped away.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.06
07

灵钟号与火葬Hringhorni and the pyre

阿萨众神抬起巴德尔的尸体，送到海边。巴德尔的船叫作“灵钟号”，是所有船中最大的一艘，众神想把它推下海，在船上为巴德尔举行火葬，可是船纹丝不动。他们只好派人到巨人之国去请一个名叫希罗金的女巨人来帮忙。她骑着一头狼来了，用毒蛇作缰绳。她跳下狼背，奥丁叫四个狂战士看住那头狼，他们只能把它摔倒才制服它。希罗金走到船头，只一推就把船推下了海，船底的滚木冒出火花，大地都颤抖起来。索尔大怒，握住锤子要打碎她的头，众神都为她求情，他才住手。巴德尔的遗体被抬上船，他的妻子南娜看见了，悲痛得心都碎了，当场死去，也被放上柴堆一起焚烧。索尔站在火堆前用妙尔尼尔为它祝圣，一个名叫利特的矮人从他脚前跑过，索尔一脚把他踢进了火里。奥丁把金环德罗普尼尔放在柴堆上，巴德尔的马也带着全套马具被送上火堆。

The Æsir carried Baldr's body to the sea. His ship Hringhorni was the greatest of all ships, but they could not launch it, so they sent to Jötunheimr for the giantess Hyrrokkin, who came riding a wolf with vipers for reins. Four berserks could hold the wolf only by knocking it down. She pushed the ship off with one shove, so that fire flew from the rollers and the earth shook; Thor would have smashed her head had the gods not begged for her. When Baldr was laid on board, his wife Nanna's heart burst with grief, and she was laid on the pyre with him. Thor hallowed the pyre with Mjöllnir and kicked the dwarf Litr into the flames; Odin laid the ring Draupnir on the pyre, and Baldr's horse was burned with all its harness.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.07
08

九夜的骑行Nine nights' ride

赫尔莫德骑着马走了九天九夜，穿过幽深黑暗的山谷，什么也看不见，直到来到冥河耶尔河边，骑上了铺着闪亮黄金的耶尔桥。守桥的少女名叫莫德古德，她问他的名字和家族，说：昨天有五队死人从这座桥上过去，可是桥被你一个人震得比他们全体还响；而且你的脸色不像死人。你为什么骑马走在通往冥界的路上？赫尔莫德说：我要去冥界找巴德尔。你有没有在路上见过他？莫德古德说：巴德尔已经骑马过了耶尔桥。通往冥界的路，就在下面，往北边去。

For nine nights Hermóðr rode through dark, deep valleys where he could see nothing, until he came to the river Gjöll and rode onto the Gjallarbrú, roofed with gleaming gold. The maiden who guarded the bridge, Móðguðr, asked his name and lineage: the day before, five companies of dead men had ridden over, yet the bridge thundered more under him alone, and he did not have the colour of the dead. He said he was riding to Hel to seek Baldr; she told him Baldr had crossed the bridge, and that the road to Hel lay downward and to the north.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.08
09

赫尔的条件Hel's condition

赫尔莫德一路骑到冥界的大门前，他跳下马，把马肚带勒紧，重新上马，用马刺一踢，骏马高高跃起，从大门上方越了过去，一点也没碰到。他骑到大殿前下了马，走进去，看见他的哥哥巴德尔坐在高座上。赫尔莫德在那里过了一夜。第二天早晨，他请求赫尔让巴德尔和他一起骑马回家，并告诉她阿萨众神为巴德尔哭得多么伤心。赫尔说：我要看看巴德尔是不是真的像人们说的那样受到爱戴。如果世上的一切东西，活的和死的，都为他哭泣，他就可以回到阿萨众神那里；可是只要有一样东西反对、不肯哭泣，他就得留在冥界。赫尔莫德起身告辞，巴德尔送他出殿，把金环德罗普尼尔交给他，让他带回去给奥丁作纪念；南娜也送给弗丽嘉一块亚麻头巾和其他礼物，还送给弗丽嘉的侍女富拉一枚金指环。

At Hel's gate Hermóðr dismounted, tightened the girth, remounted and spurred Sleipnir, who leapt clean over the gate. In the hall he saw his brother Baldr in the seat of honour, and stayed the night. In the morning he asked Hel to let Baldr ride home, telling of the gods' grief. Hel said she would test whether Baldr was as beloved as they said: if all things in the world, alive and dead, wept for him, he would return to the Æsir; but if any refused to weep, he would stay with Hel. Baldr gave Hermóðr the ring Draupnir to take to Odin as a keepsake, and Nanna sent Frigg a linen kerchief and Fulla a gold ring.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.09
10

万物都在哭泣All things weep

赫尔莫德骑马回到阿斯加德，把他的所见所闻原原本本地告诉了众神。于是阿萨众神派出使者走遍全世界，请求万物为巴德尔哭泣，好让他从冥界回来。万物都哭了：人和动物、大地和石头、树木和各种金属都哭了——斯诺里说，就像你看见这些东西从严寒中被拿到温暖的地方时，身上会凝出水珠来一样。使者们走遍了天上和人间，所到之处，没有一样东西不在流泪。众神满怀希望，以为巴德尔就要回来了。可是，就在使者们办完差事、踏上归途的时候，他们经过了一个山洞——

Hermóðr rode back and told all he had seen and heard. The Æsir sent messengers throughout the world asking that Baldr be wept out of Hel. All things did so — men and beasts, the earth and stones, trees and every metal — as you will have seen these things weep when they come out of frost into warmth.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.10
11

不肯流泪的女巨人The giantess who would not weep

使者们完成了使命，正在回家的路上，看见一个山洞里坐着一个女巨人，她自称叫作索克。他们请她也为巴德尔哭泣，让他从冥界回来。她回答说：索克要流干的眼泪，为巴德尔的火葬哭泣。不论他是活着还是死了，我从这老头的儿子身上什么好处也没得到。让赫尔留着她已经得到的吧！人们都认为，这个女巨人就是劳菲之子洛基变的，他给阿萨众神带来了最多的灾祸。巴德尔就这样留在了冥界。

As the messengers were returning, having done their errand well, they found a giantess sitting in a cave who called herself Þökk. They asked her to weep Baldr out of Hel. She answered: Þökk will weep dry tears for Baldr's burning; alive or dead, the old man's son was no use to me — let Hel keep what she has. Men believe she was Loki Laufeyjarson, who had done the Æsir the most harm. And so Baldr remained in Hel.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第49章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.11斯诺里说“人们认为”索克就是洛基，这是传统中的认定，不是故事中直接揭穿的情节。
12

鲑鱼与网The salmon and the net

众神对洛基怒不可遏，洛基逃到一座山上，盖了一间有四扇门的房子，好向四面八方都能看见。白天他常常变成一条鲑鱼，躲进法拉南格瀑布里。他坐在屋里想：阿萨众神会用什么办法来抓瀑布里的鲑鱼呢？他拿起亚麻线，像人们后来做网那样结了一张网。这时他看见众神已经来到不远处，奥丁从高座上望见了他的藏身之处。洛基赶快把网扔进火里烧掉，跳进河中。最聪明的神克瓦西尔第一个走进屋里，看见火中网的灰烬，明白这是捕鱼的工具，众神就照着灰烬的样子结了一张网。他们来到瀑布边撒网，索尔握住一头，其余的神握住另一头。洛基几次从网下、从网上逃脱，最后一次他想跳过网逃向大海，索尔在空中一把抓住了他，他滑溜溜地往外挣，索尔紧紧捏住他的尾巴——据说正因为这样，鲑鱼的尾巴才变得那么细。

The gods were so angry that Loki fled and built a house with four doors on a mountain so he could watch every way, and by day he often hid as a salmon in the Fránangr falls. Wondering how the gods might catch him, he knotted linen into a net — the first net — and when he saw the gods coming, threw it in the fire and leapt into the river. Kvasir, wisest of the gods, saw the shape of the net in the ashes, and they made one like it. Dragging the falls with Thor at one end, they drove Loki until he tried to leap over the net; Thor caught him in mid-air and held him by the tail, which is why the salmon tapers at the tail.

Evidence / 证据《欺骗古鲁菲》第50章。claim.v0320.baldr_long.12
13

洛基的惩罚The punishment of Loki

众神把洛基带进一个山洞，竖起三块扁石，在每块石头上钻一个洞。他们抓来洛基的两个儿子瓦利和纳尔维，把瓦利变成一匹狼，狼把他的兄弟撕成了碎片。众神用纳尔维的肠子把洛基捆在三块石头上：一块抵着肩膀，一块抵着腰，一块抵着膝盖窝，那些肠子随后变成了铁。斯卡蒂拿来一条毒蛇，挂在洛基的头上方，让蛇的毒液滴在他脸上。洛基的妻子西格恩站在他身旁，手里捧着一只碗接住毒液；碗满了，她就走开去倒掉，这时毒液就滴在洛基的脸上，他痛得猛烈挣扎，整个大地都随之颤抖——这就是人们所说的地震。洛基就这样被捆着，一直躺到诸神的黄昏来临。

The gods took Loki into a cave, set up three slabs on edge and bored a hole in each. They took his sons Váli and Nari (or Narfi); Váli was turned into a wolf and tore his brother apart, and with Nari's entrails they bound Loki over the stones — one under his shoulders, one under his loins, one under the backs of his knees — and the bonds became iron. Skaði hung a venomous snake above him so that its poison dripped onto his face. His wife Sigyn stands by holding a bowl under the venom, and when the bowl is full she goes to empty it; then the venom drips on his face and he shudders so violently that the whole earth shakes — what men call earthquakes. There he lies bound until Ragnarök.

科阿特利库埃在蛇山打扫时，一团羽毛飘落，她把它塞在腰间，因此怀孕。女儿科约尔沙乌基认为这是耻辱，带着四百个兄弟要杀死母亲。就在他们冲上山顶时，维齐洛波奇特利全副武装地出生，砍下科约尔沙乌基的头，把兄弟们赶散。

As they reach the summit, Huitzilopochtli is born fully armed, beheads Coyolxauhqui and scatters the brothers.

《佛罗伦萨手抄本》第三卷讲述图拉的大法师羽蛇神。巫师们来到他身边，其中一位叫蒂特拉卡瓦，也就是特斯卡特利波卡；他们带来的种种征兆让羽蛇神的荣光走向终结。羽蛇神离开时，随行的人在两座雪山之间冻死。

墨西卡 / Mexica

一座金字塔上的两位神：大神庙Two gods on one pyramid — the Templo Mayor

特诺奇蒂特兰的大神庙顶上并立着两座神殿：南边供奉太阳战神、墨西加人的守护神维齐洛波奇特利，北边供奉与农业相连的雨神特拉洛克。墨西哥国家人类学与历史研究所说，神庙始建于1325年，此后多次重建与扩建。

Atop the Templo Mayor of Tenochtitlan stood two shrines: on the south, Huitzilopochtli, solar god of war and patron of the Mexica; on the north, Tlaloc, god of rain linked to agriculture. INAH says the first small temple was built at the city's founding in 1325 and was rebuilt and enlarged many times.

玛雅 / Maya

石头、陶盘与文字中的三位玛雅神Three Maya gods in stone, clay and glyph

三份独立见证，各讲一位玛雅神：奇琴伊察的卡斯蒂略金字塔又叫“库库尔坎神庙”；大都会博物馆的一只陶盘上，雨神恰克半身浸在水中；同一博物馆的展览介绍年老的天神伊察姆纳和他的鸟形化身。三份见证分开阅读，不拼成一个统一神话。

Three separate witnesses, one god each: Chichen-Itza's El Castillo is also called the Temple of Kukulkan; a Met plate shows the rain god Chahk waist-deep in water; and a Met exhibition presents the aged sky god Itzamnaaj and his bird avatar. They are read separately, not stitched into one myth.

中国上古神话 / Ancient Chinese

伏羲始作八卦Fuxi makes the eight trigrams

《周易·系辞下》说：古时包牺氏（伏羲）治理天下，他抬头观察天象，低头观察地理，看鸟兽身上的纹理和各地的物产，近取自身、远取万物，于是开始画出八卦；他又把绳子打结做成网，用来打猎捕鱼。

The Xi Ci II says that when Baoxi (Fuxi) ruled in antiquity, he looked up at heaven and down at the earth, studied the markings of birds and beasts and the land, drew on his own body and on distant things, and first made the eight trigrams; he also knotted cords into nets for hunting and fishing.

01

包牺氏治理天下When Baoxi ruled the world

《系辞下》讲古代圣人的发明，第一位就是包牺氏——后世通常写作伏羲。书里说，远古的时候，是他在治理天下。

Xi Ci II lists the inventions of the ancient sages, and the first is Baoxi — usually written Fuxi in later texts. In remote antiquity, it says, he ruled all under heaven.

Evidence / 证据《系辞下》第二章开头。claim.v0310.china.fuxi_baoxi“包牺”即“伏羲”是传统注疏的读法。
02

仰观天，俯察地Looking up, looking down

他抬头观察天上的日月星辰，低头观察大地的形势；又细看鸟兽身上的花纹，看各地适合生长什么。近处，他从自己的身体取法；远处，他从万物取法。

He looked up at the images in the sky and down at the patterns of the earth; he studied the markings of birds and beasts and what each land was suited for. Near at hand he drew on his own body, and far off on all things.

Evidence / 证据《系辞下》第二章。claim.v0310.china.fuxi_observes
03

画出八卦The first eight trigrams

于是他开始画出八卦——八个由三条线组成的符号，用来通达神明的德性，把万物的情状分门别类。

Thereupon he first made the eight trigrams — eight figures of three lines each — to communicate with spirit-like virtue and to sort the dispositions of the myriad things.

Evidence / 证据《系辞下》第二章“于是始作八卦”。claim.v0310.china.fuxi_bagua
04

他还把绳子打结，做成罗网，人们用它打猎、捕鱼。《系辞》接下来再讲神农等后来的圣人，这里只讲伏羲这一段。

He also knotted cords into nets, which people used to hunt and fish. The Xi Ci then moves on to later sages such as Shennong; this retelling covers only Baoxi's part.

中国上古神话 / Ancient Chinese

黄帝战蚩尤：涿鹿之战The Yellow Emperor and Chiyou at Zhuolu

《史记·五帝本纪》说：神农氏衰落，诸侯互相攻伐，轩辕操练军队征讨不服者。蚩尤最为暴虐，作乱不听帝命。轩辕征召诸侯之兵，在涿鹿的原野擒杀蚩尤，诸侯于是尊他为天子，这就是黄帝。

The Shiji's Annals of the Five Emperors say that as Shennong's house declined and the lords fought one another, Xuanyuan trained troops. Chiyou, the most violent, rebelled against the ruler's command; Xuanyuan levied the lords' armies, captured and killed him in the wilds of Zhuolu, and was honoured as Son of Heaven — the Yellow Emperor.

黄帝是少典的儿子，姓公孙，名轩辕。他那个时代，神农氏的统治衰落了，诸侯互相攻打、欺压百姓，神农氏却无力征讨。轩辕于是操练军队，去讨伐不肯朝贡的诸侯。

中国上古神话 / Ancient Chinese

盘古开天地：《三五历纪》佚文Pangu between heaven and earth

三国吴人徐整的《三五历纪》已经失传，只在后世类书中留有引文。《艺文类聚》卷一引它说：天地未分时混沌如鸡蛋，盘古生在其中；一万八千年后天地开辟，清者为天、浊者为地；天每天高一丈，地每天厚一丈，盘古每天长一丈，又过一万八千年，天极高、地极深、盘古极长。

Xu Zheng's Sanwu liji is lost, surviving only in later encyclopedias. Yiwen leiju juan 1 quotes it: before heaven and earth parted, all was chaos like a hen's egg, and Pangu was born inside; after 18,000 years they opened, clear becoming heaven and murky becoming earth; each day heaven rose a zhang, earth thickened a zhang and Pangu grew a zhang, until after another 18,000 years heaven was highest, earth deepest and Pangu tallest.

清者为天，浊者为地Clear above, murky below

过了一万八千年，天地开辟：轻而清的阳气上升成为天，重而浊的阴气下沉成为地。盘古就在天地之间，一天之中变化九次，比天更神，比地更圣。

After 18,000 years heaven and earth opened: the light, clear yang rose to become heaven, the heavy, murky yin sank to become earth. Pangu stood between them, changing nine times a day, more divine than heaven and wiser than earth.

一天长高一丈A zhang a day

从此天每天升高一丈，地每天加厚一丈，盘古也每天长高一丈。这样又过了一万八千年，天高到了极点，地深到了极点，盘古也长到了极点。在这之后，才有了三皇。

From then on heaven rose a zhang each day, earth grew a zhang thicker, and Pangu grew a zhang taller. After another 18,000 years heaven was as high as it could be, earth as deep, and Pangu as tall. Only after that came the Three Sovereigns.

中国民间信仰 / Chinese Folk Religion

哪吒大战孙悟空：《西游记》第四回Nezha against Sun Wukong (Journey to the West, ch. 4)

孙悟空嫌弼马温官小，回花果山自称齐天大圣。托塔李天王与哪吒三太子奉命捉拿。哪吒变出三头六臂，悟空也变三头六臂；悟空拔毫毛变出分身，真身绕到背后打中哪吒，哪吒负痛败走。

Finding his stable post too lowly, Sun Wukong returns home and calls himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven. Heavenly King Li and his third son Nezha are sent to seize him. Nezha takes three heads and six arms; Wukong does the same, then turns a hair into a double and strikes Nezha from behind, and Nezha retreats in pain.

01

天兵来讨Heaven sends its army

孙悟空发现“弼马温”只是个看马的小官，一气之下回到花果山，自称“齐天大圣”。玉帝派托塔李天王和他的三太子哪吒，带领天兵前去捉拿。

Discovering that his title merely made him a keeper of horses, Sun Wukong storms back to his mountain and calls himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven. The Jade Emperor sends Heavenly King Li, bearer of the pagoda, and his third son Nezha with the heavenly troops to seize him.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第四回。claim.v0310.china.nezha_title
02

三头六臂Three heads, six arms

哪吒大喝一声，变成三头六臂，六只手各拿一件兵器打来。悟空见了，也变成三头六臂，把金箍棒一晃变成三条，六只手拿着架住。

Nezha gives a shout and becomes a figure with three heads and six arms, a weapon in every hand. Wukong does the same: he shakes his staff into three and parries with six hands.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第四回。claim.v0310.china.nezha_form
03

毫毛分身A hair becomes a double

两人斗得难分难解。悟空拔下一根毫毛，变成自己的模样继续迎敌，真身却绕到哪吒背后打了一棒。哪吒负痛败走，回去禀报父王：这猴子神通广大。

Neither can win. Wukong plucks a hair and turns it into a double of himself to keep fighting, while his true body circles behind Nezha and strikes. Nezha flees in pain and reports to his father that the monkey's powers are great.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第四回。claim.v0310.china.wukong_defeats_nezha这是小说情节，属于后世文学层。

爱尔兰 / Irish

第二次马格图雷德之战：达格达、莫莉甘、布里格与鲁格The Second Battle of Mag Tuired

中世纪爱尔兰传说《第二次马格图雷德之战》：达格达拥有“没有人吃不饱”的大锅；“百艺之主”鲁格来到塔拉；萨温节时达格达在河边遇见莫莉甘；布里格为战死的儿子哀哭，是爱尔兰第一次听到哀歌；鲁格用投石击毁巴洛尔的毒眼；战后莫莉甘向全爱尔兰宣告胜利。

The medieval Irish saga Cath Maige Tuired: the Dagda's cauldron leaves no one unsatisfied; Lug, master of all arts, comes to Tara; at Samain the Dagda meets the Morrígan by the river; Bríg keens for her slain son, the first keening in Ireland; Lug's sling stone drives Balor's deadly eye through his head; and the Morrígan proclaims the victory across Ireland.

01

达格达的大锅The Dagda's cauldron

达努神族带来了四件宝物，其中一件是从穆里亚斯城带来的达格达的大锅：凡是围着它吃饭的人，从没有一个是不饱足地离开的。

The Túatha Dé Danann brought four treasures. One was the Dagda's cauldron from the city of Murias: no company that ate from it ever went away unsatisfied.

Evidence / 证据Gray 本 §6。claim.v0310.irish.dagda_cauldron
02

百艺之主来到塔拉The master of all arts at Tara

鲁格来到塔拉的大门前，守门人问他会什么手艺。他报出一门又一门，而宫里每门手艺都已有人；最后他问：有没有一个人能同时精通所有这些？于是他以“百艺之主”的身份被请了进去。

Lug comes to the door of Tara, and the doorkeeper asks what art he brings. He names one after another, and each already has a master within — until he asks whether anyone there has all of them at once. So he is admitted as the Samildánach, master of all arts.

Evidence / 证据Gray 本 §§53–72。claim.v0310.irish.lugh_samildanach

萨温节的河边By the river at Samain

萨温节前后，达格达在乌恩辛河边遇见一个女人正在洗东西，一只脚踩在南岸，一只脚踩在北岸。她就是莫莉甘。两人结合之后，她告诉达格达弗魔族将在哪里登陆，并许诺要取弗魔王因德赫的心血。

Around Samain the Dagda meets a woman washing at the river Unshin, one foot on the southern bank and one on the northern. She is the Morrígan. After they unite she tells him where the Fomoire will land and promises to take the heart's blood of their king Indech.

Evidence / 证据Gray 本 §84。claim.v0310.irish.dagda_morrigan
04

第一次哀歌The first keening

布里格是达格达的女儿，她和布雷斯的儿子鲁阿丹被派去刺杀铁匠戈伊布纽，却被戈伊布纽杀死。布里格赶来为儿子哀哭，先是尖声恸哭，最后低声啜泣——这是爱尔兰第一次听到哀歌与哭泣。

Rúadán, son of Bres and of Bríg the Dagda's daughter, is sent to kill the smith Goibniu and is killed instead. Bríg comes and keens for her son, shrieking first and weeping at the end — the first time keening and weeping were heard in Ireland.

The Fomorian champion Balor has a deadly eye, opened only on the battlefield, its lid lifted by four men with a handle. Lug casts a sling stone that drives the eye out through the back of Balor's head, so that it is his own host that looks upon it.

Evidence / 证据Gray 本 §§133–135。claim.v0310.irish.lugh_kills_balor

斯拉夫 / Slavic

基辅山岗上的神像：佩伦与莫科什The idols on the Kyiv hill — Perun and Mokosh

《往年纪事》980 年条：弗拉基米尔在基辅宫殿外的山岗上立起神像——银头金须的木雕佩伦，还有霍尔斯、达日博格、斯特里博格、西马尔格尔和莫科什，人们向它们献祭。988 年他受洗后下令推倒神像，佩伦被绑在马尾上拖下山，丢进第聂伯河。

The Primary Chronicle's annal for 980: Volodimer sets up idols on the hill outside his Kyiv palace — a wooden Perun with a silver head and golden moustache, then Khors, Dazhbog, Stribog, Simargl and Mokosh — and people make offerings to them. After his baptism in 988 he has them cast down; Perun is tied to a horse's tail, dragged down the hill and thrown into the Dnieper.

Evidence / 证据《往年纪事》980 年条。claim.v060.slavic.perun_980_image

名单最后的莫科什Mokosh at the end of the list

琐罗亚斯德传统 / Zoroastrian

广阔牧场之主密特拉：《密赫尔颂》Mithra of the wide pastures — the Mihr Yasht

阿维斯塔第十颂《密赫尔颂》：阿胡拉·马兹达说，他创造密特拉时，使他与自己同样值得祭祀和祈祷；对密特拉说谎、背弃契约的人会给整个国家带来死亡；密特拉有千只耳朵、万只眼睛，在不朽的快马太阳之前最先越过哈拉山。

The Mihr Yasht, tenth hymn of the Avesta: Ahura Mazda says he made Mithra as worthy of sacrifice and prayer as himself; whoever lies to Mithra and breaks the contract brings death to the whole land; Mithra has a thousand ears and ten thousand eyes and is the first god to rise over Mount Hara, before the swift-horsed sun.

夏威夷 / Hawaiian

佩蕾的旅程：从卡希基到哈雷茂茂Pele's journey to Halemaʻumaʻu

美国国家公园管理局概述夏威夷口述传统：火山女神佩蕾生在遥远的卡希基，为寻找适合她的火与家人的居所，远航来到夏威夷群岛，一路向东南迁移，最后在基拉韦厄山顶的哈雷茂茂火山口安家，据说至今仍住在那里。按照夏威夷传统，经过她的土地要先请求许可。

The National Park Service summarizes Hawaiian oral history: the volcano deity Pele was born in distant Kahiki and voyaged to the Hawaiian Islands seeking a home for her fire and family, moving southeast until she settled in Halemaʻumaʻu crater at the summit of Kīlauea, where she is said still to live. In Hawaiian tradition one asks her permission to travel through her land.

一路向东南Island by island to the southeast

她一座岛一座岛地向东南迁移，寻找能安顿下来的地方。

She moved southeast through the islands, one after another, looking for a place to settle.

Evidence / 证据NPS“Pele”页面。claim.v0310.hawaii.pele_southeast各岛上的具体经历因版本而异，本站不补写。
03

哈雷茂茂的家A home in Halemaʻumaʻu

最后她来到基拉韦厄山顶的哈雷茂茂火山口，把这里定为永久的家。据说她至今仍住在那里。

At last she came to Halemaʻumaʻu crater at the summit of Kīlauea and made it her permanent home. She is said to live there still.

Evidence / 证据NPS 两页介绍。claim.v0310.hawaii.pele_halemaumau
04

经过她的土地Passing through her land

在夏威夷传统中，经过佩蕾的土地要先请求她的许可。国家公园管理局也请访客在这片神圣的地景中保持尊重。公园还提醒：不同的 moʻolelo 版本可能差别很大。

In Hawaiian tradition it is customary to ask Pele's permission to travel through her land, and the park asks visitors to behave respectfully in this sacred landscape. It also notes that versions of the moʻolelo may differ, sometimes greatly.

须署名的公开概述：依据美国国家公园管理局两页公开介绍；各家族与地方的 moʻolelo 版本差异很大，本站不收集。

中国民间信仰 / Chinese Folk Religion

美猴王：从石猴出世到大闹天宫The Monkey King: from the stone egg to Havoc in Heaven

《西游记》前七回的完整讲述：花果山仙石孕出石猴，他在水帘洞称王，又为躲避死亡漂洋求道，从须菩提祖师那里学会七十二变和筋斗云；回山后到龙宫取走如意金箍棒，在地府勾掉生死簿；天庭先封他弼马温、后封齐天大圣，他却偷吃蟠桃和金丹，打退十万天兵；最后被二郎神擒住，八卦炉炼出火眼金睛，终被如来压在五行山下。

The full opening arc of Journey to the West: a stone on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit gives birth to a monkey who becomes king of the Water Curtain Cave, crosses the seas to learn immortality, the seventy-two transformations and the somersault cloud, takes the iron staff from the Dragon King, strikes his name from the register of death, scorns heaven's offices, eats the peaches and elixir, defeats heaven's armies, survives the furnace with fiery golden eyes, and is finally pinned under the Mountain of Five Elements by Rulai.

01

仙石孕出石猴A stone gives birth to a monkey

东胜神洲傲来国的海外，有一座花果山，山顶上立着一块仙石。这块石头高三丈六尺五寸，围圆二丈四尺，自开天辟地以来就吸收着天地的灵气和日月的精华，久而久之有了灵通。有一天，仙石崩裂，生出一枚石卵，石卵被风一吹，化成一只石猴，五官俱全，四肢皆备。石猴学会了爬和走，向四方拜了一拜，两只眼睛里射出两道金光，直冲天上的斗府。玉皇大帝被惊动，派千里眼和顺风耳打开南天门查看。两位神将回报说：那是花果山上仙石生出的一只猴子，如今他吃了东西、喝了水，金光就要渐渐消退了。玉帝听了说：下方之物，都是天地精华所生，不足为奇。——谁也没想到，这只猴子后来会把天宫闹得天翻地覆。

Beyond the sea from the land of Aolai on the Eastern Continent stands the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit, and on its summit an immortal stone that had absorbed the essences of heaven and earth since the world began. One day it split open and released a stone egg; touched by the wind, the egg became a stone monkey. He bowed to the four quarters and beams of golden light shot from his eyes to the palace of the Pole Star. The Jade Emperor sent Thousand-Mile Eye and Wind-Following Ear to look; told it was only a monkey born of a stone, he declared such things unremarkable.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第1回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.01
02

水帘洞里的美猴王King of the Water Curtain Cave

石猴在山中和群猴一起玩耍，饿了吃草木果实，渴了喝山涧泉水。一个炎热的夏天，群猴在涧中洗澡，想去看看这股水从哪里来，便顺着山涧往上爬，一直找到一道大瀑布前。群猴拍手说：谁能钻进瀑布，找到源头又不伤身体，我们就拜他为王！石猴应声而出，闭上眼睛纵身一跳，竟穿过了瀑布。瀑布后面是一座铁板桥，桥那边是一处天造地设的洞府，石锅石灶、石床石凳一应俱全，石碣上刻着“花果山福地，水帘洞洞天”。石猴跳出来把群猴都领了进去，群猴依约向他跪拜，称他为“美猴王”。从此他去掉“石”字，自称“千岁大王”，在水帘洞里过了三五百年自在的日子。

The monkey played among the other monkeys of the mountain. One hot summer they followed a stream up to a great waterfall and promised to make king whoever could pass through it unharmed. The stone monkey shut his eyes and leapt through. Behind the falling water lay an iron bridge and a cave-home furnished by nature with stone pots, beds and benches, and an inscription naming it the Water Curtain Cave of the Mountain of Flowers and Fruit. He led the monkeys inside, they bowed to him as the Handsome Monkey King, and he lived there freely for three or five hundred years.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第1回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.02
03

为死亡而哭Weeping over death

有一天，美猴王和群猴正在饮宴，他忽然流下泪来。群猴问他为何烦恼，他说：我们现在虽然不受人间王法管束，也不怕飞禽走兽，可将来年老血衰，暗中有阎王老子管着，一旦死去，岂不白白在世上走了一遭？群猴听了，也都掩面悲啼。这时一只通背猿猴跳出来说：大王能想到这一层，就是道心开发了。五虫之中，只有三等名色不归阎王管——就是佛、仙与神圣，他们躲过轮回，与天地山川同寿。美猴王大喜，决心云游海角，去寻访这三等人物，学一个长生不老的法子。第二天，群猴摘来仙桃异果为他送行，他独自砍了松木扎成木筏，拿一根竹竿当篙，漂洋过海而去。

One day at a feast the Monkey King suddenly wept. Though no human law ruled them and no beast threatened them, he said, one day they would grow old and the King of the Dead would claim them. An old gibbon told him that only buddhas, immortals and sages escape the wheel of rebirth. Overjoyed, the Monkey King resolved to find them and learn the way to live forever. The next morning the monkeys feasted him with fruit, and he set off alone across the ocean on a raft of pine logs with a bamboo pole.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第1回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.03
04

斜月三星洞The Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars

木筏被风吹到南赡部洲。美猴王上岸学人说话、穿人衣服，在市井里走了八九年，看到的都是为名为利奔忙的人，没有一个修仙的。他又扎筏渡过西洋大海，来到西牛贺洲。在一座高山上，他听见一个樵夫唱着仙家的歌，樵夫说歌是邻居一位神仙教的，那位神仙住在灵台方寸山，斜月三星洞，名叫须菩提祖师。美猴王找到洞门，等了半天，一个仙童开门迎他进去。祖师问他姓什么，他说“我无性，人若骂我，我也不恼”；又问籍贯，他说从东胜神洲来。祖师看他像个猢狲，便把“猢狲”去掉兽旁，给他姓“孙”，再按门中“广大智慧真如性海颖悟圆觉”十二字排到“悟”字，取名“孙悟空”。

The raft carried him to the Southern Continent, where for eight or nine years he learned human speech and dress but met only people chasing fame and profit. Crossing another ocean to the Western Continent, he heard a woodcutter singing an immortal's song and was directed to the Patriarch Subodhi of the Cave of the Slanting Moon and Three Stars on the Mountain of Mind. The patriarch, seeing a monkey (husun), gave him the surname Sun by removing the animal radical, and from the generation character wu named him Sun Wukong, 'Awakened to Emptiness'.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第1回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.04
05

三更时分的秘传A secret lesson at the third watch

悟空在洞中扫地、挑水、砍柴，一住就是六七年。有一天祖师登坛讲道，问他想学什么：讲术、流、静、动各门，可以请仙问卜、读经念佛、打坐参禅、采阴补阳，悟空每听一门都先问一句“能长生吗”，听说不能，就一概不学。祖师假装发怒，跳下高台，拿戒尺在他头上打了三下，背着手走进里屋，关上了中门。众师兄都埋怨他，悟空却心里明白：打三下，是叫他三更时分去；背着手进去、关中门，是叫他从后门进来。当夜三更，他果然从后门溜进祖师卧房跪下。祖师见他领悟了哑谜，便把长生妙道的口诀传给他。三年之后，祖师又说修成的人每五百年要遭雷灾、火灾、风灾，便教他躲灾的七十二般地煞变化；后来又传他一个筋斗云，一翻就是十万八千里。

Wukong swept, fetched water and cut wood for six or seven years. When the patriarch offered him various arts, he refused each because none brought eternal life. Feigning anger, the patriarch struck him three times on the head, clasped his hands behind his back and shut the inner door. Wukong understood the riddle: come at the third watch, by the back door. That night the patriarch taught him the secret of long life, later the seventy-two earthly transformations to escape the calamities that strike immortals every five hundred years, and finally the somersault cloud that carries him 108,000 li in a single leap.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第2回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.05
06

卖弄被逐，回山除魔Showing off, and sent home

一天傍晚，众师兄围着悟空，要看他学来的变化。悟空经不住夸，捻着诀念动咒语，摇身一变，就变成一棵松树，众人齐声喝彩。吵闹声惊动了祖师，祖师把悟空叫来责备：修行之人不可在人前卖弄，别人见了要求你，你不教就会招来祸患。他命悟空立刻离开，并且叮嘱：此去无论惹出什么祸来，都不许说是我的徒弟，你只要说出半个字来，我就把你神魂贬在九幽之处。悟空含泪拜别，一个筋斗回到花果山。他得知一个混世魔王趁他不在，霸占了水帘洞、掳走了小猴，便找上门去，拔一把毫毛变出几百个小猴，把魔王打死，夺回了洞府。

One evening his fellow students begged to see his new powers, and Wukong turned himself into a pine tree to their loud applause. The patriarch, disturbed by the noise, rebuked him: an adept must not show off, for others will covet the art and trouble will follow. He sent Wukong away at once, forbidding him ever to name his teacher. Wukong somersaulted home, found that a Demon King of Confusion had seized his cave, plucked a handful of hairs that became hundreds of little monkeys, and killed the demon.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第2回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.06
07

东海龙宫借宝A weapon from the Dragon King

悟空操练群猴，却没有一件称手的兵器。他得知花果山下的铁板桥直通东海龙宫，便捻着闭水诀钻进水里，向东海龙王敖广讨兵器。龙王先后拿出一把大刀、一柄重三千六百斤的九股叉、一杆重七千二百斤的方天画戟，悟空都嫌太轻。龙婆、龙女出主意说：海藏里那块天河定底的神珍铁，这几天霞光艳艳，莫非是该出世遇此圣人？悟空过去一看，是一根斗来粗、二丈多长的铁柱，两头是金箍，中间刻着“如意金箍棒，重一万三千五百斤”。他说声“再短细些”，铁棒就随心变小，最后成了绣花针大小，藏进耳朵里。他又逼着四海龙王凑出藕丝步云履、锁子黄金甲和凤翅紫金冠，才心满意足地回山。

Needing a weapon, Wukong dived to the Crystal Palace of Ao Guang, Dragon King of the Eastern Sea. A broadsword, a nine-pronged fork of 3,600 pounds and a halberd of 7,200 pounds were all too light. The Dragon Queen suggested the divine iron that had fixed the depth of the Milky Way, which had lately been glowing. It was a pillar inscribed 'Compliant Golden-Hooped Rod, weight 13,500 pounds', and it shrank at his command until it was the size of an embroidery needle, which he kept behind his ear. He then bullied the dragon kings of the four seas into giving him cloud-walking shoes, golden mail and a phoenix-feather cap.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第3回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.07
08

勾销生死簿Striking out the Register of Death

悟空回山后，又与牛魔王等六位妖王结为兄弟，天天宴饮。一天他喝醉了，在松树下睡着，梦见两个人拿着勾魂的牌子，用绳子套住他的魂魄，一直拉到幽冥界。悟空看见城上写着“幽冥界”，大怒道：我老孙早已超出三界之外，跳出五行之中，凭什么来勾我？他从耳中掏出金箍棒，把两个勾死人打成肉酱，一路打进森罗殿。十殿阎王只好叫判官拿出生死簿给他看。悟空翻到“魂字一千三百五十号”，上面写着“孙悟空，天产石猴，该寿三百四十二岁，善终”。他索性拿笔把自己和猴类的名字一概勾掉，扔下簿子打出幽冥界。醒来后，东海龙王和地府的秦广王先后上表天庭，状告这只妖猴。

After a drunken feast with six demon kings, Wukong dreamed that two summoners roped his soul and dragged it to the Land of Darkness. Furious — had he not passed beyond the Three Realms? — he beat them to pulp with his staff and stormed the palace of the Ten Kings of the Underworld. There he found his own entry, 'Sun Wukong, stone monkey born of heaven, allotted 342 years, to die a good death', and with a brush struck out his name and those of all monkeys. When he woke, the Dragon King and the King Qinguang of the underworld each sent complaints to heaven.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第3回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.08
09

天庭的第一份官职：弼马温Heaven's first office: Keeper of the Horses

玉帝看了两道表文，正要派兵捉拿，太白金星出班奏道：这猴子是天地育成之体，不如降一道招安圣旨，把他宣上天来，给他一个官职，拘束在此，若他受天命，以后再加升赏；若违天命，就地擒拿。玉帝准奏。悟空欢喜上天，被封为御马监的弼马温。他尽心尽力，半个月里把天马养得肉肥膘满。一天同僚设宴，他问起弼马温是几品官，众人说：这官没有品从，叫作“未入流”，养得好不过是一声“好”，养瘦了还要受罚。悟空听了大怒：老孙在花果山称王称祖，怎么骗我来替他养马！他推倒公案，掣出铁棒，一路打出南天门，回到花果山。独角鬼王献上赭黄袍，劝他索性做个“齐天大圣”。

As the Jade Emperor prepared to send troops, the Gold Star of Venus advised him to summon the monkey with a decree of amnesty and keep him in heaven under a title. Wukong happily accepted and was appointed Keeper of the Heavenly Horses, tending them so well that they grew sleek within a fortnight. At a banquet he learned that the post had no rank at all. Enraged at having been tricked into grooming horses, he overturned his desk, fought his way out through the Southern Gate and returned home, where a demon king urged him to proclaim himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第4回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.09
10

齐天大圣Great Sage Equal to Heaven

悟空在洞门外竖起一面大旗，上书“齐天大圣”四个大字。玉帝派托塔李天王和哪吒三太子带领天兵下界捉拿。先锋巨灵神挥着宣花斧上阵，被悟空一棒打断斧柄，败回营中。哪吒变出三头六臂，持六般兵器来战，悟空也变三头六臂，又拔一根毫毛变作本相迎敌，真身绕到背后，一棒打中哪吒的左臂，哪吒负痛败走。李天王只好收兵回奏。太白金星又出主意：不如就封他个空衔“齐天大圣”，有官无禄，养在天地之间，收他的邪心。玉帝依从，在蟠桃园右首给他盖了一座齐天大圣府，府里还设了安静司、宁神司两个衙门。悟空这才欢天喜地，在天上住了下来。

Wukong raised a banner reading 'Great Sage Equal to Heaven'. The Jade Emperor sent Heavenly King Li and his son Nezha with heaven's soldiers. The vanguard, the Mighty Spirit, had his axe-handle snapped by one blow; Nezha took three heads and six arms, but Wukong did the same, sent a hair-double to fight, and struck Nezha from behind. Venus advised granting the empty title Great Sage Equal to Heaven, with no salary, to quiet the monkey's heart. A mansion was built for him beside the Peach Garden, complete with Offices of Peace and Serenity, and Wukong settled happily in heaven.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第4回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.10
11

蟠桃园The Garden of Immortal Peaches

大圣在天上无事可做，今天东游，明天西荡，和众星宿称兄道弟。许旌阳真人担心他闲中生事，玉帝便派他去管理蟠桃园。土地告诉他：园里共有三千六百株桃树——前面一千二百株，三千年一熟，人吃了成仙了道；中间一千二百株，六千年一熟，人吃了霞举飞升、长生不老；后面一千二百株，九千年一熟，人吃了与天地齐寿、日月同庚。大圣听了暗暗高兴，从此常常支开土地和力士，自己脱下冠服爬上大树，拣那熟透的大桃子吃个饱。有一天，王母娘娘要开蟠桃盛会，派七位仙女提着花篮来园中摘桃。大圣正变成二寸长的小人在树梢上睡觉，被惊醒后问仙女都请了谁，仙女一一说来，却没有他。

With nothing to do, the Great Sage wandered heaven befriending stars. To keep him occupied the Jade Emperor put him in charge of the Garden of Immortal Peaches, whose 3,600 trees ripened every three, six and nine thousand years, granting immortality, eternal youth and a life as long as heaven and earth. Secretly delighted, he sent his attendants away and gorged on the ripest fruit. When seven fairy maidens came to pick peaches for the Queen Mother's Peach Banquet, they woke him from a nap in the treetops — and he learned that he had not been invited.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第5回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.11
12

偷酒偷丹，十万天兵Stolen wine, stolen elixir and heaven's army

大圣用定身法把七位仙女定在树下，驾云直奔瑶池。宴席已经摆好，他拔毫毛变出瞌睡虫，叫造酒的力士都睡着了，自己端起玉液琼浆喝了个酩酊大醉。醉醺醺的他走错了路，闯进太上老君的兜率宫，宫中无人，只见丹房里摆着五个葫芦，装满炼好的金丹。他想：这是仙家至宝，我且尝尝。于是把葫芦里的金丹倒出来，像吃炒豆一样全吃了。酒醒之后，他知道闯了大祸，连忙逃出西天门，回到花果山。玉帝大怒，派四大天王、李天王、哪吒，率领二十八宿、九曜星官、十二元辰等十万天兵，布下十八架天罗地网围住花果山。大圣带着群猴迎战，一连打败九曜星和四大天王，到天黑也没有被捉住。

Freezing the fairies with an immobilising spell, the Great Sage flew to the Jade Pool, put the wine-makers to sleep with sleep-insects made from his hairs and drank himself senseless. Staggering the wrong way, he wandered into Laozi's Tushita Palace and ate the five gourds of finished elixir pills as if they were roasted beans. Sobering in alarm, he fled home. The Jade Emperor sent the Four Heavenly Kings, Heavenly King Li, Nezha, the twenty-eight lunar mansions and the nine planets with a hundred thousand soldiers and eighteen nets around the mountain, yet the Great Sage held them off until nightfall.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第5回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.12
13

二郎神斗法The contest with Erlang

观音菩萨赴蟠桃会，听说此事，先派徒弟惠岸行者下界交战，也败了回来。观音便向玉帝推荐玉帝的外甥——住在灌江口的显圣二郎真君。二郎神带着梅山六兄弟和哮天犬来到花果山，和大圣大战三百余回合，不分胜负，各自变成万丈高的法身相斗。猴群溃散，大圣心慌，收了法相变成一只麻雀飞上树梢；二郎就变成饿鹰去扑他。大圣变成大鹚老冲天飞去，二郎变成海鹤追赶；他变鱼钻进水里，二郎变鱼鹰候着；他变水蛇，二郎变灰鹤；他变成一只低贱的花鸨，二郎不屑追，用弹弓把他打落。大圣滚到山崖下又变成一座土地庙，嘴变庙门，牙变门扇，舌头变菩萨，尾巴没处放，竖在后面变成一根旗杆，被二郎一眼识破。最后太上老君在云端丢下金刚琢，正打在大圣头上，哮天犬扑上来咬住他的腿，大圣才被众神按倒擒住。

Guanyin recommended the Jade Emperor's nephew, the Illustrious Sage Erlang of Guanjiang. With his six sworn brothers and his celestial hound, Erlang fought the Great Sage for over three hundred rounds. When the monkeys scattered, the Great Sage fled through transformation after transformation — sparrow, cormorant, fish, water snake, bustard — and Erlang matched each as hawk, crane, osprey and grey crane. Disguised as a temple, the monkey could not hide his tail and stood it up behind as a flagpole, which gave him away. At last Laozi dropped his Diamond Snare on his head, the hound bit his leg, and he was seized.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第6回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.13
14

八卦炉中的火眼金睛Fiery golden eyes in the Eight Trigrams furnace

大圣被押到斩妖台，绑在降妖柱上。天兵刀砍斧剁、枪刺剑刳，火部众神放火烧、雷部众神用雷劈，竟伤不了他一根毫毛。太上老君说：这猴子吃了蟠桃、喝了御酒，又盗吃了我的金丹，炼成了金刚之躯。不如交给我，放进八卦炉里，用文武火锻炼，炼出我的丹来，他的身体自然化为灰烬。大圣被推进八卦炉，他钻进巽宫位下——巽是风，有风就没有火，只是被烟熏红了眼睛，从此有了一双“火眼金睛”。四十九天后，老君开炉取丹，大圣忽地跳了出来，一脚蹬倒八卦炉，炉砖带着火掉落凡间。他掏出金箍棒，从兜率宫一路打到灵霄殿外，九曜星闭门闭户，四天王无影无踪，只有王灵官举着金鞭拦住了他。

Bound at the execution terrace, the Great Sage could not be hurt by sword, axe, fire or thunder: the peaches, wine and elixir had made his body adamantine. Laozi had him placed in his Eight Trigrams furnace to be refined for forty-nine days. Hiding under the trigram of wind, where there is no fire, he was only smoked — which reddened his eyes into 'fiery golden eyes'. When the furnace was opened he sprang out, kicked it over so that its burning bricks fell to earth, and fought his way to the Hall of Divine Mists, where only the officer Wang Lingguan stood against him.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第7回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.14
15

如来的手掌The palm of the Buddha

王灵官和三十六员雷将把大圣团团围住，大圣变出三头六臂，把金箍棒幌一幌变成三根，六只手使开，打得雷将们近不了身。玉帝只好派游弈灵官和翊圣真君到西方去请如来佛祖。如来来到灵霄殿外，叫雷将停手，问大圣：你有什么本事，敢夺玉帝的尊位？大圣说：“皇帝轮流做，明年到我家”，只要玉帝把天宫让给他就罢了。如来笑道：我和你打个赌——你若一个筋斗翻得出我的右手掌，就算你赢，请玉帝到西方居住，天宫让给你；若翻不出去，你就回下界做妖，再修几劫来争。大圣暗笑：我一个筋斗十万八千里，他的手掌不满一尺，怎么跳不出去？他跳上佛掌，一个筋斗云不见踪影，只见天边立着五根肉红柱子，便以为到了天的尽头。

Surrounded by Wang Lingguan and thirty-six thunder generals, the Great Sage fought them off with three heads, six arms and three staffs, until the Jade Emperor sent to the West for Rulai. Asked what right he had to the throne, the Great Sage replied that emperors take turns — next year it would be his. Rulai offered a wager: if he could somersault out of Rulai's right palm, the Jade Emperor would yield heaven; if not, he must return below. Scoffing that his somersault covered 108,000 li, the Great Sage leapt — and came to five flesh-pink pillars he took to be the edge of the sky.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第7回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.15
16

五行山下Under the Mountain of Five Elements

大圣心想：我到了这里，回去跟如来做个凭证。他拔一根毫毛变出一支浓墨双毫笔，在中间那根柱子上写下一行大字：“齐天大圣到此一游”。写完收了毫毛，又不庄重地在第一根柱子下撒了一泡猴尿，然后翻转筋斗回到原处，对如来说：我已经去了又回来了，你叫玉帝让出天宫吧！如来骂道：你这尿精猴子，你正好不曾离开我的手掌！你低头看看。大圣一看，如来右手中指上写着“齐天大圣到此一游”，大拇指根下还有一股猴尿的臊气。他大吃一惊，正要再跳，被如来翻掌一扑，推出西天门外，五根手指化作金、木、水、火、土五座相连的大山，叫作“五行山”，把他压在山下。众神在天宫摆了“安天大会”答谢如来。如来又取出写着“唵、嘛、呢、叭、咪、吽”六个金字的帖子，贴在山顶，并嘱咐当地的土地神：他饿了就给他吃铁丸子，渴了就给他喝熔化的铜汁。等他的灾难满了，自然会有人来救他。——这一压，就是五百年。

To prove his journey he made a brush from a hair, wrote 'The Great Sage Equal to Heaven was here' on the middle pillar, and relieved himself at the foot of the first. Somersaulting back, he demanded the throne. Rulai showed him the words written on his own middle finger and the smell of monkey urine at the base of his thumb. Before the monkey could leap again, Rulai pushed him out of the Western Gate and turned his five fingers into the five joined peaks of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth — the Mountain of Five Elements — sealed with a golden six-syllable charm. The local god was to feed him iron pellets and molten copper until, five hundred years later, someone would come to free him.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第7回。claim.v0320.xiyouji_havoc.16“五百年”的时间与后来唐僧解救的情节见于第八回之后，本篇只讲到被压为止。

中国民间信仰 / Chinese Folk Religion

西游记 · 取经缘起：从灵山到长安Journey to the West: how the pilgrimage began

大闹天宫之后，如来要把三藏真经传到东土，观音菩萨领命东行，一路上为未来的取经人点化了沙和尚、猪刚鬣、玉龙三太子和五行山下的孙悟空。长安这边，江流儿陈玄奘历尽身世之苦长大成僧；泾河龙王为了赌气私改雨数，被魏征梦中斩首，冤魂纠缠唐太宗，太宗魂游地府后还阳，决定举办水陆大会。观音在大会上显圣，说西天有大乘真经，玄奘领命成为“三藏”，带着一捻故乡土踏上西行之路。

After Havoc in Heaven, the Buddha resolves to send his scriptures east, and Guanyin travels to find a pilgrim, recruiting on the way the future disciples Sha Wujing, Zhu Bajie, the jade dragon prince and the Monkey King under the mountain. In Chang'an the orphan Jiangliu grows up to be the monk Xuanzang; the Jing River dragon king breaks heaven's decree to win a bet and is beheaded in Wei Zheng's dream; Emperor Taizong visits the underworld and returns to hold a great mass for the dead. Guanyin appears at the mass, Xuanzang volunteers to fetch the scriptures, and he leaves with a pinch of home soil in his wine.

01

灵山上的三藏真经Three baskets of scripture on Spirit Mountain

如来把孙悟空压在五行山下以后，回到西天灵山雷音宝刹，不知不觉过了五百年。这一年七月十五，如来叫人摆开百宝异果，举行盂兰盆会，对聚集而来的诸佛、菩萨、罗汉、揭谛、比丘说：我观看天下四大部洲，众生善恶，各方不一。东胜神洲的人敬天礼地，心爽气平；北俱芦洲的人虽然好杀生，却只为糊口度日，性情拙笨，也不多作践；西牛贺洲的人不贪不杀，养气潜灵，虽然没有上真，人人都能长寿；只有南赡部洲的人贪淫乐祸，多杀多争，正是口舌凶场、是非恶海。众人听得连连叹息。如来接着说：我如今有三藏真经，可以劝人为善。一藏是法，谈天；一藏是论，说地；一藏是经，度鬼。三藏共计三十五部，一万五千一百四十四卷，是修真之经，正善之门。凡天下四大部洲的天文、地理、人物、鸟兽、花木、器用、人事，无所不载。我本想把它们直接送上东土，可是那方众生愚蠢，必定会毁谤真言，不识我法门的要旨，怠慢了瑜伽的正宗。怎样才能找到一位法力高强的神，到东土去寻一个善信之人，叫他苦历千山，远经万水，亲自到我这里来求取真经，永传东土，劝化众生呢？话音刚落，观音菩萨走上莲台，向佛三匝礼拜，说：弟子不才，愿到东土去寻一个取经人。众佛抬头一看，只见那菩萨理圆四德，智满金身，正是南海普陀落伽山救苦救难的大慈大悲观世音。

Five hundred years after pinning Sun Wukong under the Mountain of Five Elements, the Buddha held the Ullambana feast on Spirit Mountain and described the four continents: the people of the southern continent of Jambudvīpa were greedy, lustful and quarrelsome, a sea of strife. He had three baskets of true scripture — one on heaven, one on earth, one to save the dead — thirty-five works in 15,144 scrolls, that could turn people to the good. But if he simply sent them east, the foolish would slander them. Someone must find a faithful person in the east who would cross a thousand mountains to fetch them himself. Guanyin of Potalaka stepped forward and offered to go.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第八回。claim.v0330.xyj_origins.01
02

五件宝贝与一路东行Five treasures and the road east

如来非常高兴，说：别人去不得，须是观音尊者，神通广大，才可以去。又嘱咐她：这一去，不许在霄汉中行走，要半云半雾，一路看清山水，牢记路程的远近，好叮咛那取经的人。只是那取经人恐怕难行，我给你五件宝贝。说着命阿傩、迦叶取出一件锦襕异宝袈裟、一根九环锡杖，说：这袈裟和锡杖，送给那取经人亲自使用。他若是坚心来这里，穿上我的袈裟，免堕轮回；拿着我的锡杖，不遭毒害。又取出三个箍儿，说：这宝贝名叫“紧箍儿”，虽然一样三个，用法各不相同。我有“金、紧、禁”的咒语三篇。路上要是遇到神通广大的妖魔，你就劝他学好，跟那取经人做个徒弟。他要是不服使唤，就把这箍儿给他戴在头上，自然见肉生根；各依所用的咒语念一念，眼胀头痛，脑门皆裂，管教他入我门来。观音拜谢领了宝贝，带着徒弟惠岸行者——也就是托塔李天王的二太子木叉——离开灵山。惠岸使一条浑铁棍，在前面开路保护。师徒二人半云半雾，一路东行，走到弱水三千的流沙河边，只见河水浑浑，波涛汹涌，鹅毛也飘不起，芦花也定底沉。忽然河中泼剌一声，跳出一个妖魔：青不青，黑不黑，晦气色脸；长不长，短不短，赤脚筋躯；脖子上挂着九个骷髅，手里拿一根宝杖，直扑菩萨。木叉举棍拦住，两人在河边大战了几十个回合，不分胜负。妖魔停住手问：你是哪里来的和尚，敢和我对敌？木叉说：我是托塔天王二太子木叉惠岸行者，保护我师父往东土寻取经人。那妖魔一听“观音菩萨”四个字，连忙收了宝杖，扔下兵器跪在地上。

The delighted Buddha told Guanyin to travel half on cloud and half on mist, noting the distances for the pilgrim, and had Ānanda and Kāśyapa bring five treasures: a brocade cassock and a nine-ringed staff for the pilgrim — whoever wore the cassock would escape rebirth, whoever held the staff would escape poison — and three fillets with the spells Gold, Tight and Prohibition. A powerful demon who agreed to reform was to become the pilgrim's disciple; if he disobeyed, the fillet would take root on his head and the spell would make it split with pain. Guanyin set out with Huian, Prince Muzha, armed with an iron rod. At the Flowing Sands River, where not even a goose feather floats, a sallow demon with a necklace of nine skulls sprang at her; he fought Muzha to a standstill, then knelt on hearing Guanyin's name.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第八回。claim.v0330.xyj_origins.02
03

流沙河与福陵山The Flowing Sands River and Fuling Mountain

那妖魔叩头说：菩萨恕罪！我不是别的妖邪，我是灵霄殿下侍銮舆的卷帘大将。只因在蟠桃会上失手打碎了一只玻璃盏，玉帝把我打了八百下，贬到下界，变成这副模样，又叫我每七天被飞剑穿胸肋一百多下，所以我在这里受苦。饥寒难忍，三两天就出波涛找个行人吃。没想到今天冲撞了大慈菩萨。菩萨说：你在天上有罪，贬下来还这样伤生，真是罪上加罪。我奉佛旨上东土寻取经人，你何不入我门来，皈依善果，跟那取经人做个徒弟，上西天拜佛求经？我叫飞剑不来穿你，那时功成免罪，复你本职。妖魔说：我愿皈正果。又说：我在这里吃人无数，前后有几次取经人来，都被我吃了。凡是被吃的人头，我都抛在流沙里，全都沉了；只有九个取经人的骷髅，浮在水面，再也不沉，我觉得稀奇，就用索子穿起来，闲时拿来玩耍。菩萨说：这是取经人的骷髅，你可以挂在颈上，等取经人来，自有用处。于是给他摩顶受戒，指沙为姓，取名沙悟净。菩萨又往东走，来到福陵山，一股妖气冲天。忽然一个长嘴大耳的妖怪，举着一把九齿钉钯扑来。原来他是天河里的天蓬元帅，因为在蟠桃会上喝醉了酒，调戏嫦娥，被玉帝打了二千锤，贬下凡尘，投胎时错投了母猪的胎，变成这副嘴脸。他在云栈洞里招赘给卵二姐，卵二姐死后，洞里的家当都归了他，他就靠吃人度日。菩萨劝他：古人说，若要有前程，莫做没前程。你跟随取经人往西天去，将功折罪。妖怪说：前程，前程！要依你，叫我喝西北风吗？菩萨说：人有善愿，天必从之，自有吃食的地方。妖怪这才答应，菩萨给他取名猪悟能。他从此断了五荤三厌，专心等着取经人。

The demon said he had been the Curtain-Raising General who attended the imperial carriage; for breaking a crystal cup at the Peach Banquet he was flogged eight hundred times, banished and pierced by a flying sword every seven days, so hunger drove him to eat travellers. Nine pilgrims' skulls would not sink, so he strung them on a cord. Guanyin promised to stop the sword if he served the pilgrim, told him to keep the skulls for later use, and named him Sha Wujing. At Fuling Mountain a long-snouted monster with a nine-toothed rake attacked: the former Marshal of the Heavenly Canopy, banished for molesting the moon goddess while drunk and reborn by mistake in a sow's womb, who had married into the Cloud-Ladder Cave and lived by eating people. 'Shall I live on the wind?' he asked; Guanyin assured him a good vow would be provided for. Named Zhu Wuneng, he gave up meat to wait.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第八回。claim.v0330.xyj_origins.03
04

空中的玉龙与山下的猴王The dragon in the air and the monkey under the mountain

菩萨和木叉继续东行，正走着，忽然看见半空中吊着一条玉龙，正在叫苦。菩萨近前问道：你是哪里的龙，在这里受罪？那龙说：我是西海龙王敖闰的儿子，因为纵火烧了殿上的明珠，父王告我忤逆，天庭判了死罪，不日就要遭诛，求菩萨救我。菩萨当即上了南天门，求见玉帝：我奉佛旨上东土寻取经人，路上遇见这孽龙，特来奏请饶他性命，赐给我，叫他给取经人做个脚力。玉帝准奏，派天将解开玉龙交给菩萨。菩萨把他送到一处深涧，嘱咐他：等取经人来了，你变作白马，上西方立功。玉龙领命藏身去了。菩萨又往前走，远远望见万道金光、千条瑞气，原来已经到了五行山——这正是当年如来压住齐天大圣的地方。山下石匣里忽然有人高叫：是哪个在山上吟诗，揭我的短？菩萨走下山来看，原来是孙悟空，被压在石匣之中，口能言，身不能动。悟空认出了菩萨，叫道：菩萨，我在这里度日如年，没一个相知的来看我。你从哪里来？菩萨说：我奉佛旨，上东土寻取经人，路过这里，特来看你。悟空说：如来哄了我，把我压在此山，五百多年了，不能展挣。土地神看守着我，我饿了给我吃铁丸子，渴了给我喝溶化的铜汁。万望菩萨方便一二，救我老孙一救！菩萨说：你这猴子罪业弥深，救你出来，恐你又生祸害。悟空说：我已知悔了，但愿大慈悲指条门路，情愿修行。菩萨大喜，说：我到东土大唐国寻一个取经的人来，叫他救你。你可跟他做个徒弟，秉教伽持，入我佛门，再修正果。悟空连声说：愿去！愿去！菩萨说：既有善果，我与你起个法名。悟空说：我已有名了，叫做孙悟空。菩萨高兴地说：我前面也收了两个人，名字都是“悟”字排行，你也叫“悟”，正合着他们，甚好！

Further east Guanyin found a jade dragon hanging in the sky: the son of the Dragon King of the Western Sea, condemned for burning a pearl in his father's hall. She went to the Southern Gate, obtained his pardon from the Jade Emperor and set him in a deep gorge to wait as the pilgrim's horse. At the Mountain of Five Elements Sun Wukong called from his stone box: for five hundred years the local gods had fed him iron pellets and molten copper. He begged for release and promised to reform. Guanyin said a pilgrim from the Tang would free him if he became his disciple, and offered him a religious name — but he already had one, Wukong, and she was pleased that it matched the other two disciples' 'Wu' names.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第八回。claim.v0330.xyj_origins.04
05

状元、绣球与金色鲤鱼The top scholar, the embroidered ball and the golden carp

菩萨离开五行山，一路来到大唐国都长安。她和木叉变作两个疥癞游僧，住进城里的土地庙，暗中访求善人。那时是贞观十三年，长安城里正开科取士。海州有个读书人，姓陈名萼，字光蕊，告别母亲张氏，进京赶考。三场考完，唐王亲自出题，光蕊考中了第一名状元，跨马游街三日。游到丞相殷开山的府门前，殷丞相的女儿温娇——小名满堂娇——还没有婚配，正在彩楼上抛绣球选婿。她看见光蕊人才出众，又知道他是新科状元，心中十分欢喜，便把绣球抛下，恰好打中光蕊的乌纱帽。楼上楼下顿时笙箫齐奏，丫鬟们把光蕊迎进府中，两人当天就拜堂成亲。第二天，唐王任命光蕊为江州州主，催他即刻上任。光蕊带着妻子回到海州，接上母亲一同赴任。走到洪州地界的万花店，母亲张氏忽然病倒了。光蕊在店门前，看见一个渔人提着一尾金色的鲤鱼叫卖，那鱼的眼睛一闪一闪地眨动。光蕊说：我听说鱼蛇眨眼，必定不是等闲之物。就花一贯钱把鱼买下，送到洪江边放生了。回店里对母亲说起，母亲说：放生好事，我心里也欢喜。因为上任的日期催得紧，光蕊只得把母亲留在店中养病，付了房钱，约好秋凉时再来接她，自己带着妻子先走了。

Guanyin reached Chang'an and lodged in the earth-god's shrine disguised as a scabby monk. That year Chen E, styled Guangrui, of Haizhou, came first in the palace examination. Riding through the streets, he passed the mansion of Chief Minister Yin Kaishan, whose daughter Wenjiao was choosing a husband by throwing an embroidered ball from a decorated tower; it struck his hat, and they married that day. Appointed governor of Jiangzhou, he set out with his wife and his mother; at the Wanhua inn his mother fell ill. Seeing a fisherman selling a golden carp whose eyes kept blinking, Guangrui thought it no ordinary fish, bought it and released it into the Hong River. Pressed for time, he left his mother at the inn to recover and went on with his wife.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第九回。claim.v0330.xyj_origins.05第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回。
06

洪江渡口的劫难Murder at the Hong River crossing

夫妻俩带着家僮来到洪江渡口，船夫刘洪、李彪撑船过来迎接。也是光蕊前世合当有这场灾难，撞着这对冤家。刘洪一眼看见殷小姐面如满月、眼似秋波，顿起歹心，和李彪商量好，把船撑到了没有人烟的地方。等到夜深三更，他们先把家僮打死，又把陈光蕊打死，尸首推进了江里。殷小姐见丈夫被害，也要跳江寻死，刘洪一把抱住她说：你要是从了我，万事皆休；要是不从，一刀两断！殷小姐想到自己腹中已有身孕，留得性命或许还能为丈夫报仇，只得权且顺从。刘洪穿上光蕊的衣冠，拿着他的官凭，带着殷小姐到江州冒名上任去了。光蕊的尸首沉在江底，动也不动，被巡江的夜叉看见，飞报龙王。龙王叫人把尸首抬来一看，说：这人正是救我性命的恩人，怎么被人谋死了？原来前几天那尾金色鲤鱼，就是洪江龙王变化出游，被渔人捉住，若不是光蕊买下放生，早已没命了。龙王说：常言道，恩将恩报。我今天须当救他性命，以报前日之恩。他写了一道牒文，差夜叉送到洪州城隍土地处，要来了光蕊的魂魄；又取出一颗定颜珠，放进光蕊口中，保住他的尸身不坏，日后好还魂报仇。龙王对光蕊的魂魄说：你暂且在我水府中做个都领，等将来再还阳。光蕊叩头拜谢，就在水府中住了下来。

At the Hong River crossing the boatmen Liu Hong and Li Biao ferried them, and Liu Hong coveted the young wife. At midnight they rowed to a lonely place, killed the servant, struck Chen Guangrui dead and threw him in the river. When Wenjiao tried to drown herself, Liu Hong seized her and threatened her; pregnant, she submitted, hoping one day to avenge her husband. Liu Hong put on Guangrui's robes, took his letter of appointment and went to Jiangzhou as governor in his name. The body sank to the river bed, where the Hong River dragon king recognised his saviour — he himself had been the golden carp. He fetched Guangrui's soul from the local city god, put a face-preserving pearl in his mouth and kept him in the water palace as an officer, to await revenge and return.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第九回。claim.v0330.xyj_origins.06第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回。
07

漂在江上的婴儿A baby on the river

殷小姐在江州衙门里痛恨刘洪，恨不得食其肉、寝其皮，只因身怀有孕，未知男女，只得勉强忍耐。转眼到了临盆的日子，她在衙中生下一个男孩。正抱着孩子哭泣，忽然听见耳边有人叮嘱：满堂娇，听我叮嘱。我是南极星君，奉观音菩萨法旨，特送这孩子与你，异日声名远大，非比等闲。刘贼若回来，必定要害这孩子，你可用心保护。你丈夫已经得了龙王相救，日后夫妻相会，子母团圆，雪冤报仇有日。说完便不见了。不久刘洪回来，一见孩子，果然要把他淹死。殷小姐推说今天天色已晚，容到明日再抛到江中去。第二天，刘洪恰好有紧急公事出门，殷小姐暗想：这孩子留在这里，刘贼回来必定害他性命，不如早早抛到江中，听天由命。倘若皇天见怜，有人救去收养，将来还能相逢。她又怕日后难以相认，就咬破手指，写下一纸血书，把孩子父母的姓名、跟脚原由备细写明；又把孩子左脚上的一个小指用口咬下，作为记号。她取出一件贴身的汗衫，把孩子包好，趁着衙内无人，抱到江边。正要把孩子抛下，忽见江岸边漂来一片木板，她便朝天拜祷，把孩子安在木板上，用带子缚住，血书系在胸前，推入江中，任他漂流而去，自己含着眼泪回衙去了。那木板顺着江水一直流到镇江金山寺脚下停住。金山寺的长老叫做法明和尚，修真悟道，已得无生妙诀。他正在打坐，忽然听见江边有小儿啼哭，循声出去一看，见木板上缚着一个婴儿，就把他抱回寺中，取名江流，托人抚养，血书紧紧收藏起来。

In the Jiangzhou yamen Wenjiao bore a son. A voice in her ear said it was the Star of the South Pole, sent by Guanyin: the child would become famous, his father had been saved by the dragon king, and she must protect him from Liu Hong. Liu Hong wanted the child drowned; when he was called away on urgent business, she decided the river was safer. She bit her finger and wrote a letter in blood with his parents' names and story, bit off the tip of his left little toe as a mark, wrapped him in her shirt, tied him to a floating plank with the letter on his breast and pushed him into the river. The plank drifted to the foot of Jinshan Monastery, where Abbot Faming heard the crying, took him in and named him Jiangliu, 'River Float', keeping the letter safe.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第九回。claim.v0330.xyj_origins.07第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回。
08

江流儿寻母报仇Jiangliu finds his mother

光阴似箭，江流长到十八岁，长老给他剃度出家，取法名玄奘，他一心参禅，持斋把素。有一天，暮春时节，众僧在松荫下讲经参禅，一个酒肉和尚被玄奘难倒，恼羞成怒，骂道：你这业畜，连自己的爹娘姓甚名谁都不知道，还在这里捣什么鬼！玄奘听了，哭着跑进方丈跪下，求师父告诉他父母的姓名。长老这才取出那封血书和贴身的汗衫交给他。玄奘读完血书，哭倒在地，发誓说：父母之仇，不能报复，何以为人？长老就叫他扮作化缘的和尚，直奔江州。玄奘来到江州衙门前化斋，正巧殷小姐梦见月缺再圆，出来布施，见这和尚的模样和丈夫一般无二，就叫进来细问。母子相认，殷小姐要看他的左脚，果然缺了一节小指，两人抱头痛哭。母亲嘱咐他：你先到洪州万花店去找你祖母，再拿着我的书信到长安去见你外公殷丞相，叫他奏明唐王，起兵来擒刘贼，替你父亲报仇。玄奘找到万花店，打听得祖母当年没有盘缠，搬进破瓦窑里住，每天沿街乞讨，想念儿子哭得双目失明。玄奘把来历说了，祖母大哭，玄奘用舌尖舔她的双眼，祝祷之后，双眼竟然复明了。玄奘又来到长安，见了外公殷开山。殷丞相读罢女儿的书信，放声大哭，次日奏明唐王，亲自统领六万御林军杀奔江州，活捉了刘洪、李彪。他们把刘洪押到当年行凶的洪江渡口，活剜出心肝，祭奠陈光蕊。洪江龙王得知仇已报了，就把光蕊的尸首送出水面，光蕊伸腰舒臂，竟然苏醒过来，一家人在江边团聚。后来光蕊做了学士，玄奘立意安禅，回到洪福寺修行。

At eighteen Jiangliu was ordained as Xuanzang. When a monk he had bested in debate sneered that he did not know his own parents' names, Faming gave him the blood letter, and he vowed revenge. Begging at the Jiangzhou yamen, he met his mother, who recognised him by the missing toe. She sent him to find his grandmother at the Wanhua inn — now blind from weeping and begging in the street; when Xuanzang licked her eyes and prayed, her sight returned — and then to her father in Chang'an. Minister Yin led sixty thousand imperial troops to Jiangzhou and captured Liu Hong and Li Biao; Liu Hong's heart and liver were offered at the crossing where he had killed Guangrui. The dragon king returned the body, Guangrui stretched and woke, and the family was reunited; Xuanzang returned to Hongfu Monastery.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第九回。claim.v0330.xyj_origins.08第九回陈光蕊故事见于清代以后的通行本，明代世德堂本没有这一回；有的版本还写到殷小姐最后从容自尽，本节不展开。
09

渔夫、樵夫与卖卦先生A fisherman, a woodcutter and a fortune-teller

长安城外的泾河岸边，住着两个不登科的贤人：一个是渔翁，名叫张稍；一个是樵子，名叫李定。这一天两人卖完了柴、卖完了鱼，在酒馆里喝得半醉，一人提着一瓶酒，沿着泾河岸边慢慢走回家，一路上互相吟诗唱和，夸自己的营生好：一个说山里青松翠竹，逍遥自在；一个说水上明月清风，闲来无事。说着说着就斗起嘴来。李定说：张兄，你在水面上讨生活，一旦翻了船，就要葬身鱼腹。还是我在山里砍柴安稳。张稍说：李兄，你在山里，小心被老虎吃了；我呀，永远不会翻船。李定问：凭什么这样肯定？张稍说：你不知道，这长安城西门街上，有一个卖卦的先生。我每天送他一尾金色鲤鱼，他就袖传一课，依着他指的方位下网，百下百着。今天我又去买了卦，他叫我在泾河湾头东边下网，西岸抛钓，定获满载鱼虾而归。明天我再进城卖钱沽酒，再和老兄相叙。两人说笑着各自回家去了。没想到这番话被泾河里巡水的夜叉听见了，他急忙撞进水晶宫，慌慌张张报告龙王：祸事了！长安城西门街上有个卖卦的先生，算得这样准，每天叫那渔翁按方位下网。要是照他这样算下去，用不了多久，泾河里的水族就要被打尽了，还怎样壮观水府，怎样跃浪翻波，辅助大王威力？龙王大怒，提起宝剑就要上长安城去诛灭那卖卦的。龙子、龙孙、虾臣、蟹士、鲥军师、鳜少卿、鲤太宰一齐劝道：大王息怒。常言道，过耳之言，不可听信。大王此去，必有云从、必有雨助，恐怕惊吓了长安的百姓，上天见责。大王何不变化一下，进城访问一番，果有此人，再诛灭不迟；若无此辈，可不是枉害他人吗？龙王依奏，摇身一变，变作一个白衣秀士，身高八尺，丰姿英伟，走进长安城，来到西门街，只见一群人挤在一个卦铺前，门上挂着一块招牌，写着“神课先生袁守诚”——原来他是当朝钦天监台正先生袁天罡的叔父。

Outside Chang'an, by the Jing River, the fisherman Zhang Shao and the woodcutter Li Ding, tipsy and trading verses, argued about whose trade was safer. Zhang Shao said he would never capsize: a fortune-teller on West Gate Street told him every day, for the price of a golden carp, exactly where to cast his nets. A yaksha patrolling the river overheard and told the Dragon King of the Jing River that at this rate the river would be emptied. The furious dragon king seized his sword, but his court of fish and crab officials warned that his clouds and rain would frighten the city and anger heaven; he should investigate first. Disguised as a tall white-robed scholar, he went to West Gate Street and found a crowded booth with the sign of the diviner Yuan Shoucheng, uncle of the court astronomer Yuan Tiangang.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第十回。claim.v0330.xyj_origins.09
10

龙王的赌局The dragon king's wager

龙王挤进卦铺，见袁守诚相貌稀奇、仪容秀丽，便请他占卜一课。袁守诚问：问什么事？龙王说：请卜天上阴晴事如何。袁守诚袖传一课，断道：云迷山顶，雾罩林梢。若占雨泽，准在明朝。龙王问：明天什么时辰下雨？雨有多少尺寸？袁守诚说：明日辰时布云，巳时发雷，午时下雨，未时雨足，共得水三尺三寸零四十八点。龙王笑道：此言不可作戏。如果明天有雨，依你断的时辰、数目，我送你课金五十两奉谢；如果差了些儿，没有雨，或者时辰数目不对，我就打坏你的门面，扯碎你的招牌，即时赶出长安，不许你在此惑众！袁守诚欣然说：这个一定任你。请了，请了，明日雨后来会。龙王辞别回到水府，对水族们夸口：那个卖卦的说明天有雨，还说了时辰点数，我和他打赌了。下雨的事全在我身上，我说不下就不下，看他还怎么胡说！众水族都笑着说：大王是八河都总管、司雨大龙神，有雨无雨，只有大王知道，他怎敢这样乱言？那卖卦的输定了！正在说笑，半空中有人叫道：泾河龙王接旨！原来是一位金衣力士，捧着玉帝的敕旨，写的是：敕命八河总，驱雷掣电行；明朝施雨泽，普济长安城。旨意上的时辰数目，和袁守诚断的毫发不差。龙王吓得魂飞魄散，过了好一会儿才说：尘世上竟有这样灵通的人，真是能通天彻地，我这一赌是输定了！鲥军师在旁边出主意：大王放心，要赢他有何难处？明天下雨时，只要稍稍错一错时辰，克一克点数，就说他断卦不准，还怕不赢？龙王依了。第二天，他故意把时辰推后，到午时才布云、未时才落雨，又少下了三寸八点，雨停以后，又变作秀士，到西门街卦铺前，二话不说，把袁守诚的招牌、笔砚一齐打得粉碎。

The dragon king asked about tomorrow's weather. Yuan Shoucheng answered: clouds at the hour of the dragon, thunder at the snake, rain at noon, ending at the goat, three feet three inches and forty-eight drops. The dragon king wagered fifty taels against Yuan's sign and his livelihood, and back in his palace he boasted that rain was his to give. Just then a golden-robed officer brought the Jade Emperor's decree, ordering exactly that rain at exactly those hours. Terrified, he took his adviser's advice: shift the hours a little and hold back a little rain, and the bet was won. Next day he delayed the rain and gave three inches eight drops less, then went to West Gate Street and smashed the fortune-teller's sign, brushes and inkstone.

Evidence / 证据《西游记》第十回。claim.v0330.xyj_origins.10
11

梦中斩龙Beheaded in a dream

袁守诚坐在那里纹丝不动，龙王又抡起门板就打，骂道：你这妄言祸福的妖人，擅惑众心的泼汉！你的卦不灵，言语虚谬，说今日下雨的时辰点数都不对，你还敢高坐在上？快滚出去，饶你死罪！袁守诚仰面朝天冷笑道：我不怕，我不怕！我无死罪，只怕你倒有个死罪哩！别人好瞒，只是难瞒我。我认得你，你不是秀士，乃是泾河龙王。你违了玉帝敕旨，改了时辰，克了点数，犯了天条。你在那剐龙台上，恐怕难免一刀，你还在这里骂我？龙王一听，心惊胆战，毛骨悚然，急忙丢下门板，整衣伏礼，向先生跪下说：先生休怪，前言戏之耳，岂知弄假成真，果然违犯天条，奈何？望先生救我一救！不然，我死也不放你。袁守诚说：我救你不得，只是指条生路给你投生便了。你明日午时三刻，该赴人曹官魏征处听斩。你果要性命，须当急急去告当今唐太宗皇帝方好——那魏征是唐王驾下的丞相，若是讨他个人情，方保无事。龙王含泪辞去。这天夜里，龙王闯进太宗的梦中，跪在面前哀告：陛下救我！我是泾河龙王，犯了天条，该陛下的贤臣魏征处斩，故来拜求，望陛下救我一救！太宗在梦中答应了。第二天早朝散后，太宗特意留下魏征，叫他进宫下棋，想把他拖过午时三刻。两人一着一着地下到午时三刻，一盘残局未了，魏征忽然伏在棋盘上，鼾鼾地睡着了。太宗笑道：贤卿真是匡扶社稷，心劳力倦，所以不觉盹睡。任他睡着，也不叫醒。不多时魏征醒来，俯伏在地说：臣该万死！臣刚才一时昏迷，不知所为，望陛下赦臣慢君之罪。太宗问他做了什么，魏征说：臣的身子在君前，梦却离了陛下，驾云去剐龙台上，斩了一条龙。话音未落，秦叔宝、徐茂功等人飞报进来：千步廊南边十字街头，云端里落下一颗龙头，血淋淋的，特来启奏！

Yuan Shoucheng laughed at the wrecked booth: he knew the scholar was the Jing River dragon king, who by changing heaven's decree had earned execution at a quarter past noon tomorrow — and the executioner would be Chief Minister Wei Zheng. The terrified dragon begged for help, and Yuan advised him to plead with Emperor Taizong. That night the dragon appeared in the emperor's dream, and Taizong promised to save him. Next day the emperor kept Wei Zheng at chess; at a quarter past noon Wei Zheng fell asleep over the board, and the emperor let him rest. Waking, Wei Zheng confessed that in his dream he had left his body and beheaded a dragon — and just then Qin Shubao and Xu Maogong ran in to report that a bleeding dragon's head had fallen from the clouds.

门神与太宗之死The door gods and the emperor's death

太宗见了龙头，心中又惊又悔，回宫后闷闷不乐。到了夜里二更时分，只听得宫门外有号泣之声，泾河龙王的冤魂手提着一颗血淋淋的首级，高叫：唐太宗！还我命来！还我命来！你昨夜满口许诺救我，怎么天明时反宣人曹官来斩我？你出来，你出来！我与你到阎君处折辩折辩！他扯住太宗再三不放，太宗箝口难言，只挣得汗流遍体。正在难分难解之时，只见正南上香云缭绕，彩雾飘飘，有一个女真人上前，将杨柳枝用手一摆，那没头的龙悲悲啼啼，往西北而去——原来这是观音菩萨暗中护持。可是从这以后，太宗夜夜不得安宁，梦中常有鬼魅抛砖弄瓦，三宫六院都不得安生，太宗的身体一天天衰弱下去。大将秦叔宝和尉迟敬德自告奋勇，全身披挂，手持金瓜钺斧，整夜站在宫门外守卫。一夜过去，果然平安无事。太宗心疼两位将军彻夜辛苦，就叫巧手丹青画了两人的真容，照他们披挂的样子贴在宫门两边，从此夜夜无事。后人就把他们当作门神，世代相传。前门安静了，后门又响起砖瓦声来，魏征便手提那口诛龙的宝剑，侍立在后宰门前，彻夜不睡，那后门也就安静了。可是太宗的病仍然一天重似一天，眼看就要不起了。魏征从袖中取出一封书信说：陛下宽心，臣有一事，管保陛下长生。阴司里有个判官，名叫崔珏，是太上先皇帝驾前的臣子，先受兹州令，后升礼部侍郎，在世时和臣是八拜之交，相交甚厚。他如今掌管阴司的生死文簿。请陛下把这封书信带去，见了他自会照应。太宗接过书信，笼在袖里，便瞑目而亡。

From then on the dragon's ghost came at night carrying its head, crying to Taizong to give back its life and come argue before the judges of the dead; once a heavenly lady waved a willow sprig and drove it off — Guanyin protecting him unseen. But the haunting went on and the emperor grew weak. The generals Qin Shubao and Yuchi Jingde stood guard at the palace gate all night in full armour, and the ghost did not dare come; to spare them, the emperor had their portraits painted and hung on the gate — which, the novel says, is why households paste them up as door gods. When the ghost turned to the back gate, Wei Zheng guarded it with the sword that had killed the dragon. Still the emperor's illness worsened. Wei Zheng gave him a letter for his sworn friend Cui Jue, a former minister now keeper of the underworld registers, and Taizong died with it in his sleeve.
