01

射箭比赛The archery contest

十二项任务完成以后，赫拉克勒斯回到了忒拜。他把妻子墨伽拉嫁给了侄子伊俄拉俄斯，自己想要重新成家。这时他听说，俄卡利亚的国王欧律托斯——就是当年教他射箭的那位老师——宣布要把女儿伊俄勒许配给能在射箭比赛中赢过他和他的儿子们的人。赫拉克勒斯来到俄卡利亚参加比赛。比赛开始了，国王和他的儿子们都是出名的神射手，可是赫拉克勒斯的箭射得比他们所有人都准，他赢得了比赛。然而欧律托斯却不肯把女儿嫁给他。只有欧律托斯的长子伊菲托斯说，应该把伊俄勒交给赫拉克勒斯，因为他是公平地赢来的；可是欧律托斯和其他的儿子们都反对，他们说：我们害怕，如果他有了孩子，会再一次发疯，把孩子们也杀死。赫拉克勒斯受到了侮辱，愤怒地离开了俄卡利亚。这次被拒绝在他心里埋下了怨恨，也埋下了日后一连串灾难的种子。

After the labours Heracles returned to Thebes and gave Megara to his nephew Iolaus; he wished to marry again. Hearing that Eurytus, prince of Oechalia — who had once taught him archery — offered his daughter Iole as a prize to whoever should beat him and his sons at archery, he went to Oechalia and outshot them all. Yet Eurytus would not give him the bride. Only his eldest son Iphitus said Iole should be given to Heracles, who had won her fairly; Eurytus and the other sons refused, saying they feared that if he had children he would kill them again. Insulted, Heracles left Oechalia in anger, and the refusal sowed the seed of later disasters.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.6.1。claim.v0340.heracles_3.01
02

城墙上的推落The fall from the walls

不久以后，有人从优卑亚岛偷走了欧律托斯的牛——偷牛的其实是有名的盗贼奥托吕科斯。欧律托斯却认定是赫拉克勒斯干的，因为他在比赛后愤怒地离开了。只有伊菲托斯不相信朋友会做这种事，他独自出发去找赫拉克勒斯。他在路上遇到了刚从斐赖回来的赫拉克勒斯——赫拉克勒斯刚刚在那里为国王阿德墨托斯从死神手里救回了死去的王后阿尔刻斯提斯。伊菲托斯邀请赫拉克勒斯和他一起去寻找丢失的牛群，赫拉克勒斯答应了，并在提任斯热情地款待了他。可是，疯狂又一次降临到了赫拉克勒斯身上。在疯狂中，他把伊菲托斯从提任斯的城墙上扔了下去，杀死了这个唯一相信他、为他说话的朋友。清醒之后，赫拉克勒斯想要洗去这桩血罪。他先去找皮洛斯的国王涅琉斯，涅琉斯是欧律托斯的朋友，拒绝为他净罪；后来他到了阿米克莱，由希波吕托斯的儿子得伊福玻斯为他净了罪。可是杀害客人的罪太重了，他还是患上了一种可怕的疾病，久治不愈。

Not long after, cattle were stolen from Euboea by the thief Autolycus, and Eurytus supposed Heracles had done it. Iphitus did not believe it and went to find Heracles, meeting him as he came from Pherae, where he had just saved the dead Alcestis for Admetus. Iphitus invited him to help seek the cattle; Heracles promised and entertained him at Tiryns. But madness came on him again, and he threw Iphitus from the walls of Tiryns — the one friend who had believed in him. Seeking purification, he went to Neleus at Pylos, who as a friend of Eurytus refused him; at Amyclae Deiphobus, son of Hippolytus, purified him. But for the murder of his guest he was afflicted with a dire disease.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.6.2。claim.v0340.heracles_3.02
03

争夺三足鼎The struggle for the tripod

为了治好这场病，赫拉克勒斯来到德尔斐，向阿波罗求问。可是德尔斐的女祭司皮提亚拒绝回答一个杀害客人的罪人。赫拉克勒斯怒火中烧，要抢劫神庙，把女祭司坐着说神谕的三足鼎扛走，自己另立一个神谕所。阿波罗大怒，亲自下来与他搏斗。神与英雄在神庙里扭打在一起，一个是宙斯最心爱的神子，一个是宙斯最强壮的凡人儿子。众神之父宙斯不愿看见两个儿子互相残杀，就在他们中间掷下一道雷电，把他们分开了。三足鼎终于回到了原处，皮提亚这才给了赫拉克勒斯一个神谕：如果你想摆脱疾病，就必须被卖为奴隶，服役三年，并把卖身的钱作为赎罪金交给伊菲托斯的家人欧律托斯。赫拉克勒斯接受了这个判决。神的使者赫尔墨斯把他带到亚细亚，像卖一个普通的奴隶一样把他卖掉了。买下他的，是吕底亚的女王翁法勒，她是伊阿耳达涅斯的女儿，丈夫特摩罗斯死后，她独自统治着吕底亚。而欧律托斯拒绝接受这笔赎罪金。

Seeking a cure, Heracles went to Delphi, but the Pythian priestess would not answer him. In anger he tried to plunder the temple, carry off the tripod and institute an oracle of his own. Apollo fought him, and Zeus threw a thunderbolt between them to part his sons. Then Heracles received the oracle: his disease would be cured if he were sold, served three years, and paid the price as compensation to Eurytus for the murder. Hermes sold him, and he was bought by Omphale, daughter of Iardanes, queen of Lydia, who had ruled since her husband Tmolus died. Eurytus would not accept the compensation.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.6.2–2.6.3。claim.v0340.heracles_3.03
04

女王的奴仆Servant of the queen

赫拉克勒斯成了吕底亚女王翁法勒的奴仆，替她清除国中的恶人。在以弗所附近，他抓住了刻耳科珀斯——一伙专在路上捉弄、抢劫行人的家伙，把他们捆了起来。在奥利斯，有一个名叫绪琉斯的人，强迫过路的陌生人为他翻挖葡萄园。赫拉克勒斯连根拔起了他的葡萄藤，把它们烧掉，杀死了绪琉斯和他的女儿克塞诺多刻。他还在多利刻岛上看见了伊卡洛斯的尸体，那个少年因为飞得离太阳太近，翅膀融化，坠海而死，赫拉克勒斯把他埋葬了。《书库》说，正是在赫拉克勒斯为翁法勒服役的这几年里，希腊发生了许多大事：伊阿宋率领阿尔戈英雄们远航科尔基斯去取金羊毛，英雄们在卡吕冬猎杀野猪，年轻的忒修斯从特罗曾出发，沿途清除了地峡上的强盗。后世作家喜欢讲赫拉克勒斯在翁法勒身边穿上女装、纺纱织布的故事，可是《书库》并没有这样写，这里也不补进去。三年期满，赫拉克勒斯的病痊愈了，他又成了一个自由的人。

As Omphale's servant Heracles rid her land of wrongdoers. Near Ephesus he caught and bound the Cercopes, who robbed travellers; at Aulis he dealt with Syleus, who forced passing strangers to dig his vineyard, burning the vines root and all and killing Syleus with his daughter Xenodoce. On the island of Doliche he found the body of Icarus washed ashore and buried it. It was during these years of servitude, says the Library, that the voyage of the Argo to Colchis and the hunt of the Calydonian boar took place, and that Theseus came from Troezen and cleared the Isthmus of malefactors. Later writers tell of Heracles dressed as a woman and spinning wool for Omphale, but the Library does not, and it is not added here. When the three years were over, Heracles was rid of his disease and free.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.6.3。claim.v0340.heracles_3.04
05

攻陷特洛伊The sack of Troy

服役期满，赫拉克勒斯没有忘记当年对特洛伊国王拉俄墨冬发下的誓言。他召集了一支军队，乘着十八条五十桨的长船，驶向伊利昂。拉俄墨冬带兵袭击了留守船只的人，杀死了俄伊克勒斯，可是被赶了回去，特洛伊城被团团围住。攻城的时候，赫拉克勒斯的战友忒拉蒙第一个打破城墙冲进了城里，赫拉克勒斯紧随其后。看见有人比自己先进城，赫拉克勒斯拔出剑冲向忒拉蒙，他不能容忍有人被认为比他更勇敢。忒拉蒙看见了，急中生智，开始搬起地上的石头堆垒。赫拉克勒斯问他在做什么，忒拉蒙说：我在为光荣的胜利者赫拉克勒斯建一座祭坛。赫拉克勒斯的怒气顿时消了。他攻下了城市，射死了拉俄墨冬和他的儿子们，只留下了波达耳刻斯。他把公主赫西俄涅作为奖赏交给忒拉蒙，允许她从俘虏中带走一个人。赫西俄涅选择了弟弟波达耳刻斯。赫拉克勒斯说：他必须先成为奴隶，你得拿出一样东西来赎他。赫西俄涅取下头上的面纱交给了他。从此，波达耳刻斯被叫作普里阿摩斯，意思是“被赎买的人”——他就是后来特洛伊战争时的特洛伊国王。

His servitude over, Heracles sailed against Ilium with eighteen fifty-oared ships. Laomedon attacked the ships and slew Oicles but was driven back, and the city was besieged. Telamon was the first to breach the wall and enter, with Heracles after him; seeing Telamon first, Heracles drew his sword on him, unwilling that anyone be reckoned braver. Telamon, seeing it, began to collect stones, and when Heracles asked what he was doing, said he was building an altar to Heracles the Glorious Victor. Heracles was appeased. He took the city, shot Laomedon and his sons except Podarces, and gave Hesione to Telamon as a prize, allowing her to take any captive she chose. She chose her brother Podarces; Heracles said he must first become a slave and she must give something for him, and she gave the veil from her head. So Podarces was called Priam, 'the bought one' — the Priam who would be king of Troy in the great war.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.6.4。claim.v0340.heracles_3.05
06

巨人之战与奥林匹亚The giants and Olympia

赫拉克勒斯从特洛伊返航时，赫拉又一次和他作对，向大海降下了猛烈的风暴。宙斯为此大怒，把赫拉吊在了奥林匹斯山上。赫拉克勒斯的船被吹到了科斯岛，岛上的人以为他们是海盗，向他们扔石头。赫拉克勒斯在夜里攻上岸，占领了科斯岛。随后，雅典娜把他带到了佛勒格拉，那里正在进行众神与巨人之间的大战。原来众神得到神谕：没有一个凡人的帮助，众神就杀不死巨人。于是赫拉克勒斯站在众神一边，用他的毒箭射倒了一个又一个巨人。回到希腊后，他没有忘记奥革阿斯当年赖掉工钱的事。他召集了阿耳卡狄亚的军队，出征厄利斯，起初中了摩利俄涅双子的埋伏，后来在克勒俄奈杀死了他们，攻下厄利斯，杀死了奥革阿斯，让当年为他作证的费琉斯做了国王。据《书库》记载，他在那里举行了奥林匹克竞技会，为珀罗普斯建了祭坛，又为十二位神建起了六座祭坛。此后，他还攻下了皮洛斯，杀死了能变化形状的珀里克吕墨诺斯和国王涅琉斯的儿子们，只放过了年轻的涅斯托耳。

As Heracles sailed from Troy, Hera sent grievous storms, at which Zeus in anger hung her from Olympus. Heracles was driven to Cos, where the people pelted his ships with stones, taking them for pirates; he took the island by night. Then, through Athena, he came to Phlegra and fought with the gods against the giants, for the gods had an oracle that they could not kill the giants without a mortal's help. Back in Greece he marched an Arcadian army against Augeas, who had cheated him; at first ambushed by the Molionides, he later killed them at Cleonae, took Elis, slew Augeas and made Phyleus king. There, says the Library, he celebrated the Olympian games, founded an altar of Pelops and built six altars of the twelve gods. He also took Pylos, killing the shape-shifting Periclymenus and the sons of Neleus, all except young Nestor.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.7.1–2.7.3。claim.v0340.heracles_3.06
07

与河神摔跤Wrestling the river

赫拉克勒斯来到卡吕冬，向国王俄纽斯的女儿得伊阿尼拉求婚。得伊阿尼拉是英雄墨勒阿革洛斯的妹妹，赫拉克勒斯在冥府里曾见过那位英雄的亡魂。可是得伊阿尼拉已经有一个可怕的求婚者：河神阿刻罗俄斯。为了得到她，赫拉克勒斯必须与河神摔跤。阿刻罗俄斯能变化形状，在搏斗中变成了一头公牛，低着头向赫拉克勒斯冲来。赫拉克勒斯抓住了公牛的角，用尽全力一拧，竟把一只角折断了下来。阿刻罗俄斯认输了。为了要回自己的角，他把另一只角——阿玛尔忒亚之角——交给了赫拉克勒斯。阿玛尔忒亚是海摩尼俄斯的女儿，她有一只公牛的角，据斐瑞库得斯说，这只角能让人想要什么吃的喝的，就源源不断地流出什么来。赫拉克勒斯把这只神奇的角还给了河神，赢得了得伊阿尼拉。他们在卡吕冬住了一段时间，生下了儿子许罗斯。可是不久，在俄纽斯家的一次宴会上，少年侍者欧诺摩斯为赫拉克勒斯倒水洗手，赫拉克勒斯随手用指节敲了他一下，竟把少年打死了。虽然少年的父亲原谅了他，赫拉克勒斯还是按照法律，带着妻子和孩子离开卡吕冬，开始了又一次流放。

Heracles went to Calydon to woo Deianira, daughter of Oeneus. To win her he wrestled her other suitor, the river god Achelous, who turned himself into a bull; Heracles seized a horn and broke it off. Achelous, to get it back, gave him the horn of Amalthea — daughter of Haemonius, who had a bull's horn which, says Pherecydes, could supply meat or drink in abundance, whatever one wished — and so Heracles won Deianira, and their son Hyllus was born. But at a feast, when the boy Eunomus poured water on his hands, Heracles struck him with his knuckles and killed him. Though the boy's father pardoned him, Heracles, as the law required, went into exile with his wife and child.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.7.5–2.7.6。claim.v0340.heracles_3.07
08

涅索斯的血The blood of Nessus

赫拉克勒斯带着得伊阿尼拉，向特剌喀斯去投奔国王刻宇克斯，途中来到欧厄诺斯河边。马人涅索斯住在河边，据说他因为为人正直，从众神那里得到了摆渡的差事，专门背着过路人渡河。赫拉克勒斯自己蹚水过了河，让涅索斯把得伊阿尼拉背过去。可是到了河中央，涅索斯起了歹念，要侮辱得伊阿尼拉。得伊阿尼拉大声呼救，赫拉克勒斯听见了，等涅索斯一爬上岸，就一箭射穿了他的心脏。涅索斯知道自己活不成了，临死前却设下了一个恶毒的圈套。他把得伊阿尼拉叫到身边，悄声对她说：如果你想要一种能让赫拉克勒斯永远爱你的灵药，就把我流在地上的精液和从箭伤里流出的血混在一起，好好收藏起来。得伊阿尼拉信以为真，照他说的做了，把这些血收集起来，秘密地保存着。她不知道，赫拉克勒斯的箭头上浸着九头蛇许德拉的剧毒，涅索斯的血早已变成了致命的毒药。这个秘密将在多年后，以最可怕的方式揭开。

Going with Deianira to Ceyx at Trachis, Heracles came to the river Evenus, where the centaur Nessus — who, they say, had received the post from the gods for his righteousness — ferried passengers across for hire. Heracles crossed by himself and entrusted Deianira to Nessus, who tried to violate her as he carried her over. She cried out; Heracles heard and, when Nessus came out of the river, shot him to the heart. Dying, Nessus called Deianira and told her that if she would have a love charm to use on Heracles, she should mix the seed he had dropped on the ground with the blood that flowed from the wound of the barb. She did so and kept it by her, not knowing that the arrow had been dipped in the hydra's poison, and that the charm was deadly.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.7.6。claim.v0340.heracles_3.08
09

攻陷俄卡利亚The fall of Oechalia

在特剌喀斯，国王刻宇克斯接纳了赫拉克勒斯一家。此后的几年里，赫拉克勒斯打败了德律俄珀斯人，帮助多里斯人的国王埃癸弥俄斯打败了拉庇泰人，又在伊托诺斯与战神阿瑞斯的儿子库克诺斯单打独斗，杀死了他。可是他心里一直没有忘记俄卡利亚的那场射箭比赛和欧律托斯的侮辱。回到特剌喀斯后，他召集了一支军队，向俄卡利亚进发，要惩罚欧律托斯。他和盟友们攻下了俄卡利亚城，杀死了欧律托斯和他的儿子们，把公主伊俄勒作为俘虏带走了。在归途中，他在优卑亚岛的刻奈翁海角停下，要为刻奈翁的宙斯建一座祭坛，举行隆重的献祭，感谢神赐给他的胜利。为了献祭，他需要一件华美的祭服，就派传令官利卡斯回特剌喀斯，向得伊阿尼拉去取。利卡斯回到家里，得伊阿尼拉向他打听丈夫的消息，从他口中得知了伊俄勒的事。她害怕丈夫爱这个年轻美丽的姑娘胜过爱自己，心里充满了恐惧和忧伤。

At Trachis Ceyx received Heracles and his family. In the years that followed he subdued the Dryopes, helped Aegimius, king of the Dorians, against the Lapiths, and killed Cycnus, son of Ares, in single combat at Itonus. But he had not forgotten Eurytus's insult. Returning to Trachis, he mustered an army against Oechalia, took the city with his allies, killed Eurytus and his sons, and led Iole away captive. On the way back he put in at Cenaeum in Euboea to build an altar of Cenaean Zeus and offer a great sacrifice, and sent his herald Lichas to Trachis to fetch fine raiment from Deianira. From Lichas she learned about Iole, and she feared that Heracles would love the young woman more than her.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.7.7。claim.v0340.heracles_3.09
10

致命的长袍The deadly robe

得伊阿尼拉想起了涅索斯临死前的话。她以为那真是一种爱情的灵药，能让丈夫的心回到自己身边，就把保存多年的血涂在了一件长袍上，交给利卡斯带去。赫拉克勒斯穿上了长袍，开始献祭。随着祭坛上的火越烧越旺，长袍也被烤热了，浸在血里的许德拉的毒性发作起来，开始腐蚀他的皮肤。剧烈的疼痛让他发狂。他抓住送来长袍的利卡斯的双脚，把他从海角上扔进了大海。他想把长袍从身上撕下来，可是长袍紧紧地粘在他的身上，撕下来的时候，连他的皮肉也一起被撕了下来。赫拉克勒斯在这样悲惨的境况中被抬上了船，送回特剌喀斯。得伊阿尼拉得知了发生的一切，明白自己被涅索斯骗了，亲手害死了自己的丈夫，悲痛绝望地上吊自尽了。一个打败了狮子、九头蛇和冥府恶犬的英雄，最终却死于一个早已死去的马人的诡计，和一个深爱他的妻子的误会。

Remembering Nessus's words, Deianira supposed the blood was truly a love charm and smeared a tunic with it. Heracles put it on and began to sacrifice. As the tunic grew warm, the hydra's poison began to eat his skin. He lifted Lichas by the feet and hurled him from the headland into the sea, and tore off the tunic, which clung to his body so that his flesh was torn away with it. In this sad plight he was carried on shipboard to Trachis, and Deianira, learning what had happened, hanged herself. The hero who had overcome the lion, the hydra and the hound of Hades was destroyed at last by the trick of a long-dead centaur and the mistake of a loving wife.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.7.7。claim.v0340.heracles_3.10
11

俄塔山上的火The fire on Oeta

赫拉克勒斯知道自己的生命快要走到尽头了。他把和得伊阿尼拉生的长子许罗斯叫到身边，嘱咐他：等你长大成人，就娶伊俄勒为妻。然后，他让人抬着自己来到特剌喀斯境内的俄塔山上，在山顶上堆起了一座高高的火葬堆。他自己爬上火葬堆，躺了下来，命令周围的人点火。可是没有一个人敢动手，谁也不愿亲手烧死这位伟大的英雄。这时，波亚斯——后来的英雄菲罗克忒忒斯的父亲——正好路过，他是出来寻找走失的羊群的。赫拉克勒斯请他点火，波亚斯点燃了火葬堆。为了报答他，赫拉克勒斯把自己那张从不落空的弓送给了他。火焰冲天而起。就在火葬堆熊熊燃烧的时候，一片云从赫拉克勒斯的身下飘过，随着一声响雷，把他托起，送上了天空。凡人的身体在火中消失了，而宙斯的儿子升上了奥林匹斯山。

Knowing his end was near, Heracles charged Hyllus, his elder son by Deianira, to marry Iole when he came of age. Then he had himself carried to Mount Oeta in the territory of Trachis, built a pyre there, mounted it and ordered it to be kindled. No one would do it, until Poeas — father of the hero Philoctetes — passing by in search of his flocks, set it alight; and Heracles gave him his bow. While the pyre was burning, a cloud passed under Heracles and with a peal of thunder bore him up to heaven. The mortal body vanished in the fire, and the son of Zeus rose to Olympus.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.7.7。claim.v0340.heracles_3.11
12

天上的婚礼与人间的子孙A wedding in heaven, heirs on earth

赫拉克勒斯在天上获得了永生。那个从他出生前就迫害他的天后赫拉，终于与他和解了，还把自己的女儿、青春女神赫柏嫁给了他。他和赫柏生了两个儿子，阿勒克夏瑞斯和阿尼刻托斯。可是在人间，他的子孙们还在受苦。赫拉克勒斯升天之后，他的儿子们为了躲避欧律斯透斯，逃到了特剌喀斯的刻宇克斯那里。欧律斯透斯要求刻宇克斯交出他们，并威胁要发动战争，赫拉克勒斯的子孙们害怕连累刻宇克斯，离开特剌喀斯，流浪到了雅典。他们坐在雅典广场上的“慈悲祭坛”前，请求庇护。雅典人拒绝交出他们，与欧律斯透斯开战。在战斗中，欧律斯透斯的儿子们都被杀死了，欧律斯透斯自己乘着马车逃跑，许罗斯一直追赶他，在斯喀戎悬崖附近杀死了他，砍下了他的头，交给了祖母阿尔克墨涅。阿尔克墨涅用织布的梭子挖出了这个害了她儿子一生的人的眼睛。就这样，从宙斯那句誓言开始的恩怨，在赫拉克勒斯的儿子手中结束了。

In heaven Heracles obtained immortality; reconciled at last with Hera, who had persecuted him from before his birth, he married her daughter Hebe, goddess of youth, and had by her two sons, Alexiares and Anicetus. But on earth his sons fled from Eurystheus to Ceyx at Trachis, and when Eurystheus demanded them and threatened war, they left for Athens and sat down at the altar of Mercy, claiming protection. The Athenians refused to surrender them and went to war with Eurystheus. His sons were slain, and as he fled in his chariot, Hyllus pursued and killed him near the Scironian cliffs, cut off his head and gave it to Alcmena, who gouged out its eyes with weaving pins. So the feud that began with Zeus's oath ended at the hands of Heracles's son.

Evidence / 证据《书库》2.7.7–2.8.1。claim.v0340.heracles_3.12

古希腊 / Ancient Greek

阿尔戈英雄 · 上部 远航The Argonauts, Part 1: the outward voyage

伊俄尔科斯的国王珀利阿斯得到神谕，要提防穿一只鞋的人，伊阿宋却恰恰在渡河时丢了一只鞋。国王派他去遥远的科尔基斯取回金羊毛。在雅典娜的指点下，人们造好了阿尔戈号，希腊最勇敢的英雄们都来参加：赫拉克勒斯、俄耳甫斯、双子兄弟、北风之子……他们在只有女人的楞诺斯岛停留，在库最科斯的黑夜里误杀了朋友，在密西亚失去了许拉斯和赫拉克勒斯；他们打败了拳王阿密科斯，替盲眼先知菲纽斯赶走了哈耳庇厄，穿过会互相撞击的岩石，最后在夜色中驶进了科尔基斯的法细斯河口。

Pelias, king of Iolcus, is warned by an oracle to beware the man with one sandal, and Jason loses a sandal crossing a river. The king sends him to distant Colchis for the golden fleece. With Athena's help the Argo is built, and the bravest heroes of Greece join: Heracles, Orpheus, the twin sons of Zeus, the sons of the North Wind. They linger on Lemnos, an island of women; kill a friend by mistake in the dark at Cyzicus; lose Hylas and Heracles in Mysia; defeat the boxer-king Amycus; free the blind seer Phineus from the Harpies; pass the Clashing Rocks; and at last, by night, sail into the mouth of the Phasis in Colchis.

01

一只鞋的人The man with one sandal

诗人先向阿波罗祈祷，然后讲起这个古老的故事。伊俄尔科斯的国王珀利阿斯得到过一个可怕的神谕：将来会有一个只穿一只鞋的人从乡下来，他将死在这个人的谋划之下。不久以后，珀利阿斯要向父亲波塞冬和其他众神举行献祭，召集了各地的人们前来参加，却唯独没有邀请天后赫拉。年轻的伊阿宋也应召而来。他在冬天渡过涨水的阿瑙洛斯河时，一只鞋陷在泥里，被急流冲走了，他只穿着一只鞋走进了献祭的人群。珀利阿斯一眼看见了他，想起了那个神谕，心中充满了恐惧。他想出了一个除掉伊阿宋的办法：给他一个充满危险的航海任务，让他在大海上或者异国的土地上丧命，永远回不了家。他命令伊阿宋去遥远的科尔基斯，把挂在那里的金羊毛取回来。那张金羊毛原本属于一只会飞的金色公羊，当年它驮着少年佛里克索斯逃到科尔基斯，佛里克索斯把它献给了宙斯，把羊毛送给了科尔基斯的国王埃厄忒斯。

The poet begins with a prayer to Apollo and tells the old story. Pelias, king of Iolcus, had heard an oracle that a man coming from the country with one sandal would be his death. Soon after, as Pelias was offering sacrifice to his father Poseidon and the other gods — but not to Hera — Jason came to the feast, having lost one sandal in the mud of the swollen river Anaurus as he waded across in winter. Seeing him, Pelias remembered the oracle and devised for him a perilous voyage, so that he might perish at sea or among strangers and never return: he ordered him to fetch the golden fleece from distant Colchis. It was the fleece of the golden ram that had carried the boy Phrixus to Colchis, where he sacrificed the ram to Zeus and gave the fleece to Aeetes, the king.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第一卷·开篇。claim.v0340.argo_1.01
02

阿尔戈号与英雄们The Argo and her heroes

伊阿宋接受了任务。造船的是阿瑞斯托耳的儿子阿耳戈斯，雅典娜亲自指点他，用珀利翁山上的松木造成了这条船，船的名字就叫阿尔戈号。雅典娜还把一块来自多多那的神圣橡木装进了船头，这块木头能像人一样说话。消息传开，全希腊最勇敢的英雄们纷纷赶来，要和伊阿宋一起远航。诗人一一列举了他们的名字：色雷斯的歌手俄耳甫斯，他的歌声能让岩石和树木跟着移动；宙斯的儿子、刚刚捉到厄律曼托斯野猪的赫拉克勒斯，他带着少年许拉斯；宙斯的双生子卡斯托耳和波吕丢刻斯，一个善于驯马，一个善于拳击；北风神玻瑞阿斯的两个儿子仄忒斯和卡拉伊斯，他们的脚踝上长着翅膀；目光锐利、能看穿地下的林叩斯；后来成为阿喀琉斯父亲的珀琉斯和他的兄弟忒拉蒙；掌舵的提费斯；预言家伊德蒙和摩普索斯；卡吕冬的墨勒阿革洛斯……一共五十多位英雄。他们都是神的儿子或者神的后代，被称作“阿尔戈英雄”。

Jason accepted. The ship was built by Argus, son of Arestor, under Athena's direction, from the pines of Pelion, and called Argo; into her prow Athena fitted a beam of sacred oak from Dodona that could speak with a human voice. The bravest heroes of Greece gathered to sail with Jason, and the poet names them: Orpheus the Thracian singer, whose songs moved rocks and trees; Heracles, son of Zeus, fresh from capturing the Erymanthian boar, with the young Hylas; the twin sons of Zeus, Castor the horseman and Polydeuces the boxer; Zetes and Calais, sons of the North Wind Boreas, with wings at their ankles; keen-eyed Lynceus, who could see beneath the earth; Peleus, father-to-be of Achilles, and his brother Telamon; Tiphys the helmsman; the seers Idmon and Mopsus; Meleager of Calydon — some fifty heroes, sons and descendants of gods, called the Argonauts.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第一卷·英雄名录。claim.v0340.argo_1.02
03

出航Setting sail

出发的日子到了。伊俄尔科斯的人们涌到海边送行，伊阿宋的母亲阿尔喀墨得紧紧抱着儿子，哭得像一个失去了依靠的小女孩，担心再也见不到他了。伊阿宋温和地安慰母亲，然后走向帕伽塞海港。英雄们聚集在船边，伊阿宋对他们说：我们应该选出一位最勇敢的人做首领，他将决定一切。众人的目光都转向了赫拉克勒斯，可是赫拉克勒斯坐在原地没有起身，他举起右手说：这份荣誉不应该给我，我不会接受，也不允许别人接受；召集我们的人，应该领导我们。于是，大家推举伊阿宋做了首领。他们向阿波罗献祭，预言家伊德蒙预言：这次远航会成功，但他自己将死在遥远的异乡。献祭后的宴会上，伊达斯喝醉了酒，口出狂言，冒犯神明，与伊德蒙争吵起来。俄耳甫斯拿起竖琴，唱起了一支歌：唱大地、天空和海洋怎样从混沌中分开，星辰和月亮怎样运行，古老的神怎样统治世界，直到宙斯为王。英雄们听得入了神，争吵也平息了。第二天清晨，他们登上阿尔戈号，在俄耳甫斯的琴声中划起桨，驶出了海港。

On the day of departure the people of Iolcus thronged the shore, and Jason's mother Alcimede clung to him weeping like a girl who has lost her protector. Jason comforted her and went down to Pagasae. There he asked the heroes to choose the bravest as their leader; all eyes turned to Heracles, but he stayed in his seat and, raising his right hand, refused the honour and would let no one else take it — the man who had gathered them should lead them. So they chose Jason. At the sacrifice to Apollo the seer Idmon foretold that the voyage would succeed but that he himself would die far away. At the feast Idas, drunk, spoke insolently against the gods and quarrelled with Idmon, and Orpheus took his lyre and sang how earth, heaven and sea were parted out of confusion, how the stars and moon keep their courses, and how the old gods ruled until Zeus became king. Spellbound, the heroes forgot their quarrel; next morning they rowed out of the harbour to the sound of his lyre.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第一卷·出航。claim.v0340.argo_1.03
04

女人的岛The island of women

阿尔戈号来到了楞诺斯岛。这座岛上只住着女人。原来，楞诺斯的妇女们多年来不敬奉爱神阿佛洛狄忒，女神让她们的丈夫厌弃了她们，男人们从色雷斯掳来了女俘，和她们生活在一起。楞诺斯的妇女们被激怒了，在一夜之间杀死了岛上所有的男人，连孩子也没有放过，免得将来有人报仇。只有年轻的女王许普西皮勒偷偷救下了自己的父亲托阿斯，把他装进一只箱子，放到海上漂走了。现在，女人们看见一条船驶来，以为是色雷斯人来报复，都拿起了武器。传令官上岸说明来意后，许普西皮勒召集妇女们开会。一位老妇人说：我们这些年老的人终将死去，年轻的人没有丈夫，没有孩子，将来谁来耕种土地，谁来保护这个岛？不如接纳这些英雄吧。于是，女王邀请伊阿宋进城，愿意把父亲的王位让给他。英雄们在岛上住了下来，日子一天天过去，他们几乎忘记了远航的使命。最后，赫拉克勒斯——他一直留在船上——把大家召集起来，严厉地责备他们：我们离开家乡，难道是为了在这里贪图享乐吗？英雄们惭愧地登上了船。许普西皮勒流着泪送别伊阿宋，请他将来不要忘记她。

The Argo came to Lemnos, an island of women only. Because they had long neglected Aphrodite, the goddess made their husbands turn from them to captive women from Thrace, and in one night the Lemnian women killed all the men, and the boys too, lest they take vengeance one day; only the young queen Hypsipyle saved her father Thoas, setting him adrift in a chest. Seeing a ship, the women took up arms, thinking the Thracians had come. When the herald explained, Hypsipyle called an assembly, and an old woman urged them to receive the strangers: the old would die, and who then would till the land and defend the island? So the queen invited Jason to the city and offered him her father's throne. The heroes stayed, and the days passed, until Heracles, who had stayed by the ship, called them together and rebuked them: had they left home to seek their pleasure here? Ashamed, they embarked, and Hypsipyle, weeping, bade Jason remember her.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第一卷·楞诺斯岛。claim.v0340.argo_1.04
05

黑夜里的误战Battle in the dark

离开楞诺斯，阿尔戈号穿过赫勒斯滂海峡，来到了普洛滂提斯海边的多利昂人的国家。年轻的国王库最科斯刚刚新婚，他热情地接待了英雄们，因为有神谕说，有一群神一样的英雄将要到来，他应该友好地对待他们。附近的山上住着一群地生的巨人，每个都长着六条胳膊。英雄们登山眺望时，巨人们用巨石堵塞海港，想困住阿尔戈号，留在船边的赫拉克勒斯一箭一箭射倒了他们，其他英雄也赶来，把巨人全部杀死。告别了库最科斯，英雄们扬帆出海，可是夜里起了逆风，把他们又吹回了多利昂人的海岸。黑暗中，谁也认不出谁。多利昂人以为是敌人来袭，拿起武器冲了过来，两边在黑夜里展开了激战。伊阿宋一枪刺中了冲在前面的国王库最科斯，把他杀死了。天亮以后，双方才发现了这场可怕的误会。英雄们和多利昂人一起痛哭，为库最科斯举行了三天的葬礼。年轻的王后克勒伊忒悲痛欲绝，上吊自尽了；林中的仙女们为她流下的眼泪，化成了一眼泉水。此后风暴一连刮了十二天，直到英雄们在丁底摩斯山上向众神之母瑞亚献祭，风才平息下来。

Leaving Lemnos the Argo passed the Hellespont to the land of the Doliones on the Propontis, whose young king Cyzicus, newly married, welcomed the heroes as an oracle had told him to. On the mountain lived earthborn giants with six arms each, who blocked the harbour with rocks while most of the heroes climbed to look out; Heracles, left by the ship, shot them down, and the others returned to finish them. The heroes sailed on, but at night contrary winds drove them back to the same shore, and in the darkness neither side knew the other. The Doliones, taking them for raiders, attacked, and Jason struck and killed King Cyzicus. At dawn both sides saw their dreadful mistake. Heroes and Doliones mourned together for three days; the young queen Cleite hanged herself, and the tears of the nymphs became a spring. Storms then raged for twelve days, until the heroes sacrificed to Rhea, mother of the gods, on Mount Dindymum.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第一卷·库最科斯。claim.v0340.argo_1.05
06

泉水中的少年The boy in the spring

风平浪静了，英雄们比赛划桨，看谁最后一个累倒。赫拉克勒斯力气最大，大家都累得划不动了，他还在用力划，结果把桨划断了。船停在密西亚海岸，赫拉克勒斯进树林去砍一棵松树，做一支新桨。他的少年伴侣许拉斯提着青铜水罐，去为晚饭打水。他找到了一眼泉水，泉水里住着一位水中仙女。月光下，仙女看见了俊美的少年，爱上了他。当许拉斯俯身把水罐伸进泉水的时候，仙女伸出左臂搂住他的脖子，用右手拉住他的手肘，把他拖进了泉水深处。英雄波吕斐摩斯听见了许拉斯的喊声，以为他被野兽或强盗抓走了，拔剑去追，路上遇见了赫拉克勒斯。赫拉克勒斯一听，汗水从额头上流下来，像被牛虻叮咬的公牛一样，在树林里狂奔呼喊。可是到了天亮，风向变了，舵手提费斯催促大家开船，谁也没有注意到赫拉克勒斯和波吕斐摩斯还没回来。等船驶出了很远，大家才发现他们不见了，忒拉蒙怒骂伊阿宋是故意把赫拉克勒斯丢下的。就在他们争吵的时候，海神格劳科斯从海里升起，告诉他们：这是宙斯的旨意，赫拉克勒斯注定要回去完成他的任务，波吕斐摩斯将在密西亚建立一座城市。

When the sea grew calm the heroes vied at rowing, and Heracles, the strongest, pulled until his oar broke. On the Mysian shore he went into the forest to cut a pine for a new oar, while young Hylas went with a bronze pitcher to fetch water for supper. In a spring dwelt a water-nymph who, seeing the beautiful boy in the moonlight, loved him; as he leaned to dip his pitcher, she put her left arm round his neck and drew him down by the elbow into the depths. Polyphemus heard his cry and ran with drawn sword, meeting Heracles, who rushed through the forest shouting like a bull stung by a gadfly. At dawn a breeze sprang up, Tiphys urged them aboard, and no one noticed that Heracles and Polyphemus were missing until the ship was far away; Telamon accused Jason of leaving Heracles behind on purpose. As they quarrelled, the sea god Glaucus rose from the water and told them it was Zeus's will that Heracles should return to his labours, and that Polyphemus would found a city in Mysia.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第一卷·许拉斯。claim.v0340.argo_1.06
07

拳王阿密科斯Amycus the boxer

第二天清晨，阿尔戈号来到了柏布律克斯人的国家。他们的国王阿密科斯是波塞冬的儿子，是一个傲慢无礼的大力士。他定下了一个野蛮的规矩：凡是来到他国土上的外乡人，都必须和他比拳，没有一个人能活着离开。他走到海边，对英雄们说：你们中间谁最会打拳，就出来和我比一比，否则别想离开这里。宙斯的儿子、最擅长拳击的波吕丢刻斯站了出来。阿密科斯身材高大，像巨人提丰的后代一样可怕；波吕丢刻斯则年轻英俊，像清晨的星辰一样明亮。两人戴上了生牛皮缠成的拳套，在海边展开了激烈的搏斗。阿密科斯像狂风卷起的巨浪，一次次向波吕丢刻斯扑来，波吕丢刻斯却灵巧地躲闪，寻找对手的破绽。最后，阿密科斯踮起脚尖，举起拳头要砸下来，波吕丢刻斯侧身一闪，一拳打在他的耳朵上方，打碎了他的骨头，阿密科斯倒地而死。柏布律克斯人拿着棍棒和长矛冲上来，要为国王报仇，英雄们与他们混战，把他们打得四散奔逃，然后把他们的牛羊赶上船，作为战利品。

Next morning the Argo came to the land of the Bebrycians, whose king Amycus, a son of Poseidon, had an outrageous law: no stranger might leave until he had boxed with him, and none had survived. He came down to the shore and challenged the best boxer among them. Polydeuces, son of Zeus, stood up — Amycus huge and fearsome like a monstrous son of Typhon, Polydeuces young and bright as the morning star. Binding their hands with thongs of rawhide, they fought on the shore, Amycus rushing on like a wave driven by the wind, Polydeuces nimbly avoiding him and watching for an opening. At last, as Amycus rose on tiptoe to bring down a heavy blow, Polydeuces slipped aside and struck him above the ear, breaking the bones, and he fell dead. The Bebrycians rushed on with clubs and spears, but the heroes routed them and carried off their flocks.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第二卷·阿密科斯。claim.v0340.argo_1.07
08

盲眼先知与哈耳庇厄The blind seer and the Harpies

阿尔戈号来到色雷斯海岸，英雄们遇见了盲眼的老先知菲纽斯。他因为把宙斯的计划毫无保留地告诉了凡人，受到了惩罚：宙斯让他活得很长，却夺走了他的视力，还派来了哈耳庇厄。每当有人给他送来食物，这些长着翅膀的怪物就从云中猛扑下来，把食物抢走，留下的一点也被她们弄得腐臭难闻，谁也不敢靠近。菲纽斯骨瘦如柴，扶着拐杖摸索着走到英雄们面前，说：我知道你们是谁，众神告诉过我，北风神的儿子们会来救我。仄忒斯和卡拉伊斯听了，十分同情他。英雄们为他摆上饭菜，哈耳庇厄立刻像闪电一样扑了下来。北风之子展开翅膀，拔剑追了上去，一直追到了遥远的海岛上，眼看就要追上她们。这时，彩虹女神伊里斯从天而降，拦住他们说：不许杀死哈耳庇厄，她们是伟大的宙斯的猎犬；我以冥河的名义起誓，她们再也不会去打扰菲纽斯了。北风之子这才转身回来，那些海岛从此被叫作“回转之岛”。菲纽斯终于吃上了一顿饱饭，为了报答英雄们，他详细地告诉他们前方的航路，以及如何穿过那可怕的撞岩。

On the Thracian coast the heroes found the blind old seer Phineus, punished by Zeus for revealing his designs to mortals: he was given long life but no sight, and the Harpies swooped from the clouds to snatch his food and befoul whatever they left. Bent and gaunt, he groped his way to the heroes and said he knew the sons of Boreas would save him. The heroes set food before him; the Harpies swooped down like lightning, and Zetes and Calais flew after them with drawn swords as far as distant islands, and would have caught them had not Iris come down and forbidden them to kill the hounds of great Zeus, swearing by the Styx that the Harpies would never trouble Phineus again. So the sons of Boreas turned back, and the islands were called the Islands of Turning. Phineus ate his fill at last, and in return told the heroes their course and how to pass the Clashing Rocks.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第二卷·菲纽斯。claim.v0340.argo_1.08
09

撞岩The Clashing Rocks

从色雷斯出发，阿尔戈号驶向黑海的入口。那里有两块巨大的岩石，叫作库阿涅埃——撞岩。它们没有扎根在海底，会不停地相互撞击，海水被撞得飞溅起来，发出雷鸣般的巨响，任何船只想从中间穿过，都会被撞得粉碎。菲纽斯曾教给他们一个办法：先放一只鸽子飞过去，如果鸽子能平安飞过，船就可以跟着冲过去；如果鸽子被撞死了，就赶紧掉头回去。英雄们来到岩石前，欧斐摩斯放出一只鸽子。两块岩石猛地合拢，只夹住了鸽子尾巴上的几根羽毛，鸽子平安飞了过去。岩石重新分开的那一刻，舵手提费斯高喊：用力划！英雄们拼命划桨，船冲进了两块岩石之间。可是一个巨浪迎面打来，船被推了回去，岩石又开始合拢。就在这千钧一发之际，雅典娜从天而降，左手抵住一块岩石，右手推了船一把，阿尔戈号像离弦的箭一样冲了出去，只有船尾的一点装饰被岩石夹碎了。从那以后，两块岩石就紧紧地靠在一起，再也不能移动了，因为众神早已注定：只要有一条船平安穿过，撞岩就会永远固定下来。

From Thrace the Argo made for the entrance of the Black Sea, where the Cyanean rocks, rooted in nothing, clashed together with a roar like thunder, crushing any ship that tried to pass. Phineus had told them to send a dove through first: if it passed safely, they should follow; if not, turn back. Euphemus loosed a dove; the rocks met and caught only the tip of her tail feathers, and she flew through. As the rocks parted, Tiphys cried to row hard, and the ship darted between them — but a great wave drove her back as the rocks closed. Then Athena, with her left hand holding back one rock and her right thrusting the ship, sent the Argo flying through like an arrow, with only the tip of her stern ornament shorn off. From that day the rocks stood fixed together, for it was fated that when a ship passed through alive they should move no more.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第二卷·撞岩。claim.v0340.argo_1.09
10

阿波罗的显现The epiphany of Apollo

穿过撞岩以后，英雄们沿着黑海南岸向东航行。黎明时分，他们在一座名叫提尼阿斯的荒岛上靠岸，忽然看见了阿波罗：他正从吕西亚前往遥远的北方许珀耳玻瑞亚人那里，金色的卷发垂在脸颊两旁，左手握着银弓，背上挂着箭袋，在他的脚下，整座岛都在颤动，海浪高高涌起。英雄们惊恐地低下头，不敢直视神的眼睛，直到他走过岛屿，向大海飞去。他们在岛上为“黎明的阿波罗”筑起祭坛，举行了献祭，俄耳甫斯唱起了赞美阿波罗的歌。随后，他们来到了马里安底诺人的国家，国王吕科斯热情地款待了他们，因为他们杀死了与他为敌的阿密科斯。可是厄运也降临了：预言家伊德蒙——他早就预言自己会死在远方——在河边的芦苇丛中被一头凶猛的野猪咬伤了大腿，死在了这里；不久，舵手提费斯也染上急病死去。英雄们在悲伤中坐了很久，不吃也不喝，以为再也回不了家了。这时，赫拉给了安开俄斯勇气，他站出来接替了舵手的位置，英雄们又重新出发了。

Past the Rocks, the heroes coasted east along the Black Sea. At dawn on the desert island of Thynias they saw Apollo on his way from Lycia to the far Hyperboreans, his golden locks hanging down, a silver bow in his left hand and a quiver on his back; the whole island quaked beneath his feet and the waves ran high. They bowed their heads in awe until he had passed over the sea, then built an altar to Apollo of the Dawn, and Orpheus sang his praises. In the land of the Mariandyni, King Lycus welcomed them for killing his enemy Amycus. But there the seer Idmon, as he had foretold, was gored in the thigh by a fierce boar in the reed-beds of a river and died, and soon the helmsman Tiphys died of a sudden sickness. The heroes sat in grief, not eating or drinking, despairing of return, until Hera put courage into Ancaeus, who took the helm, and they sailed on.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第二卷·提尼阿斯与马里安底诺人。claim.v0340.argo_1.10
11

战神岛的铁羽鸟The birds of the island of Ares

阿尔戈号继续向东，经过了亚马逊人居住的忒耳摩冬河口，经过了以打铁为生、从不耕种的卡吕柏斯人的国家，来到了战神阿瑞斯的岛屿。菲纽斯曾警告过他们，这座岛上住着阿瑞斯的鸟，它们会像射箭一样射下锋利的羽毛。英雄们刚刚靠近，一只鸟就飞过来，射下一根羽毛，扎进了俄伊琉斯的肩膀。安菲达马斯想出了一个办法：一半人划船，另一半人把盾牌举在头顶，紧紧地连在一起，像屋顶的瓦片一样，然后一齐大声呼喊，用长矛敲击盾牌。铁羽鸟被巨大的响声吓坏了，纷纷射下羽毛，羽毛像冰雹一样落在盾牌上，却伤不了人，最后鸟群飞过大海，逃走了。当天夜里，海上起了风暴，一条破船漂到了岛上，船上是四个年轻人——他们正是当年骑着金羊逃到科尔基斯的佛里克索斯的儿子，由长子阿耳戈斯带领，要去希腊收回祖父的遗产，却在海上遇难了。伊阿宋告诉他们，自己正是要去科尔基斯取金羊毛，请他们带路。阿耳戈斯说：埃厄忒斯是太阳神的儿子，残暴而强大，金羊毛由一条从不睡觉的巨蛇看守着。可是他们还是答应和英雄们一起前往。

Sailing east past the mouth of the Thermodon, where the Amazons live, and the land of the Chalybes, who work iron and never plough, the Argo came to the island of Ares. Phineus had warned them of the birds of Ares, which shoot their feathers like arrows; as they approached, one shot a feather into the shoulder of Oileus. Amphidamas devised a plan: half rowed while the rest held their shields over the ship, locked together like a roof of tiles, and all shouted and clashed their spears on their shields. Terrified by the din, the birds rained feathers like hail on the shields and fled over the sea. That night a storm brought a wrecked ship ashore with four young men — the sons of Phrixus, led by Argus, the eldest, who had set out for Greece to claim their grandfather's inheritance. Jason told them he was going to Colchis for the fleece and asked them to guide him; Argus warned that Aeetes, son of the Sun, was cruel and mighty and that a sleepless serpent guarded the fleece, but they agreed to go.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第二卷·战神岛。claim.v0340.argo_1.11
12

驶入法细斯河Into the river Phasis

阿尔戈号越过了黑海的东端。他们看见了高耸入云的高加索山，那里，普罗米修斯被锁在悬崖上。黄昏时分，他们看见一只巨大的鹰从头顶高高飞过，翅膀扇动的声音像船帆一样，向着山崖飞去；不久，他们听见了普罗米修斯痛苦的惨叫，那叫声在天空中回荡，直到那只鹰又从山上飞回来。当天夜里，在阿耳戈斯的指引下，他们驶进了宽阔的法细斯河口，终于到达了科尔基斯——黑海最远的尽头。左边是高加索山和科尔基斯的都城埃亚，右边是战神阿瑞斯的平原和圣林，金羊毛就挂在圣林里的一棵橡树上，由那条不睡觉的巨蛇日夜看守。伊阿宋从金杯里把蜂蜜和纯酒倒进河中，祭奠大地、当地的众神和死去英雄的灵魂，请求他们帮助。英雄们放下桅杆，把船悄悄地划进了河边浓密的芦苇丛中，在黑暗中隐藏起来，等待着天明。漫长的航程结束了，可是真正的考验，才刚刚开始。

The Argo reached the far end of the Black Sea. They saw the crags of the Caucasus, where Prometheus was bound; at evening a huge eagle flew high over the ship toward the cliffs with a sound of wings like sails, and soon they heard Prometheus's cries of agony echoing through the sky until the eagle flew back from the mountain. That night, guided by Argus, they entered the broad mouth of the Phasis and came to Colchis, the furthest bound of the sea: on the left the Caucasus and the city of Aea, on the right the plain and sacred grove of Ares, where the fleece hung on an oak guarded by the sleepless serpent. Jason poured honey and pure wine from a golden cup into the river as an offering to Earth, the gods of the land and the souls of dead heroes, and they lowered the mast and hid the ship in a dense reed-bed to wait for day. The long voyage was over; the real trial was about to begin.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第二卷·抵达科尔基斯。claim.v0340.argo_1.12

依据西顿 1912 年英文散文译本，按卷和情节顺序讲述阿波罗尼俄斯（公元前三世纪）的史诗；这是希腊化时代的文学作品，与更早的口传和其他作家的版本并不完全相同。

古希腊 / Ancient Greek

阿尔戈英雄 · 下部 金羊毛与归航The Argonauts, Part 2: the fleece and the return

赫拉和雅典娜请阿佛洛狄忒帮忙，小爱神厄洛斯一箭射中了科尔基斯的公主美狄亚，她爱上了伊阿宋。国王埃厄忒斯给伊阿宋出了一道致命的难题：驾驭喷火的铜蹄公牛，耕种战神的田地，种下龙牙，再杀死从地里长出的武士。美狄亚在父亲和异乡人之间痛苦挣扎，最终把魔药交给了伊阿宋。伊阿宋通过了考验，美狄亚又用歌声催眠了看守金羊毛的巨蛇。英雄们带着金羊毛和美狄亚逃走，为了摆脱追兵，伊阿宋设伏杀死了美狄亚的弟弟阿布绪耳托斯。这桩血罪让他们漂泊了更远的路：喀耳刻为他们净罪，海中仙女护送他们穿过漂浮岩，他们在费埃克斯人那里成婚，又被风暴吹到利比亚，扛着船穿越沙漠，美狄亚在克里特用魔眼打倒了铜人塔罗斯，英雄们终于回到了帕伽塞。

Hera and Athena ask Aphrodite's help, and Eros shoots Medea, princess of Colchis, so that she falls in love with Jason. King Aeetes sets a deadly trial: yoke fire-breathing bronze-footed bulls, plough the field of Ares, sow a serpent's teeth and slay the armed men who spring from the earth. Torn between her father and the stranger, Medea gives Jason a charm; he passes the trial, and she lulls the serpent guarding the fleece with her song. Fleeing with Medea and the fleece, Jason kills her brother Apsyrtus in an ambush, and the bloodshed drives them far astray: Circe purifies them, sea nymphs guide them past the Wandering Rocks, they marry among the Phaeacians, a storm casts them into Libya where they carry the ship across the desert, and in Crete Medea destroys the bronze giant Talos with her evil eye before they reach Pagasae at last.

01

三位女神Three goddesses

英雄们躲在法细斯河边的芦苇丛里，天上的赫拉和雅典娜却在为他们发愁：埃厄忒斯强大而残暴，单凭英雄们的勇气，是取不回金羊毛的。赫拉想出了一个主意：去请爱神阿佛洛狄忒帮忙，让她的儿子厄洛斯用箭射中埃厄忒斯的女儿美狄亚，让公主爱上伊阿宋。美狄亚是魔法女神赫卡忒的女祭司，精通各种草药和咒语，只有她能帮助伊阿宋。两位女神来到阿佛洛狄忒的宫殿，女神正坐在镜前梳理她的长发。阿佛洛狄忒有些惊讶，因为这两位女神平时很少来看她。赫拉说明来意，阿佛洛狄忒答应了，可是她说：我那个孩子顽皮得很，根本不听我的话。她在宙斯的果园里找到了厄洛斯，他正和美少年伽倪墨得斯玩羊踝骨，赢得满心欢喜。阿佛洛狄忒抚摸着他的脸说：如果你去射中美狄亚，让她爱上伊阿宋，我就把宙斯小时候玩过的那只金球送给你，它的光芒像一颗星。厄洛斯一听，扔下羊踝骨，背起箭袋，从奥林匹斯山上飞了下去，飞向科尔基斯。

While the heroes lay hidden in the reeds, Hera and Athena took counsel: Aeetes was too strong and cruel for courage alone to win the fleece. Hera proposed to ask Aphrodite to have her son Eros shoot Medea, Aeetes's daughter — a priestess of Hecate, skilled in herbs and spells, the one person who could help Jason — so that she would love him. They found Aphrodite combing her long hair, surprised at their rare visit; she agreed, though she said her boy would not obey her. She found Eros in Zeus's orchard playing knucklebones with Ganymede, gleeful at his winnings, and stroking his cheek promised him the golden ball that Zeus had played with as a child, gleaming like a star, if he would shoot Medea. Eros threw down his knucklebones, took up his quiver and flew down from Olympus to Colchis.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第三卷·三位女神。claim.v0340.argo_2.01
02

厄洛斯的箭The arrow of Eros

伊阿宋带着佛里克索斯的儿子们和两位同伴，走进了埃厄忒斯的王宫。赫拉为了让他们不被科尔基斯人发现，在城里降下了一层浓雾，直到他们走进宫殿才散去。宫殿雄伟壮丽，庭院里有四眼泉水，分别流出牛奶、美酒、香油和冬暖夏凉的清水，都是火神赫淮斯托斯为太阳神的儿子造的。佛里克索斯的遗孀、埃厄忒斯的大女儿卡尔喀俄珀看见自己的儿子们回来了，惊喜地扑上去拥抱他们。就在这一片喧闹中，美狄亚从房间里走了出来。厄洛斯悄悄地躲在门廊下，搭上一支箭，拉满了弓，蹲在伊阿宋的脚边，一箭射进了美狄亚的心里，然后大笑着飞走了。那支箭在美狄亚的心底像火焰一样燃烧起来。她的目光不由自主地投向伊阿宋，心跳加快，脸色一阵苍白一阵通红，像一个贫穷的纺织女工把一点火种埋在柴堆下，深夜里那火悄悄地燃起，把整堆柴都烧成了灰烬。从这一刻起，美狄亚的心已经不再属于她自己了。

Jason went into Aeetes's palace with the sons of Phrixus and two comrades, Hera veiling them in mist through the city until they arrived. In the courtyard four fountains made by Hephaestus for the son of the Sun ran with milk, wine, fragrant oil and water warm in winter and cool in summer. Chalciope, Aeetes's elder daughter and widow of Phrixus, ran to embrace her returning sons, and in the commotion Medea came out of her chamber. Eros, hidden in the porch, strung his bow, crouched at Jason's feet and shot an arrow into Medea's heart, then flew away laughing. The shaft burned in her like flame; she could not keep her eyes from Jason, her face going pale and red by turns, as when a poor spinning-woman heaps twigs on a brand in the night and the little flame rises and consumes them all. From that moment her heart was no longer her own.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第三卷·埃厄忒斯的王宫。claim.v0340.argo_2.02
03

国王的考验The king's trial

宴席过后，埃厄忒斯问外乡人的来意。阿耳戈斯替伊阿宋说明：他们是奉珀利阿斯之命来取金羊毛的，愿意为国王出力，帮他打败邻近的敌人作为回报。埃厄忒斯勃然大怒。他以为这些人是来夺取他的王位的，佛里克索斯的儿子们则是内应。他强压怒火，对伊阿宋说：我不和勇敢的人争吵。你可以拿走金羊毛，但你必须先完成一件我自己也做过的事。在阿瑞斯的平原上，有两头铜蹄的公牛，它们的嘴里喷着火焰。我把它们套上犁，耕种阿瑞斯的四亩田地，然后在犁沟里种下的不是谷物的种子，而是一条巨蛇的牙齿。从地里长出的是全副武装的武士，我用长矛把他们全部杀死。我从清晨开始，到黄昏就能收工。如果你能在一天之内做到这一切，金羊毛就归你。伊阿宋默默地坐着，不知道怎样回答，这是一个不可能完成的任务。最后他说：国王，我接受这个考验，即使我会因此而死，因为没有什么比命运更可怕。回到船上，英雄们听说了这件事，都沉默了。

After the feast Aeetes asked why they had come, and Argus explained that they sought the fleece at Pelias's command and would serve the king against his enemies in return. Aeetes was enraged, suspecting they had come for his throne with Phrixus's sons as accomplices. Mastering his anger, he told Jason he did not quarrel with brave men: he could have the fleece if he first did what Aeetes himself had done. On the plain of Ares were two bronze-footed bulls breathing fire; Aeetes yoked them, ploughed the four-acre field of Ares, and sowed in the furrows not grain but the teeth of a dread serpent, from which armed men sprang up, and these he slew with his spear — all from dawn to dusk. If Jason could do the same in a day, the fleece was his. Jason sat speechless, then said he would accept the trial even if he died, for nothing was more dreadful than necessity. Back at the ship the heroes heard it in silence.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第三卷·国王的考验。claim.v0340.argo_2.03
04

美狄亚的不眠之夜Medea's sleepless night

那天夜里，美狄亚躺在床上，怎么也睡不着。她想着伊阿宋，想着他的面容、他的衣着、他说话的声音，想着他明天就要去面对喷火的公牛，必死无疑。她的心像阳光照在水面上反射到墙上的光斑一样，跳动不停。一会儿，她决定把魔药给他；一会儿，她又觉得不应该背叛父亲；一会儿，她想不如自己去死，什么也不管了。她起身走到门边，又转身回来，来来回回，反复了好几次，最后伏在床上痛哭起来。这时，她的姐姐卡尔喀俄珀来了。卡尔喀俄珀害怕父亲会杀死她的儿子们，求妹妹帮助伊阿宋，这样也就救了她的儿子们。美狄亚心里暗暗高兴，有了帮助伊阿宋的理由，就答应了姐姐：明天一早，我就到赫卡忒的神庙去，把能让他抵挡公牛火焰的魔药交给他。姐姐走了以后，美狄亚又陷入了羞愧和恐惧：一个少女为了一个异乡人背叛父亲，人们会怎样议论她？她拿出装满毒药的匣子，想要一死了之，可是一想到阳光下的种种美好，又害怕起死亡来，把匣子放下了。天终于亮了。

That night Medea lay sleepless, thinking of Jason's face, his clothes, his voice, and of the fire-breathing bulls that would kill him tomorrow. Her heart quivered like a sunbeam thrown on a wall from water in a pail. Now she would give him the charm, now she would not betray her father, now she would rather die; she went to the door and turned back again and again, then threw herself on the bed weeping. Then Chalciope came, fearing their father would kill her sons, and begged Medea to help the stranger and so save them. Medea, glad of the excuse, promised to go at dawn to the temple of Hecate and give him a charm against the bulls' fire. Alone again, she was overcome with shame — what would people say of a maiden who betrayed her father for a stranger? — and took out her casket of poisons to die; but thinking of the pleasant things of life under the sun, she feared death and put the casket away. At last the dawn came.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第三卷·美狄亚的夜。claim.v0340.argo_2.04
05

赫卡忒神庙的相会Meeting at Hecate's temple

清晨，美狄亚梳妆打扮，带着侍女们乘马车来到了赫卡忒的神庙。她随身带着一种魔药，这种魔药提炼自一种奇异的花，那花生长在高加索山上，是从被鹰啄食的普罗米修斯滴下的血里长出来的。伊阿宋在预言家摩普索斯和阿耳戈斯的陪同下来到神庙，赫拉让他显得格外英俊。他像从大洋河里升起的天狼星一样，出现在美狄亚面前。两人面对面站着，很久都说不出话来。伊阿宋先开口，恳求她帮助，并对她说：当年克里特的公主阿里阿德涅也曾帮助过忒修斯，后来众神把她的花冠放在天上，变成了星座；你如果帮助我们，全希腊都会传颂你的名字。美狄亚低着头，微笑着，把魔药从怀里取出来，交到了他的手里。她告诉他：半夜里，你要独自到河边去沐浴，挖一个坑，向赫卡忒献上一只母羊，倒上蜂蜜，然后离开，不要回头。明天早晨，把这药涂遍全身和你的盾牌、长矛和剑，一整天里，火焰和刀枪都伤不了你。龙牙种下、武士长出来时，你就向他们中间扔一块大石头。临别时，她含着泪说：你回到家乡以后，请记住美狄亚的名字。

At dawn Medea went in her chariot with her maidens to the temple of Hecate, bringing a charm made from a flower that grew on the Caucasus from the ichor of Prometheus, dripping as the eagle tore him. Jason came with Mopsus and Argus, made beautiful by Hera, and appeared to her like Sirius rising from Ocean. They stood face to face long in silence. Jason spoke first, begging her help and reminding her how Ariadne had helped Theseus and her crown was set among the stars by the gods; all Greece would praise Medea's name. Smiling with downcast eyes, she drew the charm from her bosom and gave it into his hands. At midnight, she told him, he must bathe alone in the river, dig a pit, sacrifice a ewe to Hecate with honey, and leave without looking back; in the morning he should anoint his body, shield, spear and sword, and for a whole day neither fire nor bronze could harm him; when the earthborn men sprang up he should throw a great stone among them. Parting, she asked him in tears to remember Medea when he was home.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第三卷·神庙相会。claim.v0340.argo_2.05
06

喷火的公牛The fire-breathing bulls

半夜，伊阿宋按照美狄亚的嘱咐，独自在河边沐浴，挖坑献祭。赫卡忒从深处升起来，头上缠绕着毒蛇，四周是冥府的猎犬的嚎叫和火把的光亮，沼泽里的仙女们都尖叫起来。伊阿宋没有回头，一直走回了同伴们身边。天亮了，他把魔药涂遍全身和兵器，觉得浑身充满了无穷的力量。埃厄忒斯穿上战神送给他的铠甲，带着科尔基斯人来到阿瑞斯的平原上观看。两头公牛从地下的牛棚里冲了出来，鼻孔里喷着火焰，咆哮声震动大地。伊阿宋稳稳地站着，用盾牌挡住冲来的公牛，火焰像风暴一样包围了他，却丝毫伤不了他。他抓住一头牛的角，把它拖到轭边，又一脚踢倒另一头牛，把两头牛都套上了犁。他用长矛赶着公牛犁地，从清晨犁到午后，把龙牙撒进了犁沟里。到了傍晚，从犁沟里长出了一个个全副武装的武士，大地上闪烁着盾牌和长矛的寒光。伊阿宋想起了美狄亚的话，举起一块四个壮汉也搬不动的大石头，扔进了武士们中间。武士们像猎犬一样扑向石头，互相厮杀起来，伊阿宋趁机冲上去，把他们一个个砍倒。太阳落山时，考验完成了。埃厄忒斯一言不发地回到城里，盘算着怎样对付这些外乡人。

At midnight Jason bathed and sacrificed as Medea had told him, and Hecate rose from the depths wreathed with serpents amid the barking of hellhounds and the glare of torches, while the marsh nymphs shrieked; he did not look back. At dawn he anointed himself and his arms and felt boundless strength. Aeetes, in the armour Ares had given him, came with the Colchians to the plain of Ares. The bulls rushed from their underground stall breathing fire; Jason stood firm behind his shield, the flame swirling round him harmlessly, dragged one bull by the horn to the yoke, felled the other with a kick, and yoked them both. Goading them with his spear he ploughed from dawn into the afternoon and sowed the teeth; at evening armed men sprang from the furrows and the earth bristled with shields and spears. Remembering Medea's words, he hurled among them a great stone that four strong men could not lift; they fell on one another like hounds, and he cut them down. At sunset the trial was done, and Aeetes went silently back to the city, plotting against the strangers.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第三卷·考验。claim.v0340.argo_2.06
07

盗取金羊毛Taking the fleece

当天夜里，美狄亚知道父亲已经起了疑心，要对她和英雄们下毒手。她心中充满恐惧，带着魔药匣子，赤着脚从宫中逃出，穿过夜色跑到河边，在英雄们的营火旁高声呼喊佛里克索斯最小的儿子的名字。伊阿宋跳上岸来，美狄亚抱住他的膝盖说：快救救我，也救救你们自己，我们得在我父亲动手之前取走金羊毛；我会让看守的巨蛇睡着。伊阿宋扶她起来，在众神面前发誓，要娶她为妻，带她回希腊。他们来到阿瑞斯的圣林，金羊毛挂在一棵高大的橡树上，像被朝阳照亮的云彩一样闪闪发光。那条巨蛇从不睡觉，它看见了来人，伸长脖子，发出可怕的嘶嘶声，整片树林都在回响。美狄亚走到巨蛇面前，用甜美的声音呼唤睡神和夜里的女王赫卡忒，唱起了催眠的歌。巨蛇巨大的身躯渐渐松弛下来，可是它仍然昂着可怕的头。美狄亚用一根新鲜的刺柏枝蘸了魔药，一边念着咒语，一边洒在巨蛇的眼睛上，浓烈的药味让它沉沉睡去。伊阿宋取下金羊毛，像一个少女用薄纱接住满月的光一样欢喜。两人飞奔回到船上，天还没有亮，英雄们立刻划桨出发了。

That night, knowing her father suspected her and plotted harm, Medea fled the palace barefoot with her casket of drugs and ran through the dark to the river, calling to the youngest son of Phrixus by the heroes' fire. Jason leapt ashore; clasping his knees she begged him to save her and themselves: they must take the fleece before her father struck, and she would put the serpent to sleep. Jason raised her and swore before the gods to make her his wedded wife in Greece. In the grove of Ares the fleece hung on a tall oak, glowing like a cloud reddened by the rising sun. The sleepless serpent saw them and hissed so that the whole grove rang; Medea called sweetly on Sleep and on Hecate, queen of the night, and sang her spell until its coils relaxed, then sprinkled its eyes with drugs from a fresh sprig of juniper, chanting, and the strong scent cast it into sleep. Jason took down the fleece, rejoicing like a maiden catching the light of the full moon on her fine robe, and they ran back to the ship and rowed away before dawn.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第四卷·金羊毛。claim.v0340.argo_2.07
08

阿布绪耳托斯之死The death of Apsyrtus

埃厄忒斯得知女儿和金羊毛都被带走了，怒不可遏，派出了大批船只追赶，领兵的是美狄亚的弟弟阿布绪耳托斯。按照菲纽斯的指点，英雄们没有从原路返回，而是驶进了伊斯特河，想从另一条路回到希腊。可是阿布绪耳托斯抄近路赶在了他们前面，封锁了河口和附近的岛屿。英雄们寡不敌众，只好与科尔基斯人谈判：金羊毛归伊阿宋，因为那是他凭考验赢来的；美狄亚则暂时留在阿耳忒弥斯神庙所在的岛上，由当地的国王裁决她应该回到父亲身边，还是跟着英雄们走。美狄亚害怕被交出去，责骂伊阿宋背弃誓言，伊阿宋发誓不会抛弃她。于是两人定下了一个阴谋：美狄亚派人带着礼物去见阿布绪耳托斯，假装要把金羊毛偷来交给他，约他夜里在神庙边单独见面。阿布绪耳托斯信以为真，独自前来。伊阿宋埋伏在一旁，冲出来一剑杀死了他，美狄亚转过脸去，不忍看见弟弟被杀。阿布绪耳托斯临死时，把鲜血溅在了姐姐的银纱和长袍上。伊阿宋按照杀人者的习俗，割下死者的手脚末端，舔了三次血又吐了三次，把尸体埋在了地下。失去了首领的科尔基斯人被英雄们打散了，可是宙斯看见了这桩用诡计犯下的血罪，大为震怒。

Aeetes, enraged, sent a great fleet after them under Medea's brother Apsyrtus. On Phineus's advice the heroes did not return the way they came but entered the river Ister; Apsyrtus went by a shorter way, got ahead of them and blocked the river mouths and islands. Outnumbered, the heroes agreed with the Colchians that the fleece should be Jason's, won by his trial, while Medea should wait on the island of Artemis's temple for a neighbouring king to judge whether she returned to her father. Medea, fearing betrayal, reproached Jason, and together they laid a plot: she sent gifts to Apsyrtus pretending she would steal the fleece for him, and he came alone by night to the temple. Jason sprang from ambush and struck him down while Medea turned her eyes away; dying, he stained her silvery veil and robe with his blood. Jason cut off the extremities of the dead man, thrice licked up the blood and thrice spat it out, as slayers do to atone, and buried him. The leaderless Colchians were routed, but Zeus saw the treacherous murder and was wroth.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第四卷·阿布绪耳托斯。claim.v0340.argo_2.08
09

会说话的船梁The speaking beam

阿尔戈号继续航行，可是风暴一次又一次把它吹回原处。忽然，船头那块来自多多那的神圣橡木开口说话了，用人的声音宣告：宙斯因为阿布绪耳托斯之死而发怒了；除非你们去找喀耳刻为你们洗清这桩血罪，否则你们永远也回不了家。英雄们听了，又惊又怕。他们驶进了厄里达诺斯河——当年太阳神的儿子法厄同驾车坠落的地方，河水至今还冒着腐臭的热气，赫利阿得斯姐妹们化成了河边的白杨，她们的眼泪化成了琥珀。他们又从厄里达诺斯驶进了罗达诺斯河，在赫拉的指引下，穿过了凯尔特人和利古里亚人的土地，来到了第勒尼安海，找到了喀耳刻居住的埃埃亚岛。喀耳刻是埃厄忒斯的妹妹，美狄亚的姑姑。伊阿宋和美狄亚默默地走进她的宫殿，坐在炉火边，伊阿宋把杀死阿布绪耳托斯的剑插在地上，两人低着头，不说一句话——这是求人洗罪的人的规矩。喀耳刻明白了，她杀了一头小猪，用猪血为他们洗手，又向宙斯献上祭品，求他平息怒气。然后她问美狄亚是谁，美狄亚用科尔基斯的语言讲述了一切。喀耳刻知道了真相，严厉地责备她背叛父亲、逃离家乡，把她赶出了宫殿。

The Argo sailed on, but storms drove her back again and again, until the Dodonian beam in her prow spoke with a human voice: Zeus was angry at the death of Apsyrtus, and they would never reach home unless Circe cleansed them of the blood. They entered the Eridanus, where Phaethon fell blazing from the Sun's chariot, where the stream still steams and the Heliades, turned to poplars, weep tears of amber; from there into the Rhodanus, and by Hera's guidance through the lands of the Celts and Ligurians to the Tyrrhenian sea and Circe's island of Aeaea. Circe was sister of Aeetes. Jason and Medea entered her house in silence and sat at the hearth as suppliants do, Jason fixing in the ground the sword that killed Apsyrtus, their eyes cast down. Circe understood; she purified their hands with the blood of a suckling pig and offered sacrifice to appease Zeus. Then she asked Medea who she was, and Medea told everything in the Colchian tongue; Circe rebuked her for betraying her father and fleeing her home, and drove her from the hall.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第四卷·喀耳刻。claim.v0340.argo_2.09
10

塞壬与漂浮岩The Sirens and the Wandering Rocks

赫拉派彩虹女神伊里斯去请海中女神忒提斯——她是英雄珀琉斯的妻子——带着她的姐妹们来护送阿尔戈号。英雄们驶过了塞壬的海岛。塞壬们站在岩石上，用甜美的歌声引诱路过的水手，让他们忘记了回家，在岛上憔悴而死。英雄们听见歌声，正要把船驶向岸边，俄耳甫斯拿起竖琴，弹起了一支轻快响亮的歌，琴声压过了塞壬的歌声，西风也把船推向前方。可是英雄布忒斯还是被塞壬的歌声迷住了，他跳进海里，向岛上游去，眼看就要送命，爱神阿佛洛狄忒怜悯他，把他从漩涡里救起，带到了西西里的利吕拜翁海角。接着，阿尔戈号来到了斯库拉和卡律布狄斯之间的海峡，前面还有漂浮岩——那里的岩石在海中漂动，岩石下喷出烈火和浓烟。忒提斯和海中仙女们赶来了，她们撩起长袍，像在沙滩上玩球的少女一样，把阿尔戈号从一个仙女手里抛给另一个仙女，在浪尖上把船托过了岩石。火神赫淮斯托斯放下锤子在山顶上观看，天后赫拉在天上紧张地抱住了雅典娜。阿尔戈号终于平安地穿过了漂浮岩。

Hera sent Iris to bid Thetis, wife of Peleus, bring her sister Nereids to escort the Argo. They passed the island of the Sirens, who lured sailors with sweet song until they wasted away; as the heroes were about to steer to the shore, Orpheus struck up a quick, ringing melody on his lyre that drowned the Sirens' voices, and the west wind bore the ship on. Only Butes, enchanted, leapt into the sea and swam for the shore; Aphrodite took pity, snatched him from the eddies and set him down on the headland of Lilybaeum in Sicily. Then, between Scylla and Charybdis, they came to the Wandering Rocks, where fire and smoke rose from the sea. Thetis and the Nereids came and, girding up their robes, tossed the Argo from hand to hand over the waves like girls playing ball on the sand, lifting her over the rocks, while Hephaestus watched from a mountain top leaning on his hammer, and Hera in heaven threw her arms round Athena in fear. So the Argo passed the Wandering Rocks.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第四卷·塞壬与漂浮岩。claim.v0340.argo_2.10
11

山洞里的婚礼A wedding in the cave

阿尔戈号来到了费埃克斯人的岛屿德瑞帕涅，国王阿尔喀诺俄斯热情地款待了英雄们。可是不久，一大批科尔基斯人追来了，他们要求费埃克斯人交出美狄亚，否则就要开战。美狄亚害怕极了，她抱住王后阿瑞忒的膝盖，哀求她不要把自己交给父亲的人，又一个个地去恳求英雄们保护她。当天夜里，国王对王后说出了自己的裁决：如果美狄亚还是一个未出嫁的少女，就把她交还给她的父亲；如果她已经成了伊阿宋的妻子，我就不会把她从丈夫身边夺走。阿瑞忒同情美狄亚，连夜派人去告诉伊阿宋。英雄们立刻在一个神圣的山洞里为伊阿宋和美狄亚举行了婚礼。他们把金羊毛铺在婚床上，金羊毛的光芒照亮了整个山洞，仙女们采来鲜花，为新人们唱起了婚礼的歌，俄耳甫斯弹琴伴奏。可是这场婚礼没有在伊阿宋的故乡举行，而是在异乡的山洞里，在恐惧中仓促完成的，诗人说，人类的欢乐从来不会是完整的。第二天，国王宣布了裁决，科尔基斯人知道已无法带走美狄亚，又害怕埃厄忒斯的怒火，就留在了费埃克斯人的国土上。

The Argo came to Drepane, island of the Phaeacians, where King Alcinous welcomed the heroes; but a great host of Colchians followed, demanding Medea on pain of war. Terrified, she clasped Queen Arete's knees and begged each of the heroes in turn to protect her. That night the king told the queen his judgment: if Medea was still a maiden she must go back to her father, but if she was Jason's wife he would not part her from her husband. Arete, pitying Medea, sent word to Jason at once, and that night the heroes celebrated the marriage of Jason and Medea in a sacred cave, spreading the golden fleece on the bridal bed so that it lit up the cave, while nymphs brought flowers and sang the wedding song and Orpheus played. Yet the wedding was not held at home in Iolcus but in a strange land, hastily and in fear, for, the poet says, mortals never find joy complete. Next day the king gave his judgment, and the Colchians, unable to take Medea and fearing Aeetes's wrath, settled among the Phaeacians.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第四卷·费埃克斯人。claim.v0340.argo_2.11
12

扛着船穿越沙漠Carrying the ship across the desert

阿尔戈号离开费埃克斯人，眼看希腊就在眼前，可是一场持续了九天九夜的北风，把他们吹到了利比亚的叙尔提斯海湾。那里的海水很浅，到处是淤泥和海草，船一旦驶进去，就再也出不来了。英雄们望着无边无际的沙漠，绝望地躺在沙滩上，用斗篷蒙住头，等待死亡。正午时分，三位守护利比亚的女神出现在伊阿宋面前，她们身披山羊皮，告诉他：当海神波塞冬的马从车上解下来的时候，你们要报答那位怀了你们这么久的母亲。伊阿宋把这句谜语告诉了同伴，珀琉斯解开了它：母亲就是阿尔戈号，她一直把我们怀在肚子里；我们现在要报答她，把她扛在肩上。这时，一匹巨大的马从海里跃出，奔向远方。英雄们扛起了阿尔戈号，在沙漠里走了整整十二天十二夜，终于来到了特里托尼斯湖。他们渴得要命，找到了赫斯珀里得斯的花园，金苹果的守护龙已经被前一天路过的赫拉克勒斯射死了。赫斯珀里得斯告诉他们，赫拉克勒斯在岩石上踢出了一眼泉水，英雄们这才喝上了水。在利比亚，英雄卡恩托斯被牧人杀死，预言家摩普索斯被毒蛇咬死，他们永远留在了这片沙漠里。

Leaving the Phaeacians, with Greece almost in sight, the Argo was driven by a north wind for nine days and nights into the Syrtis of Libya, shallow and choked with mud and weed, from which no ship returns. The heroes lay on the sand with their cloaks over their heads, waiting to die, until at noon three heroines, guardians of Libya, clad in goatskins, appeared to Jason and told him that when Poseidon's horse was unyoked from his chariot, they must repay their mother for carrying them so long in her womb. Peleus read the riddle: their mother was the Argo, and they must carry her on their shoulders — and a huge horse leapt from the sea and galloped away. For twelve days and nights they carried the ship across the desert to Lake Tritonis. Parched, they came to the garden of the Hesperides, whose dragon had been shot the day before by Heracles, and the Hesperides showed them the spring he had struck from the rock. In Libya the hero Canthus was killed by a shepherd and the seer Mopsus died of a snake's bite, and both stayed in that desert for ever.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第四卷·利比亚。claim.v0340.argo_2.12
13

铜人塔罗斯Talos the bronze man

在特里同神的指引下，阿尔戈号终于从特里托尼斯湖找到了通向大海的出口。他们驶向克里特岛，想要在那里上岸，取水休息。可是克里特有一个守护者：铜人塔罗斯。他是青铜时代最后一个活着的人，宙斯把他送给欧罗巴，让他守护克里特。他每天绕着岛走三圈，看见船只靠近，就从悬崖上掰下巨大的岩石扔过去。他的全身都是青铜，刀枪不入，只有脚踝处有一根血管，上面覆盖着一层薄薄的皮膜，那是他生死的关键。英雄们看见岩石飞来，惊恐地把船划离了海岸，又饥又渴，不知道该怎么办。这时美狄亚说：听我的，我能打倒他，无论他的身体是不是青铜做的，只要他的生命不是不朽的。她走上船头，用咒语召唤冥府里吞噬生命的死亡精灵，用她充满仇恨的魔眼紧紧盯着塔罗斯，向他投去致命的幻影。塔罗斯举起岩石要扔过来，脚踝却在一块尖石上擦破了，神圣的血液像熔化的铅一样流了出来。他摇晃着站了一会儿，像一棵被樵夫砍了一半的松树，终于轰然倒在了海边。那天夜里，英雄们在克里特上了岸。

Guided by the god Triton, the Argo found her way from Lake Tritonis to the sea and made for Crete to take water. But Crete had a guardian, Talos the bronze man, last of the bronze race, whom Zeus had given to Europa to guard the island; he strode round it three times a day and hurled rocks broken from the cliffs at approaching ships. His body was bronze and invulnerable except for a vein at the ankle covered by a thin membrane, which held his life or death. The heroes backed away in terror, hungry and thirsty, until Medea said she could overcome him, whatever his body, if his life was not immortal. Standing on the deck she invoked with spells the death-spirits of Hades, fixed Talos with her baleful eye and sent deadly phantoms against him; as he lifted a rock he grazed his ankle on a sharp stone, and the ichor ran out like molten lead. He swayed like a pine half-hewn by woodcutters and fell crashing on the shore, and that night the heroes landed in Crete.

Evidence / 证据《阿尔戈英雄纪》第四卷·塔罗斯。claim.v0340.argo_2.13
14

黑夜里的光明与归来Light in the darkness, and home

离开克里特后，阿尔戈号在大海上遇到了一种可怕的黑暗，那黑暗被人们称作“裹尸布之夜”，没有星光，也没有月光，仿佛冥府的黑暗从地下涌了上来，英雄们不知道自己是在海上还是在冥河上漂流。伊阿宋举起双手，大声向阿波罗祈祷。阿波罗从天上降临，站在一块岩石上，高高举起他的金弓，金弓发出耀眼的光芒，照亮了四周的大海。英雄们看见了一座小岛，就在岛上靠岸，为阿波罗建了祭坛，把这座岛命名为阿那斐，意思是“显现之岛”。在那里，英雄欧斐摩斯想起了一个梦：他梦见自己把特里同神送给他的一块泥土抱在怀里，泥土变成了一个少女。伊阿宋解释说，那块泥土会变成一座岛屿，由欧斐摩斯的后代居住。欧斐摩斯把泥土扔进海里，一座岛屿从海中升起，那就是卡利斯忒岛，后来叫作忒拉。英雄们又经过了埃癸那，在那里比赛谁最快把水打回船上。最后，他们平安地驶进了帕伽塞海港。诗人在结尾向英雄们告别：愿你们的故事年复一年在人们的歌声中更加动听。

After Crete a terrible darkness fell on the sea — men call it the Pall of Darkness — with no star or moon, as if the black of Hades had risen from below, so that they knew not whether they drifted on the sea or the rivers of the dead. Jason lifted his hands and cried aloud to Apollo, who came down and stood on a rock holding high his golden bow, which flashed a dazzling light all round. They saw a small island, landed, built an altar to Apollo and named the island Anaphe, 'the island of appearing'. There Euphemus remembered a dream in which the clod of earth Triton had given him became a maiden in his arms; Jason interpreted it, and Euphemus threw the clod into the sea, where it rose as the island of Calliste, later called Thera, to be settled by his descendants. Passing Aegina, where they raced to draw water, they sailed safely into the harbour of Pagasae. In his last lines the poet bids the heroes farewell: may their story grow sweeter in men's songs from year to year.

北欧 / Norse

沃尔松格萨迦 · 第一部 西格蒙德The Saga of the Völsungs, Part 1: Sigmund

沃尔松格家族是奥丁的后裔。国王沃尔松格的大厅里长着一棵巨大的橡树，在女儿西格妮的婚宴上，一个独眼的老人把一把剑插进了树干，只有西格蒙德能把它拔出来。新郎西格尔国王因此怀恨在心，设计杀死了沃尔松格和他的九个儿子，只有西格蒙德在妹妹西格妮的帮助下活了下来。为了复仇，西格妮化身为女巫与哥哥同眠，生下了辛菲奥特利；父子二人在森林里披上狼皮，最终烧死了西格尔，西格妮也随丈夫投身火海。多年以后，奥丁亲手用长矛折断了西格蒙德的剑，西格蒙德战死，把宝剑的碎片留给了尚未出生的儿子西古尔德。

The Völsungs descend from Odin. In King Völsungr's hall grows a great oak, and at his daughter Signý's wedding a one-eyed old man thrusts a sword into its trunk that only Sigmundr can draw. The bridegroom, King Siggeir, takes offence and destroys Völsungr and his nine sons; only Sigmundr survives with Signý's help. Bent on vengeance, Signý takes another woman's shape to lie with her brother and bears Sinfjötli; father and son put on wolf-skins in the forest and at last burn Siggeir in his hall, and Signý goes back into the fire to die with her husband. Years later Odin himself breaks Sigmundr's sword with his spear; Sigmundr falls and leaves the shards for his unborn son, Sigurðr.

01

奥丁之子西吉Sigi, son of Odin

萨迦从奥丁的一个儿子讲起，他的名字叫西吉。有一次，西吉和一个名叫布雷迪的奴隶一起去打猎，布雷迪是另一个人斯卡迪的奴隶。到了傍晚清点猎物，布雷迪打到的野兽比西吉的多得多。西吉觉得受了奴隶的羞辱，嫉恨在心，竟然杀死了布雷迪，把尸体埋在雪堆里。从此人们就把大雪堆叫作“布雷迪的雪堆”。事情很快败露了，人们宣布西吉是“圣地里的狼”，也就是被放逐的罪人，他不能再在家乡生活。可是奥丁没有抛弃自己的儿子，他亲自领着西吉离开了那片土地，走了很远的路，又给他准备了战船和人马。西吉成了一个伟大的战士，在战争中赢得了一个国家，做了匈人之地的国王，娶了一位有名望的妻子。他统治了很久，十分强大，直到年老的时候，他妻子的兄弟们背叛了他，趁他身边人少的时候袭击他，把他杀死了。他的儿子勒里尔召集了大军，为父亲报了仇，杀死了所有背叛者，继承了父亲的王国。

The saga begins with Sigi, a son of Odin. Out hunting with Breði, a thrall belonging to a man called Skaði, Sigi found at evening that the thrall had taken far more game than he; jealous and shamed, he killed Breði and buried him in a snowdrift, which is why great drifts are called Breði's drifts. The deed was discovered and Sigi was declared a wolf in holy places, an outlaw, and could no longer live at home. But Odin led his son far away and gave him warships and men, and Sigi became a great warrior, won a kingdom and ruled as king of Hunland with a noble wife. He ruled long and mightily until in old age his wife's brothers betrayed and killed him when few men were with him; his son Rerir gathered a host, avenged his father on all the traitors, and took the kingdom.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第1章。claim.v0340.vol_1.01
02

苹果与六年的孕育The apple and the six-year child

勒里尔国王和王后很久都没有孩子，他们为此十分忧愁，向众神祈求，希望能有一个儿子。女神弗丽嘉听见了他们的祈祷，告诉了奥丁。奥丁派他的愿望侍女——巨人赫利姆尼尔的女儿赫柳德——变成一只乌鸦，把一个苹果带给勒里尔。那时勒里尔正坐在一座土丘上，乌鸦飞过，把苹果扔在了他的膝上。勒里尔明白了这是神的恩赐，把苹果带回去给王后吃了。不久，王后怀孕了。可是勒里尔国王出征时病死了，王后的身孕却迟迟不能分娩，一直怀了六年。她知道自己活不长了，就命人剖开她的身体，取出孩子。生下来的是一个已经长得很大的男孩，他在母亲死前亲吻了她。这个孩子就是沃尔松格。沃尔松格长大后做了匈人之地的国王，娶了当年送苹果的赫柳德为妻，生了十个儿子和一个女儿，最大的是一对双胞胎：儿子西格蒙德和女儿西格妮。沃尔松格建了一座宏伟的大厅，大厅正中长着一棵巨大的橡树，树枝穿过屋顶向外伸展，开着美丽的花，人们把它叫作“孩子树”布兰斯托克。

Rerir and his queen long had no child and prayed to the gods for a son. Frigg heard and told Odin, who sent his wish-maiden Hljóð, daughter of the giant Hrímnir, in the shape of a crow with an apple, which she dropped into Rerir's lap as he sat on a mound. Rerir understood, and the queen ate the apple and conceived. But Rerir died of sickness on a campaign, and the queen carried the child six years without giving birth; knowing she would not live, she had him cut from her, and the boy, already well grown, kissed his mother before she died. He was Völsungr. He became king of Hunland, married Hljóð, who had brought the apple, and had ten sons and a daughter, the eldest being the twins Sigmundr and Signý. He built a splendid hall round a great oak whose blossoming branches spread out through the roof, called the Branstock.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第2章。claim.v0340.vol_1.02
03

橡树里的剑The sword in the oak

高特兰的国王西格尔来向西格妮求婚。沃尔松格和儿子们觉得这门亲事不错，答应了，可是西格妮自己并不愿意，只是听从了父亲的安排。婚宴在沃尔松格的大厅里举行，大厅中央的橡树周围燃着火堆。宴会正热闹的时候，一个陌生人走进了大厅。他身材高大，年纪很老，只有一只眼睛，披着一件带帽的斗篷，赤着脚，裤子用亚麻布绑在腿上。他手里握着一把剑，走到橡树前，把剑一直插进树干，只露出剑柄。大厅里的人都不敢和他打招呼。他说：谁能把这把剑从树干里拔出来，这把剑就送给谁；他会发现，这是他手中握过的最好的剑。说完，老人走出大厅，谁也不知道他是谁，去了哪里——这是奥丁。众人纷纷上前拔剑，一个接一个，都拔不动。最后，西格蒙德走上前去，伸手一拔，那把剑就像放在那里等着他一样，轻轻松松地被拔了出来。这是一把无与伦比的好剑。西格尔国王想要这把剑，提出用三倍于剑重的黄金来换。西格蒙德回答：你和我一样，本来也可以把它拔出来，如果它是给你的话。可是现在它到了我的手里，就是给我你所有的黄金，我也不换。西格尔听了这番话，觉得受到了嘲弄，心中暗暗怀恨。

Siggeir, king of Gautland, asked for Signý. Völsungr and his sons favoured the match, and Signý, though unwilling, obeyed. At the wedding feast in Völsungr's hall, fires burning round the great oak, a stranger came in: very tall and old, one-eyed, in a hooded cloak, barefoot, with linen breeches bound round his legs. He drove a sword into the trunk up to the hilt, said that whoever drew it out should have it as a gift and find no better sword ever in his hand, and went out; no one knew who he was or where he went — it was Odin. Man after man tried and failed, until Sigmundr took hold and drew it out as if it lay loose. Siggeir offered three times its weight in gold, but Sigmundr answered that Siggeir could have drawn it as well as he if it had been meant for him; now that it had come to his hand, he would not give it up for all Siggeir's gold. Siggeir took it as mockery and nursed his grudge.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第3章。claim.v0340.vol_1.03
04

沃尔松格之死The death of Völsungr

第二天，西格妮请求父亲让她早点离开，她说她不愿意跟西格尔走，她预感到这门亲事会带来灾难。可是沃尔松格说，答应了的事不能反悔，否则会给两家带来耻辱。西格尔国王带着西格妮回国前，邀请沃尔松格和他的儿子们三个月后到高特兰做客。到了约定的日子，沃尔松格带着儿子们乘三条船来到高特兰的海岸。西格妮趁夜里来到船上，对父亲说：西格尔已经集结了大军，要背叛你们，杀死你们。你们赶快回去，召集自己的军队再来吧。沃尔松格回答：我还在母亲腹中的时候，就说过一句话，我发誓无论遇到火还是铁，都绝不逃跑，我一直遵守着这个誓言。现在我老了，更不能违背它。女儿，你回到你丈夫身边去吧。第二天一早，沃尔松格和儿子们上岸迎战，他们八次冲进敌阵，杀死了许多人，可是寡不敌众，沃尔松格在阵前战死，他的十个儿子全部被俘。西格妮恳求丈夫：不要马上杀死我的兄弟们，把他们锁在木枷里，放在树林里吧，让我能多看他们几眼。西格尔答应了，心想这样他们会死得更痛苦。

Next day Signý begged her father to let her stay, foreseeing disaster from the marriage, but Völsungr said a promise could not be broken without shame. Siggeir invited Völsungr and his sons to Gautland in three months. When they came with three ships, Signý went to them by night and warned that Siggeir had gathered a host to betray them: let them go home and raise an army. Völsungr answered that while still unborn he had sworn never to flee from fire or iron, and he had kept that vow; old as he was, he would not break it now — let her go back to her husband. At dawn they went ashore and fought, charging through Siggeir's ranks eight times, but Völsungr fell before his men and all ten of his sons were captured. Signý begged Siggeir not to kill her brothers at once but to put them in stocks in the forest, so that she might see them a while longer, and Siggeir agreed, thinking they would suffer more.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第4–5章。claim.v0340.vol_1.04
05

林中的母狼The she-wolf in the forest

十个兄弟被锁在森林里的一根巨大的木枷上。第一天夜里，一头又老又大的母狼从森林里走出来，咬死了其中一个兄弟，把他吃掉了，然后离去。第二天夜里，母狼又来了，又吃掉了一个。就这样，一连九夜，九个兄弟都被母狼吃掉了，只剩下了西格蒙德。有人说，这头母狼是西格尔的母亲，她用魔法变成了狼的样子。西格妮每天都派人去打听消息，知道只剩下西格蒙德一个了，她想出了一个办法。她叫来一个心腹，让他带着蜂蜜去森林里，把蜂蜜涂在西格蒙德的脸上，再放一些在他的嘴里。到了夜里，母狼又来了，闻到了蜂蜜的香味，就去舔西格蒙德脸上的蜂蜜，然后把舌头伸进了他的嘴里。西格蒙德一口咬住了母狼的舌头，母狼拼命挣扎，用脚蹬着木枷，竟把木枷蹬裂了，西格蒙德紧咬不放，把狼的舌头连根扯了出来，母狼就这样死了。西格蒙德挣脱了木枷，逃进了森林深处。西格妮派人给他送去所需的东西，他在森林里挖了一个地洞住了下来。西格尔以为沃尔松格家的人都死光了。

The ten brothers were set in a great stock in the forest. On the first night an old, huge she-wolf came out of the wood and killed and ate one of them; so it went for nine nights, until only Sigmundr was left. Some say the wolf was Siggeir's mother in the shape of a wolf by witchcraft. Signý sent a trusted man to smear honey on Sigmundr's face and put some in his mouth. That night the she-wolf came, licked the honey from his face and thrust her tongue into his mouth; Sigmundr bit hard on it, and as she struggled and braced her feet against the stock she split it, while he held on until he tore out her tongue by the roots, and she died. Sigmundr escaped into the forest, and Signý sent him what he needed; he made himself an earth-house there, while Siggeir thought all the Völsungs were dead.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第5章。claim.v0340.vol_1.05
06

西格妮的考验Signý's test

西格妮心中只有一个念头：为父亲和兄弟们报仇。她和西格尔生了两个儿子。大儿子十岁的时候，她把他送到森林里西格蒙德那里，让他帮助舅舅复仇。可是复仇的人必须有勇气。在送去之前，西格妮先试探孩子：她把他袖子的边缝在他的手臂皮肤上，孩子疼得叫了起来。到了森林里，西格蒙德让孩子揉面做饭，自己出去砍柴。等他回来，面还没有揉好，孩子说，他不敢碰那袋面粉，因为里面有个活的东西在动。西格蒙德把这件事告诉了西格妮，西格妮说：这孩子没有勇气，留着他没用，杀了他吧。西格蒙德照做了。第二年，西格妮又把小儿子送来，结果也是一样。萨迦就这样冷酷地讲述了西格妮的决心：在她眼里，西格尔的儿子不配成为沃尔松格家的复仇者，她宁可牺牲自己的孩子，也不让复仇落空。她明白了，能和西格蒙德一起复仇的，必须是一个纯粹的沃尔松格家的孩子。

Signý thought only of vengeance. When her elder son by Siggeir was ten, she sent him to Sigmundr in the forest to help, first testing him by sewing the cuffs of his sleeves to the skin of his arms, at which he cried out. Sigmundr set the boy to knead dough while he fetched wood; the boy did not dare touch the meal-sack because something alive was moving in it. When Sigmundr told Signý, she said the boy had no courage and should be killed, and so it was done; the next year the younger son fared the same. The saga tells Signý's resolve coldly: Siggeir's sons were unfit to be the Völsungs' avengers, and only a child of pure Völsung blood could share the vengeance.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第6章。claim.v0340.vol_1.06
07

辛菲奥特利Sinfjötli

有一天，一个会魔法的女巫来到西格妮的住处。西格妮对她说：我想和你交换容貌。女巫用魔法让两人换了样子，女巫变成西格妮的模样留在西格尔身边，而西格妮变成女巫的样子，来到了森林里西格蒙德的地洞，请求借宿。西格蒙德没有认出她，留她住了三夜，与她同床。然后，西格妮回到了家，和女巫换回了容貌。不久她生下了一个儿子，取名辛菲奥特利。他是西格蒙德和西格妮的儿子，有着纯粹的沃尔松格家的血统。辛菲奥特利长到十岁时，西格妮也用同样的方法试探他：把袖子缝在他手臂的皮肉上，他一声不吭；她把袖子连皮一起撕下来，问他疼不疼，他说：对沃尔松格家的人来说，这点疼算不了什么。她把他送到西格蒙德那里。西格蒙德让他揉面，自己出去砍柴。回来时，面已经做好了。西格蒙德问他有没有在面里发现什么东西，辛菲奥特利说：开始揉的时候，面里好像有个活的东西，我没管它，把它一起揉进面里了。西格蒙德笑着说：今晚你别吃这面包了，你把一条最毒的蛇揉进去了。西格蒙德能吃毒蛇而不受伤害，辛菲奥特利能抵挡外面的毒，却不能吃下毒物。

One day a sorceress came to Signý, who asked to exchange shapes with her. The sorceress, in Signý's likeness, stayed with Siggeir, while Signý in her likeness went to Sigmundr's earth-house in the forest and asked for shelter; not knowing her, he kept her three nights and lay with her. Then she went home and they changed back, and in time she bore a son, Sinfjötli, child of Sigmundr and Signý, a Völsung on both sides. When he was ten she tested him the same way: he did not flinch when the sleeves were sewn to his skin, and when she tore them off with the skin, he said such a pain was little to a Völsung. Sent to Sigmundr and set to kneading, he had the bread baked by the time Sigmundr returned; asked if he had found anything in the meal, he said something alive had been in it at first, but he had kneaded it in. Sigmundr laughed and told him not to eat that bread, for he had kneaded in the most venomous of serpents. Sigmundr could eat poison unharmed; Sinfjötli could bear venom on his skin but not eat it.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第7章。claim.v0340.vol_1.07
08

狼皮The wolf-skins

西格蒙德觉得辛菲奥特利还太年轻，复仇之前应该让他经受更多的磨炼。父子二人在夏天里走遍森林，杀人抢劫。西格蒙德一直以为辛菲奥特利是西格尔的儿子，只觉得他有着沃尔松格家的勇猛。有一天，他们来到森林里的一座小屋，看见里面有两个人睡着，身上戴着粗大的金环，墙上挂着两张狼皮。原来这两个人是国王的儿子，中了魔法，只能每隔十天从狼皮里出来一次。西格蒙德和辛菲奥特利穿上了狼皮，却再也脱不下来了，他们也变成了狼，像狼一样嚎叫。他们约定：如果一个人遇到七个以上的敌人，就要嚎叫，叫另一个来帮忙。可是辛菲奥特利遇到了十一个人，没有呼救，独自把他们全杀了。西格蒙德见了大怒，扑上去咬住了他的喉咙。辛菲奥特利倒地不起，西格蒙德追悔莫及，背着他回到小屋，坐在他身边，诅咒那两张狼皮。这时，他看见两只鼬鼠，一只咬了另一只的喉咙，然后跑进树林，衔来一片叶子，放在伤口上，那只鼬鼠就活了过来。一只渡鸦给西格蒙德衔来了同样的叶子，他把叶子放在辛菲奥特利的伤口上，辛菲奥特利立刻跳了起来，完好如初。到了第十天，他们终于脱下了狼皮，把它们扔进火里烧掉了。

Thinking Sinfjötli too young, Sigmundr hardened him first; they roamed the forest through the summer killing men for plunder, Sigmundr still believing the boy was Siggeir's son. They came to a house where two men slept wearing thick gold rings, with wolf-skins hanging over them — kings' sons under a spell who could come out of the skins only every tenth day. Sigmundr and Sinfjötli put on the skins and could not take them off; they became wolves and howled like wolves. They agreed that whoever met more than seven men would howl for the other; but Sinfjötli met eleven and killed them all alone without calling. In anger Sigmundr leapt on him and bit him in the throat. Repenting, he carried him back to the house and cursed the skins; then he saw a weasel bite another in the throat and run into the wood for a leaf that healed it, and a raven brought him such a leaf, and Sinfjötli sprang up whole. On the tenth day they could take the skins off, and they burned them.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第8章。claim.v0340.vol_1.08
09

燃烧的大厅The burning hall

复仇的时候到了。西格蒙德和辛菲奥特利来到西格尔的王宫，藏在大厅前面放酒桶的屋子里。西格妮知道他们来了。西格尔和西格妮的两个年幼的孩子在大厅里玩金环，一个金环滚进了酒桶屋，孩子跑去捡，看见了两个陌生的大个子，赶紧跑回去告诉父亲。西格妮对西格蒙德说：这两个孩子出卖了你们，杀了他们吧。西格蒙德不肯，辛菲奥特利却拔剑杀死了两个孩子，把尸体扔进了大厅。西格尔的人一拥而上，经过一场激战，父子二人被擒。西格尔下令把他们活埋在一座大坟堆里，坟堆中间用一块巨大的石板隔开，让他们看得见彼此，却碰不到彼此，慢慢饿死。就在人们往坟堆上盖草皮的时候，西格妮抱着一捆稻草走来，扔进了辛菲奥特利那一边，里面裹着一块猪肉，猪肉里藏着西格蒙德的那把剑。夜里，父子二人用这把剑锯开了石板，那把剑锋利无比，石板被锯成了两半。他们从坟堆里爬出来，来到西格尔的大厅，在大厅四周堆满了木柴，放起火来。西格尔被火惊醒，问是谁放的火。西格蒙德说：是我和我外甥辛菲奥特利，我们要让你知道，沃尔松格家的人并没有死光。他请妹妹出来。西格妮走出火海，对哥哥说出了真相：辛菲奥特利是她和他的儿子，她为了复仇做了一切，现在她已经不能再活下去了。她亲吻了哥哥和儿子，转身走回燃烧的大厅，与丈夫一起死在了火中。

The time for vengeance came. Father and son hid in the ale-store before Siggeir's hall. Two young children of Siggeir and Signý, playing with gold rings, saw them when a ring rolled in, and told their father. Signý told Sigmundr to kill them for betraying them; he would not, but Sinfjötli slew them and flung them into the hall. After hard fighting the two were taken, and Siggeir had them buried alive in a great mound divided by a stone slab, so they could see but not reach each other. As the turf was laid, Signý threw straw into Sinfjötli's side with pork wrapped round Sigmundr's sword; in the night they sawed through the slab with it, climbed out, piled wood round Siggeir's hall and set it on fire. When Siggeir asked who had lit it, Sigmundr said it was he and his sister's son Sinfjötli, to show that not all the Völsungs were dead. He called his sister out; Signý told him that Sinfjötli was her son by him, that she had done everything for vengeance and could not live after it; she kissed her brother and son, went back into the burning hall and died with her husband.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第8章。claim.v0340.vol_1.09
10

博格希尔德的毒酒Borghildr's poison

大仇得报，西格蒙德回到了父亲的国家，赶走了趁他不在时占据王位的人，做了一个伟大的国王。他娶了一位名叫博格希尔德的妻子，生了两个儿子，其中的赫尔吉后来成为杀死洪丁国王的著名英雄，赢得了女武神般的公主西格伦。辛菲奥特利也一直跟随着父亲，四处征战。有一次，他和博格希尔德的兄弟同时爱上了一个女人，两人在争斗中，辛菲奥特利杀死了他。博格希尔德要求把辛菲奥特利赶走，西格蒙德不肯，宁愿用黄金赔偿。博格希尔德表面上接受了，暗地里却决心报复。在为她兄弟举行的葬礼宴会上，她亲自给众人倒酒，端了一角酒给辛菲奥特利。辛菲奥特利看了看，说：这酒浑浊。西格蒙德接过来替他喝了。第二次又是这样。第三次，博格希尔德讥讽说：你还算是沃尔松格家的人吗？西格蒙德这时已经喝醉了，对儿子说：用你的胡子把它滤过去吧，儿子。辛菲奥特利喝下了酒，立刻倒地而死。西格蒙德悲痛欲绝，抱着儿子的尸体走到一个海湾边，一个撑着小船的人说愿意把他们渡过去，可是船太小，只能装下尸体。西格蒙德把尸体放上船，那人撑船离岸，转眼就消失了——那是奥丁来接他的孙子了。

Vengeance done, Sigmundr returned to his father's land, drove out the usurper and became a great king. He married Borghildr and had two sons, of whom Helgi became the famous slayer of King Hundingr and won Sigrún. Sinfjötli fought at his father's side; but he and Borghildr's brother wooed the same woman, and Sinfjötli killed him. Borghildr demanded he be driven out; Sigmundr would only pay compensation in gold, and she seemed to accept it. At her brother's funeral feast she bore the drink herself and gave Sinfjötli a horn; he said the drink was cloudy, and Sigmundr drank it for him — twice. The third time she taunted him with being no Völsung, and Sigmundr, now drunk, said: 'Let your beard strain it, son.' Sinfjötli drank and fell dead. Grief-stricken, Sigmundr carried the body to a fjord, where a man in a small boat offered to ferry it across; the boat could hold only the body, and as soon as it was laid in, the man pushed off and vanished — Odin had come for his kinsman.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第9–10章。claim.v0340.vol_1.10
11

奥丁的长矛Odin's spear

博格希尔德被赶走，不久死去了。西格蒙德年纪老了，却听说岛国国王埃利米的女儿约尔迪斯是世上最美丽、最聪明的女子，就去向她求婚。洪丁国王的儿子吕恩吉也来求婚。约尔迪斯选择了年老而名声显赫的西格蒙德。吕恩吉怀恨在心，带着大军来攻打西格蒙德。西格蒙德虽然年老，仍然奋勇作战，他的剑在敌阵中左右砍杀，敌人纷纷倒下，他的手臂上沾满了鲜血。就在这时，一个人出现在战场上：他披着一件蓝色的斗篷，戴着宽边帽，只有一只眼睛，手里握着一支长矛。他走到西格蒙德面前，举起长矛挡住了西格蒙德砍来的剑。西格蒙德的剑砍在长矛上，断成了两截。从这一刻起，胜负就决定了。西格蒙德的人马纷纷倒下，国王自己也受了致命的伤，他的岳父埃利米也战死了。那把当年由奥丁插在橡树里、只有西格蒙德能拔出来的剑，最终由奥丁亲手折断。萨迦没有解释奥丁为什么这样做，可是西格蒙德自己明白：他的时候到了。

Borghildr was driven out and soon died. Old as he was, Sigmundr wooed Hjördís, daughter of King Eylimi, the fairest and wisest of women; Lyngvi, son of Hundingr, wooed her too, but she chose the old and famous Sigmundr. Lyngvi came against him with a great host. Old Sigmundr fought fiercely, his sword hewing down men until his arms were red with blood. Then a man appeared on the field in a blue cloak and broad hat, one-eyed, holding a spear, and he held up the spear against Sigmundr's stroke, and the sword broke in two. From that moment the battle turned; Sigmundr's men fell, he himself was mortally wounded, and his father-in-law Eylimi was slain. The sword Odin had thrust into the oak for Sigmundr alone was broken by Odin himself. The saga does not say why; but Sigmundr knew his time had come.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第11章。claim.v0340.vol_1.11
12

宝剑的碎片The shards of the sword

夜里，约尔迪斯来到满是尸体的战场上，找到了垂死的西格蒙德，问他能不能医治。西格蒙德说：许多人死于不太有希望的情况，可是我的运气已经离开了我，我不愿意医治。奥丁不愿意我再挥剑，因为他折断了它。只要他愿意，我曾经一直能打胜仗。他对约尔迪斯说：你怀着一个儿子，好好抚养他，他将成为我们家族最伟大、最著名的人。好好保管这把剑的碎片，用它们能打造出一把好剑，名叫格拉姆，我们的儿子将用它做出许多伟大的事业，他的名字将永远流传。说完这些话，西格蒙德在天亮时死去了。这时，丹麦国王希亚尔普雷克的儿子阿尔夫率领战船来到海边。约尔迪斯和侍女交换了衣服，侍女扮作王后，约尔迪斯扮作侍女。阿尔夫怀疑侍女的举止，就问她们：在天亮之前，你们怎么知道天快亮了？侍女说：我小时候常常在天亮前起来喝酒，所以到了那个时候就会醒。约尔迪斯说：父亲给了我一枚金戒指，天快亮时，戒指就会在我手指上变凉。阿尔夫立刻明白了谁是真正的王后，他善待约尔迪斯，后来娶了她。不久，约尔迪斯生下了西格蒙德的儿子，取名西古尔德。

That night Hjördís came to the field of the dead, found Sigmundr dying and asked if he could be healed. Many live when hope is small, he said, but his luck had left him and he would not be healed; Odin did not wish him to draw sword again, since he had broken it, and while Odin willed it he had always won. She was carrying his son, he told her: let her rear him well, for he would be the greatest and most famous of their kin; and let her keep the shards of the sword well, for from them a good sword called Gram would be made, and their son would do great deeds with it, and his name would live as long as the world. He died at dawn. Then Álfr, son of King Hjálprekr of Denmark, came with his ships. Hjördís had exchanged clothes with her maid; Álfr, suspicious, asked how they knew in the dark that dawn was near. The maid said she had been used to drinking before dawn as a girl; Hjördís said her father had given her a gold ring that grew cold on her finger toward daybreak. Álfr knew the true queen, treated her honourably and later married her, and she bore Sigmundr's son, Sigurðr.

Evidence / 证据《沃尔松格萨迦》第12–13章。claim.v0340.vol_1.12

Editorial boundary / 编辑边界

依据莫里斯与马格努松英译《沃尔松格萨迦》第1–13章，按章节顺序讲述。萨迦写成于十三世纪的冰岛，改写自《诗体埃达》中的英雄诗；第9章赫尔吉的事迹只作概述。萨迦中兄妹乱伦、杀子等情节照原书交代结果，不渲染细节。

北欧 / Norse

沃尔松格萨迦 · 第二部 屠龙者西古尔德The Saga of the Völsungs, Part 2: Sigurd the dragon-slayer

西古尔德在丹麦国王的宫中长大，由矮人般的铁匠雷金抚养，在奥丁的指点下选中了骏马格拉尼。雷金讲述了一段带着诅咒的黄金的来历：洛基杀死了他的兄弟奥特，众神从矮人安德瓦利那里夺来黄金作为赎金，安德瓦利诅咒了黄金和戒指；他的另一个兄弟法夫纳为了黄金杀死了父亲，变成了恶龙。雷金用西格蒙德留下的碎片重铸了宝剑格拉姆，西古尔德为父亲报了仇，又在坑中刺死了法夫纳。他尝到龙心的血，听懂了鸟语，杀死了想要背叛他的雷金，带着黄金来到山上，唤醒了被奥丁用睡眠之刺惩罚的女武神布伦希尔德，两人许下了婚誓。

Sigurðr grows up at the Danish court, fostered by the dwarf-like smith Reginn, and with Odin's advice chooses the horse Grani. Reginn tells of cursed gold: Loki killed his brother Otr, the gods took the dwarf Andvari's hoard as ransom and Andvari cursed the gold and his ring; his other brother Fáfnir killed their father for it and became a dragon. Reginn reforges Sigmundr's shards into the sword Gram; Sigurðr avenges his father and stabs Fáfnir from a pit. Tasting the dragon's heart-blood he understands the birds, kills the treacherous Reginn, carries off the gold, and on a mountain wakes the shield-maiden Brynhildr, whom Odin had pricked with the sleep-thorn, and they plight their troth.
